For each spatial position, SSI fixes the observed surrounding context, defines a conditional game over the channels at that position, and applies the Shapley value to this local game. The result is a full spectral-spatial attribution matrix rather than a single heatmap or a global channel ranking. SSI has a clear local interpretation. It satisfies Shapley fairness within each position, and aggregating its channel attributions exactly recovers the position-level contextual contrast obtained by replacing that position with the baseline. SSI also differs from context-averaged Owen-style hierarchical accounting, which uses the same position-channel grouping but averages over external spatial coalitions. On HLS Burn Scar, SSI outperforms an MC-Owen estimator across retained attribution metrics while using only about 6% of its evaluation budget. Across CUB-200, EuroSAT, and HLS Burn Scar under both per-channel mean and zero baselines, SSI achieves the best joint deletion and insertion AUC over dense, flat, and rank-1 baselines, yields the strongest spectral hit rates and channel deletion, and leads spatial localization on both annotated datasets. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [218] [Noise-Space Reward Alignment for Few-Step Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21125)
*Woocheol Shin,Taeyoung Yun,Jiwon Sung,Hyeongyu Kang,Jeongmin Park,Jaewoo Lee,Kyuil Sim,Dohyun Kim,Yutong He,Jinkyoo Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Noise Policy Optimization (NPO)方法，针对少步生成模型在仅有黑盒奖励情况下的对齐问题，通过学习一个摊销的流策略来变换冻结生成器的初始噪声分布，从而在保持少步推理效率的同时实现奖励对齐，并在图像、语言和蛋白质结构生成任务上取得了优于直接微调和测试时搜索方法的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步生成模型（如一致性模型、蒸馏模型、Flow-Map等）虽然能以极少的评估次数生成高质量样本，但在仅有黑盒奖励信号的情况下，难以将其对齐到下游目标属性。现有方法中，直接对生成器进行RL微调会出现严重的奖励过优化（破坏预训练知识），而测试时噪声优化则牺牲了少步生成的效率优势。因此需要一种专门针对少步生成模型的对齐方法。

Method: 核心方法为Noise Policy Optimization (NPO)，包含三个关键设计：(1) 保持预训练生成器冻结，学习一个摊销的流策略（连续ODE）在初始噪声空间中将标准高斯噪声映射为奖励倾斜的噪声分布，其通过冻结生成器的前推分布恰好等于奖励倾斜的输出分布；(2) 使用KL正则化的奖励最大化目标，通过与参考速度场的偏差实现正则化，保持噪声分布接近初始高斯分布；(3) 采用基于ELBO的似然估计方法（仅需采样端点处的正向加噪对），避免依赖轨迹模拟，大幅提升训练时的样本效率。策略通过GRPO风格的优势函数和重要性比进行更新。

Result: 在三个领域的实验中，NPO均取得了比直接微调更好的奖励-质量权衡：(1) 文本到图像生成（SD-Turbo, SANA-Sprint）：NPO提升了美学和压缩性奖励，同时保持ImageReward和LPIPS多样性，优于Flow-GRPO和FAV-B；(2) 语言生成（ELF四步模型）：在主题引导任务上提升奖励的同时保持了困惑度和熵；(3) 蛋白质结构生成：提升β-折叠多样性的同时保留可设计性。相比测试时搜索方法（BoN, ReNO, ZeNO），NPO以16×到549×更低的推理成本实现了相当的奖励水平。相比轨迹基础的噪声策略学习方法（Noise Flow-GRPO, ODS），NPO以更少的奖励评估次数达到相同奖励水平。NPO对ELBO权重、正则化强度和插值方式等设计选择具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: NPO是一种针对少步生成模型的高效奖励对齐方法，通过冻结生成器并在噪声空间学习摊销策略，有效利用了预训练知识，避免了奖励过优化，同时将测试时搜索成本摊销到训练阶段。ELBO基础的似然估计进一步提升了训练效率。该方法在多种生成任务上展示了良好的泛化能力，是一种实用且通用的少步生成模型对齐方案。未来工作可将噪声策略进一步蒸馏为一步映射以完全匹配冻结生成器的推理速度。

Abstract: Few-step generative models produce high-quality samples in one or a few evaluations. However, steering them toward desired properties remains difficult, especially when only black-box reward evaluations are available. While one could apply approaches developed for iterative diffusion and flow-based models, such as direct RL fine-tuning or test-time scaling, we find that neither transfers well to the few-step regime: direct fine-tuning suffers from severe reward over-optimization, and test-time scaling sacrifices the efficiency advantage of few-step generation. We propose Noise Policy Optimization (NPO), which explicitly targets the alignment problem for few-step generative models. The key idea is to learn an amortized flow policy over the initial noise space of the generator. The trained policy transports Gaussian noise to a reward-tilted noise distribution, whose pushforward distribution through the frozen generator is exactly the reward-tilted output distribution. By keeping the generator frozen, we can effectively utilize the knowledge encoded in the pretrained model, yielding a better reward-quality trade-off than direct fine-tuning. The amortized policy moves the search cost into training, so inference adds only a lightweight noise sampling step on top of the pretrained model. To improve sample efficiency during training, we use ELBO-based likelihood estimation that requires only sampled endpoints rather than simulated trajectories. Across image, language, and protein structure generation, NPO consistently achieves a better reward-quality trade-off than direct fine-tuning, and matches test-time search methods with 16 to 549 times lower inference cost.

</details>


### [219] [Predicting Live Birth After Fresh Embryo Transfer in IVF/ICSI: Differential ICM/Trophectoderm Morphology Encoding and a Hybrid Attention--Logistic Regression Ensemble](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21134)
*Abdul Raheem Shahzad,Jinxin Chen,Ming Zhang,Juan Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个单中心616个IVF/ICSI新鲜胚胎移植周期的数据集，提出了一种对囊胚内细胞团(ICM)和滋养外胚层(TE)进行差异化加权的新形态学编码方案，并开发了一种混合注意力网络与逻辑回归(HAN+LR)的集成模型用于活产预测，最终在11个模型的对比中获得最高的测试AUC-ROC(0.710)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有IVF/ICSI活产预测模型多存在未外部验证或偏倚风险，且结构化临床数据上的现代表格模型缺乏头对头基准比较；此外，传统Gardner评分对囊胚ICM和TE隐含等权重，无法区分镜像分级(如4AB vs 4BA)。因此需要构建一个经过精心整理的单中心数据集，并开发适合小样本临床表格数据的预测模型，同时引入更合理的胚胎形态学编码。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 收集616个新鲜胚胎移植周期(251例活产，365例非活产)，涵盖临床、实验室和胚胎学四大类预测变量；(2) 提出差异化ICM/TE加权编码方案(ICM×0.5, TE×1.0)，将Gardner字母等级和Peter卵裂期分级转化为10个数值列；(3) 预处理采用KNN(k=5)填补和稳健缩放，通过SelectKBest(ANOVA F统计)筛选50个特征；(4) 构建HAN(可学习特征注意力门控+紧凑MLP: 50→24→12→1)，由3个不同随机种子实例概率平均组成HAN骨干；(5) HAN与L2正则化逻辑回归通过验证集网格搜索混合权重(w=0.70)构成HAN+LR集成；(6) 与经典ML、TabPFN及文本序列化语言模型(MiniLM、DistilBERT、BERT、ELECTRA、RoBERTa)共11个模型对比。

Result: HAN+LR集成在93例保留测试集上取得最高AUC-ROC(0.710)、准确率0.710、F1=0.630，优于HAN骨干(0.700)、逻辑回归(0.667)、TabPFN+LR(0.666)、TabPFN(0.650)及其他模型(0.556–0.632)；文本序列化语言模型表现接近随机(AUC≤0.61)。加权TE特征在跨模型共识重要性中排名第一(4.53%)。消融实验验证了特征注意力模块、dropout配置(0.25/0.15)和HAN加权混合(w=0.7)的贡献。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了一个透明、可复现的IVF/ICSI活产预测框架，含精心整理的数据集、差异化的ICM/TE编码和紧凑(约5,000参数)且可审计的HAN+LR集成模型；下一关键步骤是前瞻性、多中心外部验证及概率校准和决策阈值优化，方可用于临床决策支持。

Abstract: Predicting live birth before fresh embryo transfer could support shared decision-making in IVF/ICSI, but routine clinical data are small, heterogeneous, and contain pathway-dependent variables prone to outcome leakage. We aimed to construct a curated single-centre IVF/ICSI dataset and develop a prediction model suited to small tabular clinical data. \textit{Materials and Methods:} We assembled 616 fresh embryo-transfer cycles (251 live birth, 365 non-live birth) with clinical, laboratory, and embryological predictors, and embryo morphology encoded with a novel differential weighting of the inner cell mass and trophectoderm. After KNN imputation, robust scaling, and selection of 50 features, we developed a Hybrid Attention Network (HAN), a learnable feature-attention gate followed by a compact multilayer perceptron, and a HAN + logistic-regression (LR) ensemble with a validation-tuned weight. Models were benchmarked against classical machine learning, TabPFN, and text-serialized language models on a held-out test set; AUC-ROC was the primary metric. \textit{Results:} The HAN + LR ensemble achieved the highest test AUC-ROC (0.710; accuracy 0.710, F1 0.630), ahead of the HAN backbone alone (0.700), logistic regression (0.667), the TabPFN + LR hybrid (0.666), and TabPFN (0.650). Text-serialized language models performed near chance (AUC $\le$ 0.61). The differentially weighted trophectoderm feature ranked highest by consensus importance across models. \textit{Discussion:} A compact attention network combined with a linear model outperformed both components and strong foundation-model baselines on a small clinical cohort. \textit{Conclusion:} The curated dataset and HAN + LR ensemble offer a transparent, reproducible basis for IVF/ICSI live-birth prediction; external validation is the next step.

</details>


### [220] [Sensor Diagnosis for Fuel and Emissions Monitoring in Heavy-Duty Diesel Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21188)
*Tejas Dahiya,Saurabh Kumar Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对重型柴油车传感器故障诊断与碳排放监测问题，提出两套基于健康数据学习关系的方法：一是传感器诊断程序（识别故障传感器并判断故障类型），二是燃油修正程序（选择性地修正燃料读数以改善CO₂排放计算）。在12升重型柴油发动机217个稳态工况点上测试，五种合成故障的诊断覆盖率为77.3%、准确率92.1%，燃油修正使燃烧CO₂计算误差降低83.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重型柴油车占欧盟道路运输CO₂排放约四分之一，但在IEA当前政策情景下到2035年仅有约10%卡车实现电动化，因此对在用柴油车的燃料和排放监测仍至关重要。传感器读数误差会扭曲燃料使用和排放估算，而现有方法要么侧重瞬态工况下的单一信号重建，要么缺乏对完整诊断流程及CO₂核算影响的系统评估。论文旨在评估基于健康数据学习关系的方法能否在未见转速条件下同时完成传感器故障识别与燃料修正，从而提升排放核算精度同时保留未受影响读数。

Method: 诊断程序：(1) 用二阶多项式岭回归从转速、转矩和其他四个传感器读数预测每个传感器的健康值；(2) 用120棵极端随机树集合的预测分歧标准化预测误差，构建调整后误差并设定可疑点阈值；(3) 通过替换测试法识别故障传感器——估计替换值后检查另一传感器预测误差是否下降，选择总分最大的传感器；(4) 随机森林基于12个传感器特征和12个组特征预测五种故障类型（偏移、缩放、噪声、间歇零、截顶）；(5) 逻辑回归估计诊断正确性概率，设定报告阈值以决定是否发出诊断。燃油修正程序：在单个工况点评估六个传感器，估计每个传感器的健康值并选择使最大调整误差降幅最大的传感器作为故障；要求触发警报、通过工况检查、燃油被选中且与第二选择差距足够大时才修正。所有模型在七折分组交叉验证（每折排除三个转速的所有测量）下用三种随机种子训练评估。

Result: 在31,500个故障注入组中（217个工况点随机采样20个）：警报率80.0%、诊断发布率77.3%、发布诊断中92.1%完全正确；传感器识别在警报组中96.7%正确。故障类型间差异显著：偏移96.4%、噪声99.98%、间歇零96.0%正确，但缩放误差仅63.1%、截顶65.2%正确。健康组误诊率6.7%（集中在特定转速-种子组合）。燃油修正在1%故障场景假设下使CO₂计算平均绝对误差从0.0529降至0.00855 kg/发动机小时（降低83.8%）；替换所有读数反而使误差增至0.3488 kg；仅修正已知故障读数误差为0.000325 kg。在额外涡轮风扇数据集上验证，检测率36.9%、传感器识别率89.4%、重构误差减少83.3%。

Conclusion: 在测试的发动机工况图上，基于健康数据学习的关系可支持完整传感器诊断和燃油修正，在提升排放核算精度的同时保留未受影响读数。方法对偏移和噪声故障效果优异，但对缩放误差和截顶故障仍有困难。故障类型不熟悉时（负荷依赖偏移、卡死读数、双传感器同时故障），系统仍会输出五种训练类型之一（90.2%-98.5%），说明仅靠不确定性阈值无法可靠识别训练类别外的故障。未来工作需在真实车辆运行中用观测到的传感器故障、不同发动机及变化工况评估两种程序，以验证诊断准确性和燃油修正对CO₂估算的改进效果。

Abstract: Faulty sensor readings can distort estimates of fuel use and carbon dioxide emissions from diesel engines. We evaluate two procedures that use relationships learned from healthy measurements to diagnose faults and guide fuel correction. The diagnosis procedure tests whether replacing a suspected faulty reading with an estimated healthy value helps a model predict another sensor's recorded reading more accurately. It then predicts the fault type and decides whether to report the diagnosis. We evaluate five synthetic fault types on 217 steady-state operating points from a heavy-duty diesel engine, excluding all measurements at selected engine speeds from training. Across 31,500 fault-injected groups of 20 operating points, it issues diagnoses for 77.3% of groups, with 92.1% of diagnoses issued on these groups correct. The fuel correction procedure uses a different sensor-selection rule at individual operating points, testing how each replacement changes the largest prediction error across all six sensors. Fuel correction requires a fault alarm and engine speed and torque close to the training conditions. A fuel reading is replaced only when its replacement reduces the largest prediction error sufficiently more than replacements for the other sensors. Assuming faults in 1% of one-hour scenarios, equally likely sensors and fault types, and equal time at each measured condition, selected fuel corrections reduce mean absolute error in calculated combustion CO2 by 83.8%. On this engine map, learned relationships support complete sensor diagnoses and fuel corrections that improve emissions accounting while preserving unaffected readings.

</details>


### [221] [Resisting Harmful Instructions through Training-Free Weight Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21189)
*Ali Ebrahimpour-Boroojeny,Xiaocong Yang,Samuel Schapiro,Zahra Borhani,Francisco R. Ortega,Yujia Zheng,ChengXiang Zhai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的权重编辑方法，通过对比成对提示词的激活差异来识别并缩放少量关键权重，从而降低指令微调语言模型对特定不良指令（如被指示说谎、产生性别歧视内容）的遵从度。该方法在五个模型家族的LIARS' BENCH和AI Liar上均优于系统提示、激活引导和集合差分掩码等基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指令跟随能力使模型能响应各种请求，但也使其可能遵从与安全目标相冲突的指令（如被要求说谎或输出歧视性内容）。现有干预手段（系统提示可被覆盖、激活引导效果不稳定）各有缺陷，且均不修改模型参数本身。需要一种轻量级、无需梯度训练、直接修改权重即可降低模型对特定不良指令遵从度的干预方法。

Method: 核心方法基于激活对比的权重编辑：(1) 构建成对提示集F/F：阻止/允许回答</br>
2. 通道对比：计算每个输入通道在F和T条件下的平均L2范数差，对比值</br>
3. 选择与编辑：评分s_ij = |W_ij| × c_j，每矩阵选ρ=4%最高正分值权重，应用W'=W⊙(1+αM)，α∈[-1.25, -1]</br>整个过程仅需前向传播，无需梯度或标注回复。

Result: 在五个模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-4-mini、Falcon3-3B、OLMo-2-1B、Qwen2.5-3B）上，方法在LIARS' BENCH上平均诚实率84.9%（领先最强基线+6.2个百分点），AI Liar上79.4%（领先+4.6）。七种提示格式转换研究中，单轮格式平均诚实率95.8%（vs CAA引导83.4%）。指令性别歧视任务中，平均性别歧视率从57.9%降至24.3%，结合公平提示进一步降至11.6%。

Conclusion: 该工作确立了基于梯度激活对比的权重编辑作为针对指令性说谎和性别歧视的有效训练免费干预方法。该方法可独立使用或与提示防护措施结合，支持其在权重可修改但上下文不可控的场景中部署。主要局限在于：选择性不足（也会降低对合法虚构请求的遵从）、多轮对话转换不一致、效果依赖于构建提示和验证选择的设置。

Abstract: Instruction-following language models can comply with requests that conflict with intended behaviors and safety alignment. We introduce a training-free weight-editing approach for reducing compliance with targeted undesirable instructions. Our method needs only forward passes on a small set of prompt pairs per target behavior, and because the edit is stored in the model's weights, changing or deleting instructions in the prompt cannot undo the weight modification. We evaluate the approach on two target harmful behaviors across five instruction-tuned models: instructed falsehood and instructed sexism. On two instructed-lying benchmarks, it improves mean honest response rates by 6.2 and 4.6 percentage points over the strongest alternative, significantly on three of the five models and within noise on the other two. In a controlled study of seven prompt formats, it maintains higher honest-response rates than single-layer activation steering when orders to lie arrive in single-turn formats not used to construct the edit. For instructed sexism, it reduces the mean sexist-response rate from 57.9% to 24.3%; combining the edit with a fairness prompt reduces it further to 11.9%. These results establish our contrast-based weight editing approach as an effective training-free intervention in two distinct behavioral domains, supporting its use both independently and alongside prompt-based safeguards.

</details>


### [222] [Poisoning the corpora of protein design systems during pre-training and retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21200)
*Charalampos Koilakos,Kimon-Antonios Provatas,Michail Patsakis,Candace SY Chan,Georgios A. Pavlopoulos,Ilias Georgakopoulos-Soares*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对蛋白质基础模型提出了两种数据投毒攻击，分别针对自回归蛋白质语言模型的预训练语料库以及文本引导蛋白质生成器的检索语料库，证明了仅通过数据操纵即可在蛋白质设计系统中植入持久性对抗行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质基础模型在生成新型生物序列方面应用日益广泛，但其训练和检索高度依赖大规模公开数据集，这些数据来源使其面临对抗性数据操纵的安全风险。然而，蛋白质设计系统中数据投毒攻击的可行性与危害程度尚未得到系统研究。

Method: 研究设计了两类数据投毒攻击：(1) 预训练语料库投毒——分别训练3亿参数的ProtGPT2和ProGen2变体，注入含特定触发器(trigger)与载荷(payload)的污染蛋白质序列，分别采用均匀(Uniform)和渐进(Ramped)投毒策略；(2) 检索语料库投毒——在不修改模型权重和解码过程的前提下，向检索库插入对抗记录，分别测试查询感知(Query-aware)的单记录攻击和查询无关(Query-unaware)的1500条通用记录攻击，并通过模板化请求和自由文本请求评估检索劫持率，进而通过profile-HMM同源性检测载荷（如结构域）的成功转移率。

Result: 预训练投毒：两种架构在所有投毒实验中都成功习得高可靠性的触发器依赖生成行为。渐进投毒方案下，仅需约200个污染样本即可触发多数激活，而均匀方案需约5000个样本。检索投毒：单条查询感知记录即可在58%模板化请求和97%自由文本请求中占据前16的检索位置；在成功劫持检索的条件下，62%请求生成了被篡改的序列，其中19%-21%通过profile-HMM同源性确认成功转移了插入的结构域。1500条查询无关通用记录同样实现了显著的检索劫持与结构域转移效果。同时，正常模型行为在两种攻击下基本保持不变。

Conclusion: 仅通过对抗性数据贡献即可在预训练阶段建立持久性的序列特异性行为，或在推理阶段重定向蛋白质生成，而模型的常规功能几乎不受影响。该研究确立了蛋白质序列数据的完整性与生物溯源性作为生成式蛋白质设计系统关键安全防线的重要地位。

Abstract: Protein foundation models increasingly support the generation of novel biological sequences, yet their reliance on large public datasets creates opportunities for adversarial manipulation of the material they learn from and retrieve. We investigate two data-only poisoning attacks against protein design systems, targeting the pre-training corpus of autoregressive protein language models and the retrieval corpus of a text-guided protein generator. For the first, we pre-trained ProtGPT2 and ProGen2 variants of 300 million parameters, introducing poisoned protein sequences containing one of two triggers followed by one of three payloads. Across all poisoned runs, both architectures acquired highly reliable trigger-dependent generation under uniform and ramped poisoning schedules. Under ramped exposure, the earliest majority activation occurred after only 200 contaminated examples, while for the uniform schedule earliest activation occurred around 5000 poisoned samples. For the second attack, we inserted records into a retrieval corpus system without modifying its weights or decoding procedure. A single query-aware record captured a top-16 retrieval position for 58\% of templated requests and 97\% of free-text requests. Conditional on successful poisoned retrieval, 62\% of requests produced altered sequences, while 19-21% acquired the inserted domain by profile-HMM homology. A universal query-unaware attack using 1,500 records also achieved substantial retrieval capture and domain transfer. Together, these findings demonstrate that adversarial protein sequence contributions can establish persistent, sequence-specific behaviour during pre-training or redirect protein generation at inference, while leaving ordinary model behaviour largely preserved. Our work establishes the integrity and biological provenance of protein sequence data as critical safeguards for generative protein design systems.

</details>


### [223] [Hard Way, The Only Way: Provable Merits of Training on Hardest Examples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21201)
*Elvis Dohmatob*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对"数据剪枝为何有效"这一现象，利用统计力学中的副本方法，建立了高维加权经验风险最小化（ERM）下数据剪枝的精确理论框架。研究证明：在样本量远大于特征维度（P≫N）时，保留仅约2N个"最困难"训练样本的极端剪枝策略可使分类测试误差从经典P⁻¹/²速率提升至贝叶斯最优的P⁻¹速率；在样本量较小（P≪N）时则最优保留"简单"样本。该工作统一并严格化了此前基于Gardner问题的启发式分析，并为"少即是多"现象及模型崩溃缓解提供了理论依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践中观察到的"激进数据剪枝可显著提升模型性能甚至超越全数据训练"这一反直觉现象，亟需统一的理论解释。此前Sorscher et al.(2022)与Dohmatob et al.(2026)分别通过Gardner问题和随机矩阵理论给出启发式判断，但缺乏对标准加权ERM框架下光滑损失、标签噪声及显式权重的严格理论刻画。

Method: 在比例渐近极限N,P→∞且N/P→φ>0下，研究线性学生-教师模型对高斯输入的加权ridge正则化ERM。采用副本方法(replica method)从统计力学推导固定点方程，给出student权重与测试误差的精确渐近表达式，并分别在小φ（分类，Theorem 5；回归，Theorem 9）与大φ（分类，Theorem 8）下严格证明最优剪枝策略与最优测试误差下界。

Result: 1) 推导出加权ERM下测试误差的精确渐近公式（Theorem 2-4），并恢复Dohmatob et al.(2026)主要结果作为特例。2) 证明在P≫N（φ→0）且无标签偏移条件下，最优剪枝为保留沿pruning方向边界处薄带状的2N个最困难样本，达到E_test≍φ/√(6π)的Bayes最优P⁻¹速率（Theorem 5），优于全数据的P⁻¹/²速率。3) 在P≪N（φ→∞）时，若剪枝方向良好则最优保留最简单样本（Theorem 8）；若剪枝方向不佳则反而应使用全部数据。4) 证明在有标签偏移的回归问题中，激进剪枝可缓解模型崩溃（Theorem 9）。数值实验与理论完全吻合。

Conclusion: 本文为"少即是多"的数据剪枝现象提供了首个基于标准加权ERM的严格高维理论：在数据过剩时，精心设计的极端剪枝能够突破传统ERM的平方根瓶颈，达到贝叶斯最优速率；且此策略同时能缓解递归训练中的模型崩溃。这将数据中心的AI研究从单纯依赖数据规模转向以战略性样本选择为核心，并为LLM微调中观察到的激进剪枝现象提供了理论支撑。未来工作需将该框架扩展至非线性模型与神经网络。

Abstract: Despite a surge of empirical interest in the ``unreasonable effectiveness'' of drastic data pruning for AI systems, a unified theoretical understanding of this phenomenon remains elusive. In this work, we provide a precise high-dimensional theory of learning under data pruning via weighted empirical risk minimization (ERM). As in previous work, we analyze a setting where pruning is performed along a one-dimensional subspace of the input space. Our analysis precisely characterizes the limiting test error curves in the regime where the input dimension N and sample size P tend to infinity with a fixed ratio N/P. The resulting theory recovers several recent results in the literature as special cases and provides a general lens to evaluate how pruning strategies interact with the loss function and label noise. Crucially, we characterize the optimal pruning strategy in the high-sample regime where P greatly exceeds N. We demonstrate that strategic pruning can accelerate the decay of classification test error from the classical sqrt(N/P) rate, typical of vanilla ERM with loss functions without exponential tail (e.g., quadratic loss), to the much faster Bayes-optimal scaling of order N/P. In this setup, we prove that, surprisingly, this optimal performance is achieved by a drastic pruning strategy: discarding almost all training data except for a small proportion, consisting strictly of the 2N hardest training examples.

</details>


### [224] [Learning and Forecasting Multiscale Spatiotemporal Epidemic Dynamics with Lagrangian-Eulerian Graph Neural ODEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21223)
*Jinyi Duan,Qian Li,Biao Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LE-EpiGNODE框架，将年龄接触驱动的拉格朗日感染生成算子与移动驱动的欧拉人口传输算子嵌入结构保持型通用微分方程（UDE），用于多尺度时空流行病学预测，在合成与三个真实COVID-19数据集上均取得最优长程预测精度，并具备过程级动力学可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合模型未能明确说明异构观测对应何种流行病学过程，以及学习到的图交互如何修改系统状态；不同过程（感染生成 vs 人口传输）具有本质不同的状态作用却被吸收到同一潜在交互机制中，可能在训练区域内产生补偿但在长程外推时失效，轨迹精度无法保证动力学的忠实性。

Method: 提出LE-EpiGNODE（Lagrangian–Eulerian Epidemic Graph Neural ODE）：在结构化通用微分方程中嵌入两个过程特定的图神经算子——基于年龄接触信息的拉格朗日感染生成算子（在区域内部通过隔室转移产生新感染）和基于移动信息的欧拉人口传输算子（通过零和约束保守地重新分配完整隔室状态）；采用两阶段学习（OD移动网络预训练 + 疫情观测损失优化）；引入F^b→Φ→LIF/EIF分层评估框架来检验过程级动力学保真度。

Result: 在14个合成机制、3个真实COVID-19数据集（Ontario、Hubei、Spain）与21个对比模型、5个消融实验中，LE-EpiGNODE在最长时间跨度上均取得最低WMAPE，相对最佳基线降低17.7%–40.0%；消融实验证实拉格朗日-欧拉分解及过程对齐先验的必要性；合成实验中学习到的算子与通量与已知生成动力学高度一致（F^L-PCC达0.936–0.980，F^E-PCC达0.996–0.999）。

Conclusion: 机制组织的图神经动力学可通过将异构观测映射到其物理约束的过程、赋予图过程明确语义并由控制动力学限制状态变换，为长程流行病外推提供可靠路径，并在控制系统中实现可直接检验的过程级机制解释；该原理可推广至具有不同物理状态作用的多尺度动力系统。

Abstract: Accurate medium- to long-range epidemic forecasting requires extrapolating high-dimensional, heterogeneous and nonstationary dynamics from partial observations. Yet hybrid models often leave implicit which observations inform which epidemic processes and how learned graph interactions modify system state. We introduce LE-EpiGNODE, which replaces generic message passing with process-specific, mechanism-guided neural operators: age-contact information drives Lagrangian infection generation, whereas mobility drives conservative Eulerian population transport within a structure-preserving universal differential equation. We evaluated LE-EpiGNODE across 14 controlled synthetic mechanisms spanning time-modulated, state-dependent, nonlinear and coupled dynamics, three complementary COVID-19 settings, 21 comparator models and five targeted ablations. Forecasting gains tended to become more pronounced at longer horizons; at the longest horizon, LE-EpiGNODE achieved the lowest WMAPE in all three real-world datasets, reducing error by 17.7-40.0% relative to the best baseline. Controlled ablations linked these gains to the Lagrangian-Eulerian decomposition and process-aligned priors, while synthetic ground truth showed that learned operators and induced state fluxes track known generating dynamics. These results support mechanism-organized graph neural dynamics as a route to reliable long-horizon extrapolation with directly testable, process-level mechanistic interpretation beyond trajectory accuracy.

</details>


### [225] [Not All Change Is Damage: Update-Matched Unlearning for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21230)
*Jie Li,Youming Tao,Bowei He,Meng Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出更新匹配遗忘（UMU）方法，针对大语言模型在发布后持续微调场景下的鲁棒遗忘问题。其核心观点是：现有防御方法使用预更新参考会同时惩罚有用的更新变化，导致模型失去可塑性（学习新任务的能力）。UMU通过对防御模型和参考模型应用相同的模拟重学习更新，并基于新任务学习试验选择检查点，在抑制被删除知识恢复的同时保留了模型的可塑性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有鲁棒遗忘防御训练模型抵抗模拟重学习，但低重学习率无法区分选择性抵抗与一般可塑性丧失。预更新参考会将更新本身诱导的有用变化视为偏差而惩罚，导致模型既抵抗目标恢复也抵抗正常学习。需要一种能选择性防止重学习同时保留可塑性的防御方法。

Method: 提出参考时序假设：当目标抑制程度相同时，更新匹配的参考比预更新参考更好地保留可塑性。基于此提出UMU，包含两个组件：(1) 更新匹配回放——使用TaskLoRA在被防御模型的副本上模拟重学习，记录权重变化后将该更新同步应用到教师模型（参考）和学生模型（防御模型），仅训练EraseLoRA在抑制遗忘集恢复的同时匹配已更新教师的保留集输出；(2) 学习试验选择——对候选检查点在新任务上进行短时微调，只有通过遗忘、保留、效用和学习进展检查的检查点才被发布。最终将EraseLoRA合并后释放标准模型，无运行时组件。

Result: 在TOFU和FaithUn基准上，使用Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct和Qwen3-4B，针对GD、RMU、KLUE三种基础遗忘方法共12种设置：UMU平均降低有害重学习28.8点（p=0.1）、良性重学习9.9点，同时提升新任务准确率3.5点。消融实验表明：去除回放（使用预更新参考）虽攻击分数相似但新任务准确率下降6.3点；去除学习试验选择则新任务准确率下降2.0-2.7点，验证了参考时序假设。

Conclusion: 鲁棒遗忘应选择性地防止被删除知识的恢复，同时不抑制学习本身。参考时序是揭示重学习抵抗与可塑性丧失之间模糊性的关键机制。UMU通过更新匹配回放和学习试验选择，在三种基础方法、两个基准和两个骨干网络上同时改善了重学习抵抗和可塑性，证明了对齐保留目标与更新方向并显式考虑可塑性的重要性。

Abstract: Unlearning aims to remove selected knowledge from large language models to mitigate privacy and safety risks while preserving useful capabilities. For models that continue to be fine-tuned after release, this goal is insufficient: they must also resist relearning the deleted knowledge while preserving plasticity, the ability to learn new tasks. Existing defenses train against simulated relearning while trying to preserve useful capabilities, but low relearning alone cannot distinguish selective resistance from a general loss of plasticity. Evaluating preservation after an update requires deciding what the updated model should remain close to. A pre-update reference penalizes useful changes induced by the update simply because they depart from earlier outputs. We therefore formulate the reference-timing hypothesis that, at comparable target suppression, an update-matched reference better preserves plasticity than a pre-update one. To test and address this hypothesis, we propose Update-Matched Unlearning (UMU), which applies the same simulated relearning update to the defended model and to an undefended reference initialized from the same unlearned model, and uses new-task learning to guide model selection. Extensive experiments on TOFU and FaithUn with Llama and Qwen models show that UMU improves both relearning resistance and plasticity across all three base unlearning methods, lowering harmful and benign relearning by 30.4 and 9.9 points on average while raising new-task accuracy by 3.5 points. When the reference does not receive the update, relearning remains similarly low but new-task accuracy falls below the base method, supporting the reference-timing hypothesis and showing that robust unlearning should prevent recovery selectively without suppressing learning itself.

</details>


### [226] [Compatibility Matters: A Framework for Token-Level Teacher Selection in On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21234)
*Stanley Wei,Jiin Woo,Kaan Ozkara,Youngsuk Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出在On-Policy Distillation (OPD) 中进行 token 级别教师选择的理论框架，分析教师与学生的"兼容性"，将教师能力差距与师生表征差距解耦，并提出表征路由和置信度路由两类方案，实验证明在数学、代码、Triton kernel生成和视觉推理任务上pass@k可提升10个百分点以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 OPD 在整个训练过程甚至每个 prompt rollout 中只使用单一教师，忽略了 on-policy 特性所带来的 token 级教师选择的灵活性。缺乏对"什么样的教师适合监督学生"这一问题的严格理论刻画。

Method: 在 log-linear 模型族下建立理论框架，利用性能差引理将教师能力差距 ΔT 与师生 KL 模仿差距解耦；提出三类 token 级路由方案（直接分段路由、置信度路由、表征路由）；证明表征对齐 ρ 较大的教师产生更大梯度范数、置信度（熵更小）的教师产生更大梯度范数，并证明表征路由可保留更多高质量模式的多样性。

Result: 在合成 Math-Triton 任务上，Hellinger 路由在 pass@16 上达到 29.30%，比 vanilla OPD 高约 10 个百分点；在 Triton-only 思考任务上，熵路由 pass@1 达 22.44%；在算法编码任务上，特征路由在 pass@64 上优于所有基线；视觉推理上 Hellinger 路由在 WeMath 和 MathVista-mini 上分别达 68.69% 和 67.40%。

Conclusion: token 级教师选择是 OPD 中被低估的灵活维度；表征路由（教师-学生特征对齐）与置信度路由（教师熵）互补，前者在师生架构相似时更有效，后者在师生架构差异较大时更有效；该方法既提升能力又保持多样性，可作为 OPD-then-RL 流程中更好的起点。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently been introduced as a promising paradigm for continual learning, where a student policy can be supervised at the token-level. Typically, OPD is performed using a single teacher per prompt rollout (or even per training run). However, this ignores a whole other axis of flexibility that is available due to the on-policy nature - token-level teacher selection during rollouts. Building on this insight, we theoretically explore what makes a teacher and a student compatible for OPD, and leverage our findings to derive several empirical heuristics for teacher selection. In particular, our framework captures several desiderata for OPD: compatible teacher-student reasoning patterns, teacher competence, and induced student diversity. Theoretically, we categorize several types of teacher routing schemes, and we prove that under different scenarios, different routing schemes are likely to be beneficial for optimization and student diversity. We back up our findings with extensive experimental results in domains such as math, coding, kernel generation, and visual reasoning, where we find upwards of 10 percentage points of improvement on pass@$k$ when compared to vanilla OPD and the teacher experts on certain tasks, indicating both capability improvement and diversity over high-quality responses.

</details>


### [227] [Isolating a Language Model's Judgment with a Label-Free Subspace](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21256)
*Chaemin Jang,Donggyu Lee,Jeesoo Kim,Dongman Lee,Jihee Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无标签方法,通过识别隐藏状态中的"表达子空间"(expression subspace)来分离语言模型的内在判断(judgment)与其最终输出表达(expression),从而在指令改变导致输出不可靠时仍可恢复模型的真实判断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型被要求做出判断时,改变指令(例如否定问题、改变"是/否"含义)可能使最终输出变得不可靠。作者探究这是因为模型改变了内在判断,还是仅仅未能正确表达原有判断。标准线性读出器(readout)同时混合了判断和表达信息,因此也无法区分二者。

Method: 对同一输入在不同指令下的隐藏状态向量做配对差分,这些差分集中在低维"表达子空间"中。利用 SVD 提取该子空间(无需任何基准标签),然后从线性读出器中去除该子空间的投影,得到"孤立判断"(isolated judgment)。实验涵盖 14 个模型-数据集组合,涉及正确性、蕴含、安全三类二元判断任务。

Result: 当问题被否定时,孤立判断将读出器的 AUROC 从 0.504 提升到 0.825(蕴含)、从 0.480 提升到 0.891(安全)。在保留条件(No/False/0 表示正确)下也表现出类似的恢复效果。判断在中间层即可读出,而表达子空间对读出器的干扰主要发生在后层(约 0.9 层深度之后)。仅需从否定对中提取的 3 个方向即可恢复大部分性能。

Conclusion: 模型即使在最终答案改变时仍保持可读的内在判断。"表达子空间"提供了一种无标签方式将判断与表达分离,使在模型输出不可靠时仍能恢复内部判断。这对模型评估、内部读出器设计以及干预方法具有重要意义:行为失败可能源于判断错误或表达错误,二者需要不同的修正策略。

Abstract: Language models are often asked to make judgments: whether a proposed answer is correct, whether one statement follows logically from another, or whether a response is safe. Yet changing the instructions that specify how the judgment should be expressed can make the final answer less reliable, even for the same input. We ask whether this reflects a change in internal judgment or a failure to express it. Comparing hidden-state vectors for the same input under different instructions, we find that their differences concentrate in a low-dimensional expression subspace. We identify this subspace without benchmark labels and remove its contribution from a linear predictor to obtain an isolated judgment. Across correctness, entailment, and safety, the isolated judgment remains reliable under instructions not used to identify the subspace, even when the model's final answer and the original predictor degrade. When the judgment question is negated, isolation raises the predictor's AUROC from 0.504 to 0.825 for entailment and from 0.480 to 0.891 for safety. We also find that judgment is readable in earlier layers, before the expression subspace begins to disrupt the predictor. Together, these results provide a way to separate judgment from expression and recover internal judgments even when the model's final answers are unreliable.

</details>


### [228] [Rethinking Learning from Label Proportions via Moment Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21262)
*Tianhao Ma,Wei Wang,Yivan Zhang,Dong-Dong Wu,Takashi Ishida,Gang Niu,Masashi Sugiyama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LLP-MM（基于矩匹配的标签比例学习），一种用于弱监督学习任务LLP的简单有效方法。该方法针对传统"随机袋"假设在实际中常被违反的问题，采用更现实的"结构化袋"假设，并证明袋级标签计数服从泊松多项分布（PMD）。通过对齐分类器预测与多阶阶乘矩，在多个基准数据集上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLP方法大多基于"实例-标签对i.i.d.采样后随机组合成袋"的假设，但该假设在选举投票、在线广告等真实场景中常被违反（袋内实例存在相关性，分组依赖实例特征）。实验表明现有方法在非随机设置下表现次优。本文旨在设计一种适用于更现实结构化袋假设的方法。

Method: 1. 提出"结构化袋"假设：袋i.i.d.采样，给定袋后实例标签条件独立。由此推导袋级标签计数向量服从泊松多项分布（PMD）。
2. 提出LLP-MM：将可计算的r阶阶乘矩张量作为训练目标，让分类器预测诱导的阶乘矩与基于标签比例推导的实证矩对齐。经典比例匹配（PM）是其一阶特例。
3. 使用状态压缩动态规划方法，通过对称性将复杂度从q^r降至组合数C(q+s,s)。
4. 理论证明：使用更高阶矩会收紧解空间（Proposition 3.1），并提供基于Rademacher复杂度的泛化界（Theorem 3.2/3.3）。
5. 各阶用交叉熵损失，加权λ_r=1/s求和。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、miniImageNet三个数据集×三种袋构建策略（随机、聚类、α-first）×四种袋大小（16/32/64/128）共36个设置中，LLP-MM平均准确率均排名第一（Rank 1）。在半真实场景KU-Optofil PBC血细胞数据集上，Macro-F1达69.75%，超越LLP-PVC 11.33个百分点。Experiment 4.4显示随阶数s提升性能改善且计算开销可控。

Conclusion: LLP-MM通过将LLP与泊松多项分布关联，为弱监督学习提供了一种统一的矩匹配框架。更高阶矩能收紧解空间并提供丰富监督信号，在多种袋构建策略下均保持鲁棒的高性能与实用计算效率。未来工作包括构建更多真实LLP基准和多类评估指标。代码已在GitHub开源。

Abstract: Learning from label proportions (LLP) is a weakly supervised setting where training data are grouped into bags with only bag-level label proportions observed, and the goal is to learn a classifier that predicts labels for individual instances. Recently, a large body of methods has emerged; however, most of them rely on the assumption that instance-label pairs are sampled i.i.d. and randomly assembled into bags, an assumption often violated in real-world scenarios. Our experimental results indicate that these methods perform suboptimally under non-random settings. In this work, we adopt a more realistic assumption: bags are sampled i.i.d., and instance labels are conditionally independent given the instances. Under this setting, we show that the label counts follow a Poisson multinomial distribution. Motivated by this observation, we propose LLP via moment matching (LLP-MM), a simple yet effective approach which leverages multi-order factorial moments as training objectives, encouraging the classifier predictions to match these moments and thereby more fully exploit the underlying statistical structure of the data. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets under various bag construction strategies demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach while maintaining high computational efficiency. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [229] [Regret Lower Bound for Online Learning of Quantum States with Logarithmic Loss, with Applications to Quantum State Tomography and Confidence Sequences for Matrix Means](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21273)
*Yen-Huan Li,Wei-Fu Tseng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究对数损失下的量子态在线学习（OLQS）问题，建立了遗憾下界，证明 Exponential Weights 和 Q-VB-FTRL 算法在维度依赖上是最优的；并将该方法应用于量子态断层扫描和矩阵均值的置信序列构造。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线投资组合选择的最优算法问题已研究三十多年，其遗憾率 O(d log T) 已知最小极大最优。OLQS 作为量子推广，现有算法（如 Exponential Weights 和 Q-VB-FTRL）的遗憾率带有额外的 d 因子达到 O(d² log T)，但尚不清楚这个额外 d 因子是本质的，还是分析的产物。回答该问题对理解这些算法的意义至关重要，且 OLQS 与量子态断层扫描有直接联系。

Method: 1) 将 OLQS 与量子态断层扫描相联系，通过 online-to-batch 转换将 OLQS 算法的遗憾上界转化为高概率估计误差上界；2) 结合已知的量子态断层扫描样本复杂度下界 Ω(d³/ε²)（Haah 等人、Lowe 和 Nayak），反推出 OLQS 的遗憾下界，证明任何算法无法达到 O(dᵞ log T)（γ<2）的遗憾率；3) 使用对数损失的 1-exp-concave 性质，结合 Mehta（2017）的 online-to-batch 转换方案（通过对密度矩阵做向最大混合态的收缩保证损失有界）实现快速速率 O˜(1/T)；4) 利用 Ville 不等式构造随机矩阵均值的置信序列，采用 Blum-Kalai 风格的 Exponential Weights 遗憾界 log C(T+p, p)。

Result: 1) 证明定理 1.1：当 T ≫ d² log d 时，任何 OLQS 算法都无法达到 O(dᵞ log T)（γ<2）的遗憾率，确认 Exponential Weights 和 Q-VB-FTRL 的 O(d² log T) 遗憾率的多项式维度依赖是最优的；2) 得到样本最优（至多 polylog 因子）的量子态断层扫描算法，估计误差为 O˜(√(d³ log n / n))；3) 提出矩阵均值置信序列构造（推论 4.6），复数情形 p=d²−1，实数情形 p=d²/2+d/2−1；4) 数值实验（d=8, T=200）在协方差矩阵估计上，所构造的置信序列相比 Ryu-Wornell（向量化的 Universal Portfolios）、Howard 等人和 Wang-Ramdas 的方法，相对 Hilbert-Schmidt 体积更小。附注：OLQS 的精确最小极大遗憾率仍开放。

Conclusion: 本文确立了 OLQS 的遗憾下界 Ω(d² log T)（指数部分除外），验证了 Exponential Weights 和 Q-VB-FTRL 在维度多项式依赖上的最优性；给出了基于在线学习的、近似样本最优的量子态断层扫描算法；并将投资组合选择与置信序列的联系推广至矩阵值参数。开放问题包括确定 OLQS 精确最小极大遗憾率、所构造置信序列的最优性，以及对更一般 −log L(x) 损失形式的统一理论。

Abstract: We study the problem of online learning of quantum states with logarithmic loss, which is a quantum generalization of online portfolio selection and has applications to quantum state tomography, the task of estimating an unknown quantum state from measurement outcomes. We first establish a regret lower bound, showing that the regret rates of Exponential Weights and the algorithm of Tseng et al. (2025) have optimal polynomial dependence on the dimension. Our analysis leads to two further results. First, our lower-bound proof leads to a quantum state tomography algorithm that is sample optimal up to polylogarithmic factors in the sample size. Second, we develop an algorithm for constructing confidence sequences for the mean of a matrix-valued random variable. A numerical experiment shows that the latter algorithm is competitive with existing methods.

</details>


### [230] [TimeCap: A Scalable Open-Source Pipeline for Captioning Wearable Health Time-Series Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21274)
*Max Rosenblattl,Milana Gurbanova,Karl Aurel Deck,Narayan Schuetz,Thomas Kaar,Manuel Milling,Nicolas Zumarraga,Ning Wang,Kelly W. Zhang,Anders Johnson,Robert Jakob,Björn W. Schuller,Elgar Fleisch,Daniel Seung Kim,Allan Lawrie,Patrick Langer,Maxwell A. Xu,Euan Ashley,Paul Schmiedmayer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TimeCap 是一个开源、确定性、无需语言模型的可穿戴健康时序数据字幕生成管道，通过四个可组合的提取器层级（统计、结构、语义、跨通道）将多变量时间序列信号转换为可复现的自然语言描述。基于该管道，作者在 OpenMHC（MyHeart Counts）数据集上生成了 MHCap 字幕语料库（19 个 Apple HealthKit 通道、908,944 人日、超过 700 万条字幕），并训练 OpenTSLM-Cap 模型，证明字幕增强训练在 32 项用户级二元评估中的 29 项上优于纯标签基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列语言模型（TSLM）的发展受限于三个核心缺口：（1）数据缺口：现有的大规模可穿戴传感器-文本配对语料库多为闭源或规模/模态不足；（2）方法缺口：依赖大语言模型进行标注的方案无法保证可复现性与信号接地性；（3）可扩展性缺口：现有管道绑定于特定传感器模式，难以迁移到新数据集。论文旨在同时填补这三大缺口。

Method: TimeCap 包含四个模块化提取器层级：(1) 统计层基于每个连续通道计算均值/最大/最小/标准差并通过确定性模板渲染；(2) 结构层使用 scipy.signal.find_peaks 进行峰值检测，并通过多窗口扫描+线性回归拟合检测趋势；(3) 语义层从二元睡眠/锻炼通道提取活动区间；(4) 跨通道层将各通道证据（如心率、步数、距离、能量）合成为多通道叙述（如行走时同步量化心率与步数）。所有超参数在标注前固定，整个管道无需语言模型参与，保证完全确定性。通过通道模式抽象（channel-schema abstraction），仅凭通道定义文件即可迁移到新数据集。

Result: 将 TimeCap 应用于 OpenMHC 生成 MHCap：覆盖 19 个 Apple HealthKit 通道、908,944 人日、2,081 名参与者、共 7,005,763 条字幕（结构层 45.6%、跨通道层 27.7%、统计层 14.3%、语义层 12.4%）。迁移到 WESAD 数据集生成 WESADCap（240 统计 + 1,071 结构 + 75 语义 + 75 跨通道字幕）。训练 OpenTSLM-Cap（基于 Llama-3.2 1B/3B+LoRA）在用户级 AUROC/AUPRC 上，caption 增强版本在 32 项二元评估中 29 项优于纯标签基线；在 3B 规模上，零样本临床任务（如心血管疾病、糖尿病、冠心病、房颤）有清晰改进（F1 提升 2.6–6.1），BMI QWK +4.8，Happiness QWK +5.0。消融实验显示任一独立字幕族即可带来 1.9–3.2 AUROC 提升，但只有全混合族在所有 8 项二元任务上全部优于基线。

Conclusion: TimeCap 通过确定性的、信号接地的字幕生成管道，同时填补了数据、方法与可扩展性三大缺口，是首个可复现、可审计、可扩展至新传感器模式的开源架构。MHCap 作为最大的开源多模态可穿戴字幕语料库，能有效提升 TSLM 在下游健康任务上的性能，尤其显著改善对未见临床条件的零样本泛化能力。该工作使 TSLM 训练数据具备可追溯性与可审计性，降低了健康传感器-语言模型研究的门槛，并可推广至工业、能源等领域的时间序列场景。

Abstract: Time-series data generated continuously across industrial, environmental, and especially health domains produce multimodal signals whose scale and heterogeneity make their processing and interpretation particularly challenging. Time-Series Language Models (TSLMs) promise scalable interpretation of these signals, yet remain bottlenecked by a fundamental lack of text-annotated time series pairs that are signal-grounded, reproducible, and extensible across modalities and schemas. Existing paired corpora are either closed or limited in scale and modality coverage. Annotation with large language models could scale them up, but its outputs cannot be regenerated exactly, which prevents others from re-deriving, extending, or auditing the resulting corpus. To address this, we release TimeCap, an open deterministic captioning pipeline with three reusable extractor tiers and a cross-channel synthesis layer that operates directly on the signal with no language model in the loop, extensible to new schemas by writing channel definitions alone. This positions TimeCap as a reproducible mechanism for future dataset generation rather than a one-off release. Applying TimeCap to OpenMHC, the MyHeart Counts wearable dataset, yields MHCap, the largest open caption layer for multimodal wearable time-series data. MHCap spans 19 Apple HealthKit channels and 7,005,763 captions over 908,944 person-days. To showcase the impact of the corpus, we train OpenTSLM, a time-series language model, on MHCap and benchmark on health-outcome prediction. Caption-augmented training (OpenTSLM-Cap) outperforms a label-only baseline on 29 of 32 per-user binary evaluations across 8 tasks.

</details>


### [231] [Can Capability Enhancement be Localized?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21294)
*Anh Tuan Nguyen,Anna Bair,Zico Kolter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了"能力增强定位"(Capability Enhancement Localization, CEL)问题：是否存在少量注意力头，删除它们能提升模型在特定任务上的性能。作者通过实证研究和理论分析两方面证明这一现象的存在性。实证方面，在三个模型家族(Llama、Qwen、SmolLM3)和四个任务(Arithmetic、BoolQ、HellaSwag、MBPP)上验证了稀疏删除注意力头能提升任务表现。理论方面，构建了一个简化的多头softmax注意力模型，在两个存在特征冲突的任务上进行训练，证明从小的随机初始化开始的梯度下降会将冲突特征集中在特定注意力头中，并在一定条件下删除这些头能改善一个任务的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究表明Transformer中部分注意力头对特定任务至关重要，删除它们会严重损害性能，但很少有研究关注反方向问题：是否存在某些注意力头，删除它们反而能提升任务表现。这一"反直觉"现象在多语言模型、知识冲突、数学推理等场景中被零星观察到，但缺乏系统的实证验证和理论解释。

Method: 方法分两阶段：1) 阶段一对发现集(discovery set)上每个注意力头进行单独消融，筛选出候选头池(论文取top-10)；2) 阶段二从候选池中评估大小不超过3的子集联合消融效果，选出在发现集上表现最佳的子集，并在独立的测试集上验证增益。理论部分构建一个含3个注意力头、3个特征的简化对角softmax注意力模型，定义两个特征冲突的任务，通过小高斯初始化下的全批量梯度下降分析，引入辅助ODE描述参数动态，通过"逃逸时间"竞争证明特征会集中在某个"赢家"头，再证明在冲突特征独立于任务特定特征的头被分配到的情况下，删除该头能改善任务A同时损害任务B。

Result: 实证结果显示，在三个模型和四个任务上都发现了显著的正向消融增益。例如SmolLM3在Arithmetic任务上从70.40%提升至83.50%（+13.10pp，相对错误减少44.26%）。BoolQ、HellaSwag、MBPP任务也观察到一致的正向增益(范围1.29至2.54pp)。理论证明：1) 在小初始化极限下，梯度下降将各特征集中到特定的"赢家"头，其他头的系数保持为O(α⁴)量级；2) 在事件E={冲突特征的头不在其他两个特征的头中}（概率4/9）下，删除该冲突头使任务A风险降低t²而任务B风险增加3t²，即使联合训练达到全局最优。

Conclusion: 本文首次系统提出并验证了CEL现象：通过简单两阶段搜索，可在多个模型和任务上找到稀疏的注意力头集合，删除它们无需微调即可提升任务性能。理论上证明该现象可自然源于训练动力学——当任务存在特征冲突时，梯度下降会将冲突特征局部化到个别头中，删除这些头能在保持联合最优的同时改善单个任务。这为能力局部化研究提供了新方向，但也存在局限：实证搜索不能保证找到最优子集；理论分析依赖于固定特征编码和对角参数化。未来工作可开发更高效的搜索程序，并放宽理论假设以处理学习表示和特征间交互。

Abstract: Transformer-based language models have shown strong capabilities across many tasks and domains. However, prior work shows that, for a given task, not all attention heads matter equally. Specifically, they suggest that many \textit{redundant} heads can be safely removed with little-to-no effect, while a small set of \textit{important} heads, when ablated, severely damages the model's performance on the given task. In this work, we investigate a complementary aspect, called \textit{Capability Enhancement Localization} (CEL): \textit{given a model and a task, does there exist a small set of heads whose removal improves the task performance?} We first investigate this question \textit{empirically} across models from different families. Using a simple two-stage routine that screens candidate heads and evaluates their joint ablations, we identify sparse head combinations whose removal improves task-specific performance without further fine-tuning. Motivated by these observations, we ask \textit{theoretically whether such a phenomenon can naturally arise from training dynamics, and under what conditions}. To this end, we construct a simplified multi-head softmax attention model and two tasks with conflicting features, and show that gradient descent from small random initialization provably concentrates the conflicting features into particular heads. We further show that ablating such heads improves performance on one task while harming the other, even though training converges to a global optimum of the joint objective. This establishes a possible training-induced theoretical explanation for CEL.

</details>


### [232] [Personalized Projected Ascent for Federated Stackelberg Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21295)
*M Yashwanth,Sharannya Ghosh,Saikiran Bulusu,Anirban Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究联邦Stackelberg优化问题，提出个性化共享最小化变量、客户端专属最大化变量的minimax框架。由于联邦DRO和对抗训练中各客户端的内层最大化变量（数据重加权/对抗扰动）在含义和维度上均不同，传统的平均聚合方式不合理。因此，作者采用投影上升法进行个性化更新，并在非凸-凹（NC-C）设定下证明了标准次线性收敛率；针对非凸-PL（NC-PL）设定中出现的与步长无关的噪声平台问题，进一步提出VR-SGDA算法，通过客户端私有快照在双时间尺度机制下实现方差缩减，消除噪声平台并恢复次线性收敛率。实验在子群体鲁棒性和NLP对抗训练上验证了该方法在最差组鲁棒性和双时间尺度跟踪方面的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦鲁棒优化（如DRO和对抗训练）天然是minimax问题，但内层最大化变量与各客户端自身数据相关（样本重加权/输入扰动），维度与可行集各异，无法在服务器端有意义地平均。然而现有联邦minimax方法仍维护单一全局内层变量并聚合，这偏离了真正的"每客户端最坏情况"目标。

Method: 1) 将联邦minimax形式化为共享外层变量x与各客户端专属内层变量y_i的Stackelberg博弈，采用两时间尺度个性化局部SGDA（投影上升）。2) NC-C设定下利用Moreau包络作为非光滑非凸的stationarity度量，推导标准次线性收敛率。3) NC-PL设定下面向梯度映射PL条件，识别出与步长无关的噪声平台O(σ_y²/μ²)源于内层随机更新的方差无法被服务器聚合消除。4) 提出Personalized VR-SGDA：每客户端在同步边界保存(x_bar, y_bar_i)快照，使用同一随机样本ξ^t计算当前与快照梯度之差作为控制变量，将常值方差替换为随两时间尺度衰减的drift项。5) 通过KKT条件推导DRO中χ²-受约束单纯形的投影可通过阈值化收缩参数的一维搜索高效求解。

Result: 理论结果：(a) NC-C设定：个性化投影SGDA达到8Δ_φ/(η_x T) + 4ε²的Moreau包络收敛速率，复杂度O(1/ε⁸)梯度计算与O(1/ε⁴)通信轮次，前导阶与集中式两时间尺度结果一致。(b) NC-PL：vanilla SGDA出现恒定噪声平台O(L²σ_y²/μ²)；VR-SGDA在η_y=Θ(1/√T)、η_x=Θ(μ²η_y/L²)、τ=T^{1/4}下达到O(1/√T)渐近收敛率，消除噪声平台，需T=O(1/ε⁴)梯度计算与K=O(1/ε³)通信轮次。实验：在Banking-77（10客户端Dirichlet α=0.1分区）上，最差客户端准确率从ERM和共享方法的34.09%提升至38.18%；在Colored MNIST（10客户端Dirichlet α=2.0分区）上，最差组准确率从ERM的0.19%和共享DRO的52.23%大幅提升至72.37%；合成NC-PL实验验证VR-SGDA将||∇Φ||²降低约两个数量级。

Conclusion: 个性化是联邦Stackelberg优化的结构性必然，而非算法偏好选择。将最大化变量保持在客户端本地（仅通信共享模型x）使问题自动分解为n个独立的跟随者子问题，消除了现有分析中所需的共识误差控制，使得集中式两时间尺度的收敛保证可直接迁移（在NC-C设定下无需快照机制）。在更具挑战性的NC-PL设定中，个性化造成的内层随机噪声无法通过聚合抵消，形成内在的步长不变噪声平台；通过基于客户端私有快照的SVRG式方差缩减，可在两时间尺度机制下将常数方差替换为衰减漂移，从而在不损害个性化与投影性质的前提下恢复最优收敛阶。该工作也揭示了部分客户端参与场景中陈旧内层变量与漂移全局模型之间的耦合仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Federated minimax problems, such as distributionally robust optimization and adversarial training, include an inner maximization variable built from each client's local data. These variables differ in meaning and dimension from one client to the next, so averaging them across clients, as standard federated minimax methods do, is ill-posed. We therefore study a federated minimax problem where the minimization variable $\mathbf{x}$ is shared and aggregated, while each client retains the maximization variable $\mathbf{y}_i$ (personalized). Because these applications constrain $\mathbf{y}_i$ to a compact convex set, we analyze projected ascent directly. We show that, in the nonconvex-concave regime, this projected personalized scheme attains the standard sublinear rate. In the nonconvex-PL regime, however, it hits a stepsize-invariant noise floor due to stochastic $\mathbf{y}_i$ updates. To mitigate this, we propose VR-SGDA, incorporating a variance-reduced ascent step where each client maintains a private variable snapshot. By evaluating current and snapshot gradients on the same sample, the constant variance is replaced by a vanishing drift under a two-timescale regime. VR-SGDA eliminates the noise floor, attaining sublinear leading rates while preserving personalization and projection. Experiments on subpopulation-robustness and NLP adversarial training confirm both the worst-group robustness benefits and the two-timescale tracking mechanism.

</details>


### [233] [PocketTSLM: Deploying an On-Device Soft-Prompt Time-Series Language Model for Privacy-Preserving Smartphone Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21308)
*Max Rosenblattl,Nikhil Krishnaswamy,Leon Nissen,Manuel Milling,Nicolas Zumarraga,Ning Wang,Thomas Kaar,Robert Jakob,Björn W. Schuller,Elgar Fleisch,Patrick Langer,Paul Schmiedmayer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PocketTSLM 是 OpenTSLM-SoftPrompt 在 iPhone 上的端侧部署，通过 MLX-Swift 运行软提示式生理时序语言模型（TSLM），实现在智能手机本地完成 EEG 睡眠分期与 12 导联 ECG 推理，全程不向云端传输健康数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云端 TSLM 推理会将敏感生理数据传出设备，带来隐私、延迟与按次计费风险；而将时序数据序列化为文本送入移动端小模型会压缩时序结构或耗尽上下文/内存预算。论文旨在验证软提示（表征级融合）路径能否在消费级手机上完整运行，并在同一骨干上量化其相对文本序列化的 token、延迟与内存代价。

Method: 将 OpenTSLM-SP 自 PyTorch 通过 Python MLX 中转后迁移至 Swift MLX，保留 CNN-Transformer 编码器 + MLP 投影器 + 冻结 Llama-3.2-1B（bf16）+ LoRA（ECG/EEG 各一）的架构。核心做法是将时序编码器输出作为连续软提示向量直接注入 LLM 的嵌入序列，而非作为词表 token；同时低层重构 MLX-Swift 的 Llama 前向以接受预计算嵌入。设计了一个数值等价性协议（贪心解码下 Swift 与 Python MLX/PyTorch 参考逐 token 比对）和一个设备端上下文经济学基准（同一骨干上对比软提示与 LLMTime 风格的文本序列化），并以 Sleep-EDF 单通道 EEG 与 ECG-QA 12 导联 ECG 为固定评测样本。

Result: 软提示相比文本序列化在评测格式下时间序列 token 数少约 12×（每 4 个采样 1 个软提示 token vs. 每个采样 3 个 BPE token）。在前 20 个 Sleep-EDF CoT 样本上 PyTorch 参考、Python MLX 与 iPhone 三者均 17/20 相同且错例一致（85%）。单通道 EEG 在 L=1000 时软提示 TTFT 2.4s vs. 文本 14.8s；12 导联 ECG 在 L=1000（10 s）下软提示可运行（≤11.6s TTFT，≤4.2 GiB），而文本序列化在 L≥250 即触发不可捕获的 OS 内存终止。超过 4,300 token 预算时文本路径会预算超限，软提示路径在整个测量区间内均可完成。

Conclusion: PocketTSLM 证实软提示生理 TSLM 可在消费级智能手机上端侧运行，相对文本序列化在 token、预填充成本与可处理窗口长度上具备显著优势，支持更长生理时间序列进入设备端上下文。但论文明确将其定位为实现与部署贡献而非临床验证；下一步需要在真实可穿戴数据上做前瞻性研究，并建立安全、监控与合规流程，交叉注意力融合路径及其他骨干/设备的扩展仍待后续工作。

Abstract: Consumer phones and wearables increasingly collect physiological time-series data, yet most mobile systems treat these streams as summaries or text rather than as temporal evidence. This representation is poorly matched to personal health systems that need to retrieve, route, or summarize sensor evidence while preserving temporal structure. Cloud-hosted time-series language models avoid smartphone limits, but they repeatedly move sensitive physiology off the device and add latency and per-query compute cost. Mobile model alternatives that aggregate time-series data into statistical features or serialize raw samples as text either compress temporal structure or exhaust the context and memory budgets of small on-device models. We present PocketTSLM, a mobile-native deployment of OpenTSLM SoftPrompt, the soft-prompt variant of the OpenTSLM time-series language model. PocketTSLM runs fully on a consumer smartphone by injecting encoded time-series windows as embeddings instead of tokenizing time series as text. A numerical parity protocol verifies identical greedy-decoded token sequences between the Swift port and a Python reference using Apple's MLX machine-learning framework. Answers also match the PyTorch reference, although rationale wording can differ. An on-device context-economics benchmark compares the soft-prompt path with a text-serialized baseline on the same backbone. In our benchmark format, soft-prompting uses approximately 12 times fewer time-series tokens and reduces prompt-prefill cost. PocketTSLM processes 30-second Sleep-EDF electroencephalography clips for sleep staging and a 1,000-sample (10 s) 12-lead electrocardiogram clip from ECG-QA. In comparison, text-serialized baselines exceed the phone's context or memory budget at longer time-series windows. All inference runs entirely on the device, with no health data transmitted during inference.

</details>


### [234] [Spectrum Is Not Enough: A Random-Matrix Account of Data-Free Preconditioning for Differentially Private Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21312)
*Shilin Zhang,Kangning Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用随机矩阵理论重新审视数据无关（data-free）的KFAC预条件器（如DP-KFC）：证明其误差信号因子G和数据无关，且激活因子A的"bulk"部分可被无数据重建，但"spike"部分不可；进而提出基底（basis）比谱形（spectrum）更关键，并发现在DP噪声下会出现序反转的交叉点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DP-KFC等方法用合成探针（synthetic probes）代替私有数据估计KFAC的Kronecker因子，并以"匹配私有因子的特征值衰减"作为探针有效性的判据。但该判据为何成立、何时失效并不清楚。作者希望用随机矩阵理论给出可证、可证伪的失败边界与机制性修正。

Method: 理论：将私有激活协方差建模为"bulk + spike"的spiked covariance模型（BBP相变），给出G因子的算子范数上界（Proposition IV.1）和探针残余损伤的闭式Whitened-Volume Law（Proposition VI.3）。实证：在8个数据集配置、5种模态、2种架构上做20个实验族对比：固定谱形仅旋转特征基底（Haar随机 vs Fourier对齐），在不同噪声倍率σ与学习率下扫描下游精度。

Result: 1) G因子在72个source–layer–epoch配置上零违反；2) 一个近完美匹配谱（log-ratio dispersion 0.02）的探针，在Haar随机基底下残余仍膨胀2–90×；证明基底错配才是真正决定因素；3) 当spike强度超过BBP阈值s_c ≈ 0.55（d/n=0.191），bulk-only探针的损伤精确为s²/(1−s²)；4) 下游：每层调参不转化为精度提升；5) DP机制存在σ ≈ 0.3处的cross-over，σ之上扁平白噪声探针反超匹配探针。

Conclusion: 数据无关预条件成功的本质不是谱形匹配，而是Fourier对齐基底与bulk陡度匹配；数据诱导的spike才是真正的不可重建对象，应留给per-sample clipping处理；噪声足够大时几何不再是瓶颈，可学习性才是。

Abstract: Data-free preconditioning builds the Kronecker factors of KFAC from synthetic probes instead of private data. DP-KFC validates a probe by matching the eigenvalue decay of the private factors; we turn this criterion into a random-matrix account of what a probe can reconstruct. A single dichotomy organizes it: in the factorization $ A \otimes G $, the error-signal factor $ G $ and the architecture-determined bulk of the activation factor $ A $ are reconstructible without data, while only the data-induced spikes of $ A $ are not. We prove the $ G $ half is data-insensitive up to an explicit error-energy bound, with zero violations over a full training trajectory across four modalities and a natural-image benchmark. We locate the failure boundary at a Baik-Ben Arous-Péché threshold: a bulk-only probe suffers an exact damage $s^2/(1-s^2)$ from a data-induced spike, which becomes invisible once it exceeds $(d/n)^{1/4}$, confirmed on an injected-spike surrogate. Holding the probe spectrum fixed and varying only its eigenbasis, we show that spectral-shape matching is neither sufficient nor the operative object: a probe with a near-exact matched spectrum (log-ratio dispersion $0.02$) still inflates the residual $2 \times $-$90 \times $ when its eigenvectors are random. A closed-form whitened-volume law explains this and predicts the within-spectrum ordering of the critical volume, though not its cross-dataset magnitude. Downstream, per-layer tuning does not transfer to accuracy and the headroom is a small oracle-minus-white gap. Under a privacy mechanism the source ordering survives while learning does, then inverts at a noise cross-over where the flat probe overtakes the matched ones.

</details>


### [235] [Ranking and Partitioning of Attention Heads for Sparse and Continual Reinforcement Learning Fine-tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21336)
*Ruizhe Shi,Zaiwen Yang,Qiubo Wang,Banghua Zhu,Maryam Fazel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于梯度范数的注意力头排序和分区方法，用于稀疏和持续学习的强化学习微调，在数学、指令跟随和编码任务上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL微调语言模型成本高昂，因其需更新大量参数。现有研究表明，仅更新部分注意力头即可实现有效适应，这启发了稀疏RL微调的研究。此外，持续学习中顺序任务更新易导致灾难性遗忘，参数隔离是一种有前景的解决方案。因此，需要一种准则来识别最有效的注意力头进行更新，并设计策略来减少跨任务干扰。

Method: 1. 稀疏学习：使用梯度范数对注意力头进行排序，选择顶部梯度范数最大的头进行微调。
2. 持续学习：将注意力头按任务进行分区，例如"Top-Bottom"、"Round-Robin"或"Shared"策略，为不同任务分配不相交的头子集。
3. 理论分析：基于梯度流和Adam优化器视角，论证梯度范数与训练效率的关系，并分析多头自注意力的二阶结构，解释注意力头作为稀疏更新单元的优势。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B和Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3模型上，针对数学、指令跟随和编码任务的实验表明：
- 顶部50%梯度范数头的微调持续优于底部50%和随机50%基线，且常匹配甚至超过全注意力/全参数微调的性能。
- 持续学习中，头分区策略有效减少了对先前任务的遗忘，同时保持对新任务的适应能力。
- 头重置实验表明，分区头之间存在近似的功能隔离。

Conclusion: 梯度范数是识别有效注意力头进行稀疏RL微调的实用准则。头分区策略能有效缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。理论分析解释了为何基于注意力头的稀疏更新能保持稳定且高效。局限：实验限于相对较小的语言模型和特定任务，且理论分析限于单层多头自注意力。

Abstract: We study sparse and continual reinforcement learning fine-tuning of language models through attention-head ranking and partitioning. For sparse learning, we rank attention heads by gradient norm to identify a small subset of heads that can be trained effectively. For continual learning, we partition heads across tasks to reduce cross-task interference and preserve previously learned capabilities. Theoretically, we relate gradient norm to training effectiveness, and further characterize why sparse, separated head updates can remain stable. Empirically, across math, instruction-following, and coding tasks, tuning higher-ranked heads consistently outperforms tuning lower-ranked ones while often matching denser baselines, and head partitioning improves retention while preserving adaptation to new tasks.

</details>


### [236] [Online Quantile Omniprediction for Proper Losses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21342)
*Hyunsuk Kim,Isaac Gibbs,Michael W. Mahoney,Ryan J. Tibshirani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了在线分位数全预测（Online Quantile Omniprediction）算法，通过分位数网格预测的方式，在连续型目标变量上同时针对所有满足正则性条件的适当损失（proper losses）实现样本高效的优化，误差率为 Õ(√(log(mNB)/T))，并在COVID-19住院预测任务中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的全预测（omniprediction）研究主要集中在二分类任务上，对多分类和连续型目标的扩展存在收敛速率慢的问题。连续型目标下的全预测在实际应用中（如天气预报、流行病预测）具有重要意义，但缺乏高效且通用的算法框架。本文旨在填补这一空白，为连续型目标构造一个对所有适当损失同时表现良好的预测器。

Method: 本文基于适当分位数损失的结构化分解定理（Saerens、Thomson、Gneiting、Ehm、Gneiting、Jordan、Krzysztof等人发展的理论），将任意适当损失分解为基本损失（elementary loss）的混合。具体方法包括：(1) 离散化技巧将无穷损失类简化为有限基本损失集合（Lemma 1）；(2) 利用LNPR的多目标学习框架，构建两玩家博弈算法——一方使用Hedge算法学习权重，另一方求解极小极大程序构造（随机化）分位数预测；(3) 算法1给出了完整的在线算法，其每步可在O(mNB)时间内实现，并能保证分位数预测的单调性（无交叉）；(4) 在COVID-19住院预测数据上进行实证验证，使用18个专家组的分位数预测作为基预测器，与COVIDhub-Ens、JHUAPL-SLPEns等集成方法比较。

Result: 理论上，算法1在T个时间步内对所有有界适当分位数损失的全预测误差上界为2(c+1/c)√(log(mNB)/T)，与单一损失的在线学习速率Õ(√(1/T))在对数因子内匹配。在COVID-19住院预测实验中（51个州级序列加US-aggregate，共208个时间序列，4个预测周期，23个分位数水平，127周数据，18个专家组），该算法在所有时间周期上均优于COVIDhub-Ens和JHUAPL-SLPEns集成方法，特别是在较长的预测周期（3-4周）上优势更显著；相比Hedge-QL基线，在分位数损失上有明显改进，尤其在困难预测实例上。该算法具有较低的学习率敏感性，并能保证预测的分位数不交叉。

Conclusion: 本文为连续型目标的适当损失全预测问题提供了首个计算高效且样本高效的算法，在COVID-19住院预测的实际应用中得到验证。局限性在于：(1) 仅适用于有界适当损失，不涵盖对数损失等需要密度估计的无界损失；(2) 分位数表示可能不足以评估基于密度的适当损失；(3) 未来研究方向包括探索替代的聚合准则和确定可处理的全预测问题的完整范围。

Abstract: The task of constructing a predictor that is simultaneously accurate under multiple evaluation metrics has been popularized recently under the name omniprediction. Prior work in this area has largely focused on binary prediction tasks, and existing results for multiclass and continuous outcomes typically suffer from slow error rates. In this paper, we consider forecasts expressed as a set of quantiles over a discrete but otherwise arbitrary set of probability levels. We develop sample-efficient algorithms for constructing forecasts that are accurate simultaneously across all proper losses that satisfy mild regularity conditions, where proper losses are those minimized by predicting the true quantiles. Our algorithms are online and can operate in a dynamic environment, while simultaneously taking multiple losses into account, and their forecasts offer the potential to provide diverse end-users with rich information for evaluating risk and informing a range of practical decision-making tasks. As an example, we demonstrate how our procedure can be used to ensemble quantile forecasts of COVID-19 hospitalizations made by experts during the pandemic.

</details>


### [237] [Honesty is the Best Policy ... or is it? Demand Management for Probabilistic Service Options](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21351)
*Daniela Sailer,Robert Klein,Claudius Steinhardt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究服务行业中动态披露概率服务选项的内生概率优化与操纵问题，将其建模为序贯决策过程，提出透明度约束限制概率失真，并开发基于强化学习的近似算法和基于采样的混合整数规划来优化信息显示。通过到自提柜投递（OOHD）的案例研究，揭示了个体透明度与总体客户效用之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 服务行业因客户参与价值创造过程而具有固有的容量不确定性。提供商若在预订时做出严格可行性承诺会导致保守决策，造成收入损失与产能闲置；但依赖事后干预（如过预订、改道、服务降级）又将风险转嫁给客户，引发不满。提供商可在预订时向客户展示预测服务水平的概率，但客户难以验证其准确性。现有概率产品研究将概率视为外生静态设计选择，而本文场景中"真实概率"是内生于系统状态的动态变量，并受策略反馈影响。由于客户无法轻易核实披露的概率，提供商有动机操纵显示概率来引导客户选择，由此产生一种新的需求管理杠杆，引发对透明度约束与监管的需求。

Method: 1. **建模框架**：将问题形式化为无限期序贯决策过程（基于Powell 2022的框架），引入"后选择状态"将状态转移分解为两步，提出递归方程定义真实分配概率 ψ_o^π(S_k^c)；引入水平 τ ∈ [0,1] 的透明度约束限制显示概率与真实概率的偏差。2. **理论性质**：建立单调性性质Π(τ₁)⊆Π(τ₂)；证明在非预期性分配方案下，全透明度（τ=0）有唯一可行解（性质2）。3. **近似方法**：开发基于蒙特卡洛更新的强化学习算法训练神经网络 ψ̂_θ 近似真实概率（采用二元交叉熵损失，回放记忆，基于lookahead的基线特征）。4. **显示概率优化**：构建基于场景采样的混合整数规划（MIP），结合深度价值函数近似（期望效用EU或前瞻模型LA）求解。5. **到自提柜投递（OOHD）案例**：将包裹柜视为高级结果、包裹店视为基础结果，比较不同分配方案（先到先得FF、基于遗憾的优先级MY）与透明度水平。

Result: 1. **解的质量**：在基准设置中，全透明度（τ=0）使客户满意度相对无信息（NO）提升12.8%（FF）和7.5%（MY）；去除透明度约束后（τ=1），LA方法额外带来显著提升。2. **概率失真**：操纵主要通过低估获得高级结果的概率实现（FF中平均-29.2pp，MY中-15.7pp），正向失真较少且较弱。3. **需求再分配**：FF+LA(τ=1)将22%的非首选储物柜客户引导至其他选项，而NO下为0%。4. **客户遗憾权衡**：移除透明度约束使12.2%（FF）/8.9%（MY）的客户蒙受效用损失，7.2%/7.6%获得效用收益——少数人获大利，多数人受小损。5. **长期可信度**：完全自由操纵时，显示概率暗示的重定向率系统性高于经验重定向率，削弱信息可信度。6. **参数分析**：储物柜效用溢价越大（β_L=4）、网络越密集（I=25），信息提供与需求管理的价值越高；适度的透明度放宽（τ≤0.35）即可带来大部分增益，边际收益递减。

Conclusion: 本文引入概率服务选项概念，将动态内生概率的概率产品研究从战略视角拓展到运营视角，并提出透明度约束来限制操纵程度。基于强化学习的真实概率近似算法与基于采样的MIP在计算上适用于实时决策。OOHD案例研究表明，动态信息披露能显著提升聚合客户满意度，适度放宽透明度可额外带来实质性收益，但需与系统性客户效用损失分配不均及长期可信度侵蚀之间进行权衡。本文为衡量操纵激励及设计干预机制提供了方法论支撑。未来研究方向包括：(1) 预期性分配机制与显示-分配联合优化；(2) 客户对概率准确性的动态学习与信念更新。

Abstract: To enable well-informed customer choices and redistribute demand across service options, providers can display probabilities regarding predicted service levels at the time of booking, effectively offering probabilistic service options. In many service settings, the underlying truthful probabilities endogenously depend on the system state, rather than being static product attributes controlled by the provider. While customers rely on this information when making decisions, they cannot readily verify its accuracy. Consequently, providers may be tempted to manipulate the displayed probabilities to guide customers' choices in their favor, creating a novel lever for demand management. In this work, we model the resulting problem as a sequential decision process, define truthful probabilities recursively, and introduce transparency constraints that limit their distortion. Because the exact computation of truthful probabilities is intractable for realistic settings, we develop an adapted reinforcement learning algorithm to approximate them. Furthermore, we propose a sampling-based mixed-integer program to optimize the information communicated by the provider in each state. Our framework enables providers to gauge the benefits of dynamically disclosing probabilistic information at the time of booking and sheds light on incentives for manipulation. Our computational study is motivated by out-of-home delivery, i.e., the delivery to parcel lockers or shops, and reveals a trade-off between individual-level transparency and aggregate customer utilities.

</details>


### [238] [Same Target, Different Origins: Aligning Latent Rollout for Consistent PDE Emulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21370)
*Xinying Li,Jing Xu,Wenjun Wang,Limei Han,Fenglei Cao,Ruoxi Jiang,Yuan Qi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Align Latent Rollout (ALR)，一种用于自回归神经PDE求解器的隐空间正则化方法。该方法通过在共享目标时间对齐来自不同回滚起点的隐状态及其局部演化响应，来缓解自回归预测中的误差累积问题。基于二阶泰勒分析，ALR设计了两个互补目标：零阶隐状态一致性和一阶隐动力学一致性。实验在多个PDE基准上验证了ALR对多种神经算子骨架的有效性，显著提高了预测精度并减少了跨起点的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经PDE求解器在自回归回滚过程中，近似误差会随回滚深度传播和累积，导致同一目标时间从不同时间起点出发的预测结果产生依赖起点的差异。对于良态的确定性PDE流，沿同一物理轨迹在不同时间的状态应在精确演化下到达相同的目标状态，但现有方法并未显式约束不同回滚起点在求解器内部表示空间中的一致性。本文从跨起点一致性视角研究自回归误差累积问题。

Method: 1. 形式化跨起点一致性原则：将神经算子分解为编码器E_θ和解码器D_θ，选取中间层表示作为隐状态。2. 对诱导的隐演化映射G_θ=E_θ∘D_θ进行二阶泰勒展开，分析跨起点隐差异Δz_t的传播，推导出差异传播由两项主导：通过局部雅可比的线性传播项和雅可比变化的修正项。3. 提出两个正则化目标：零阶隐状态一致性L_state = ||z_{t1→t} - z_{t2→t}||_F²，以及一阶隐动力学一致性L_dynamic，通过随机雅可比-向量积（JVP）估计L_dynamic^full。4. 总损失L_total = L_pred + λ_state·L_state + λ_dynamic·L_dynamic。

Result: 在Navier-Stokes (ν=10⁻⁴, ν=10⁻⁵)、浅水方程和Kolmogorov流四个时空PDE基准上，FNO+ALR相比FNO基线分别实现29.25%、14.54%、28.95%和31.77%的相对L2误差降低。消融实验表明L_dynamic贡献大于L_state，两者组合效果最佳。在F-FNO和LSM骨架上也获得一致提升，验证了方法对不同架构的通用性。在浅水方程上，60步回滚时ALR仅将误差从20步放大3.1倍，而FNO放大13.6倍，显著改善长程回滚稳定性。ALR仅增加训练开销，不改变推理计算量。

Conclusion: ALR作为一种骨架无关的正则化框架，通过在隐空间对齐共享目标表示及其局部演化，有效缓解了神经PDE求解器中的自回归误差累积。该方法不修改主千网络架构，可灵活集成到不同的神经算子中，在多个PDE基准和骨架上实现精度提升和跨起点差异减少，并在长程自回归回滚中展现出更强的稳定性。

Abstract: Neural PDE solvers commonly generate multi-step predictions through autoregressive rollout, recursively applying a learned evolution operator and feeding each prediction back as input for the next step. Approximation errors can therefore propagate through the rollout, causing predictions at a shared target time to depend on their temporal origins and rollout depths. For a well-posed deterministic PDE flow, however, states at different times along the same physical trajectory should, under exact evolution, reach the same target state. To this end, we propose Align Latent Rollout (ALR), a regularization approach that promotes consistency across rollout origins through the neural PDE solver's internal representations. A second-order Taylor analysis of latent discrepancy propagation motivates two objectives: zeroth-order latent state consistency, which aligns representations at a shared target time, and first-order latent dynamics consistency, which aligns local evolution responses to shared perturbations. ALR can be integrated into different neural PDE solvers by regularizing suitable internal representations, without modifying their backbone architectures. Experiments across multiple PDE benchmarks and neural-operator backbones show that ALR improves prediction accuracy while reducing shared-target discrepancies across rollout origins.

</details>


### [239] [Does Compression Imply Generalization? A Minimum Description Length Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21376)
*Lincen Yang,Jiayang Shi,Nan Pu,Daniël M. Pelt,Matthijs van Leeuwen,Zhong Li,Shujian Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从最小描述长度（MDL）视角研究过参数化神经网络的泛化问题，提出可仅从训练轨迹计算的"预序遗憾"（prequential regret）作为模型复杂度的可操作度量，并证明其在（近）插值机制下上界算法诱导分布下的参数描述长度，进而在 PAC-MDL 框架下给出高概率泛化界，同时将 MDL 与算法级信息瓶颈（IB）在参数压缩层面统一起来。经验上在 CIFAR-10/100 上与泛化误差的 Pearson 相关性超过 0.9。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代过参数化神经网络为何能泛化是核心问题。已有的压缩视角（PAC-Bayes、互信息 I(S;W)、信息瓶颈 IB）存在概念不一致、依赖保留数据或难以估计的（超）高维互信息等缺陷。作者希望找到一种可从训练轨迹单独计算、与具体训练算法紧密结合的压缩信号，并将 MDL 与 IB 两套压缩概念在参数层面统一。

Method: 方法核心是提出"预序遗憾" L_preq − L̂（prequential code 长度与最终模型 hindsight code 长度之差）。在（近）插值机制下（满足插值-通用性条件 Q_θ(Y^m|X^m) ≥ T(Y^m|X^m,θ)），证明：(1) 期望预序遗憾上界 H_T(θ|X^m) − H_T(θ|X^m,Y^m) + KL(P||Q_preq)，即算法诱导分布下参数的条件自信息加 bits-back 修正（确定性算法时退化为 H_T(θ|X^m)）；(2) 通过构造分区不变先验 P(π,θ)=T(θ|X^m_π)/C(m+n,m) 与 Markov 不等式，在 Blier-Langford PAC-MDL 框架下推导高概率泛化界（确定性算法）；(3) 对于随机算法，借助 PAC-Bayes 框架（Bébegin et al.）处理 bits-back 项，得到 KL 型泛化界，控制 Gibbs 误差；(4) 同时给出 I(X^m;Z^m) 的分解，证明近期对算法级 IB 的"编码器复杂度修正项" I(X^m;φ_l) 被 MDL 参数描述长度 H(θ) ≤ E[L(θ)] 上界，统一 MDL 与 IB。实验在 CIFAR-10（540 个 ResNet 配置）和 CIFAR-100（99 个配置，几何增长分块 K≤40）上计算 R/m 报告 Pearson/Spearman/Kendall 相关性。

Result: 主要理论成果：(a) 在（近）插值机制下建立 E[L_preq−L̂] ≥ H_T(θ|X^m)（确定性）或 ≥ I_T(θ;Y^m|X^m)（随机），将预序遗憾与算法诱导参数分布的描述长度挂钩；(b) 确定性算法的 PAC-MDL 泛化界为 n ê(θ,S') ≤ b_max(n, ê(θ,S), δ/(2C(m+n,m)) · 2^(−2E[R]/δ))，随机算法在 PAC-Bayes 下得到 kl 上界；(c) 算法级 IB 编码器修正项 I(X^m;φ_l) ≤ H(θ) ≤ E[L(θ)]。实验：CIFAR-10 上 R/m 与泛化差距的 Pearson 相关系数达 0.92（loss）/0.92（error），显著优于参数级 IB 基线 (S;θ^{S}_{D+1}) 的 0.25/0.08，亦优于多层 IB 表示基线；CIFAR-100 99 配置上同样表现出强相关性，少数训练精度低于 0.25 的欠拟合配置落在负遗憾区，与插值-通用性条件失效一致。

Conclusion: 预序遗憾是一种仅依赖训练轨迹、无需保留数据或高维互信息估计的模型复杂度信号，并且与过参数化神经网络的实际泛化差距高度相关（Pearson>0.9）。该结果从 MDL 视角为"压缩蕴含泛化"提供了可操作且紧致的证据，并通过描述长度上界将 MDL 的参数压缩与算法级 IB 的表示压缩统一起来。局限：泛化界仅在转导式（transductive）PAC-MDL 设置下成立，扩展到总体风险形式仍为开放问题；插值-通用性条件在严重欠拟合或强记忆化下失效；实验限于 ResNet/CIFAR，尚未覆盖 Transformer/语言/多模态等更广泛近插值机制。

Abstract: A central question in modern learning theory is what notion of compression, if any, explains why over-parameterized neural networks generalize. Existing answers measure complexity at different levels, ranging from weights to representations; however, estimating the associated quantities either requires held-out data in principle or relies on the challenging (ultra) high-dimensional mutual information estimation. To overcome these challenges, we approach the question through the minimum description length (MDL) principle, and specifically, we propose the prequential regret as a complementary signal that is computable from the training trajectory alone. We establish that, in the (nearly) interpolating regime, the expected prequential regret upper-bounds the description length of the trained parameter under the algorithm-induced distribution, and that this description length translates into a high-probability generalization bound in the PAC-MDL setting. Along the way, we show that the encoder-complexity correction recently added to the algorithm-level information bottleneck (IB) is upper-bounded by an MDL parameter description length, \new{bringing together} the two views of compression from MDL and IB. Empirically, the prequential regret tracks the generalization error on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, with Pearson correlations exceeding 0.9.

</details>


### [240] [RDL-Bench: A Benchmark for Task-Aware Question Answering over Relational Databases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21382)
*Yao Cheng,Siqiang Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RDL-Bench是一个面向真实多表关系数据库的任务感知问答基准，覆盖当前状态推理和未来导向预测两类问题，统一于自然语言接口，涵盖七个领域共4040个验证实例，支持原生求解器和任务感知模块化系统两种评估设置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准（如text-to-SQL和RelBench）孤立评估SQL式查找或关系预测，无法反映真实用户场景中系统需识别问题能力并路由至合适执行机制的需求。论文旨在构建一个统一的NL接口基准，将当前状态推理与未来预测整合，并量化路由错误对系统级性能的影响。

Method: 方法包括：（1）基于七个真实多表RDB构建统一实例架构，包含NL问题、任务元数据、模式信息、可执行证据或目标构造逻辑、时间上下文和denotation级真值；（2）采用Claude Sonnet 4.6辅助生成结合人工核验的质量控制流程；（3）引入t_ref因果边界防止时间泄漏；（4）评估三类基线（LLM推理、Text-to-SQL、表格/图RDL模型）及任务感知模块化系统（路由器+模块），对比LLM路由器与Oracle路由器以分离路由错误与执行错误。

Result: 关键实验发现：（1）最佳原生推理宏平均仅0.49，94.7%输出可执行SQL但仅52.1%返回精确真值，模式对齐、关系组合和答案规范化仍为瓶颈；（2）上下文增强（2-hop）无一致提升；（3）LLM在布尔预测上具竞争力（Claude-GraphCtx 0.74）但在标量回归上不稳定（Llama8B在Airline达nMAE 50.04），布尔格式掩盖真实关系理解；（4）强LLM路由器表现接近Oracle（Claude 0.97），但Llama8B路由器Track Accuracy仅0.29（低于随机0.49），尽管Table-F1达0.78，表明模式链接与能力识别是分离技能；（5）端到端Llama8B-Router推理得分降至0.03。

Conclusion: RDL-Bench将推理与预测整合于统一NL工作负载，揭示关系推理在denotation对齐层面远未饱和，LLM预测竞争力受任务格式驱动且在标量回归上失效，任务感知路由存在能力阈值（大模型可靠，小模型系统性偏差使端到端性能低于随机）。未来方向包括联合解决模式接地、多跳组合与答案形式控制的方法、超越二分类的预测QA、轻量级路由器以及多轮关系QA。

Abstract: Relational databases (RDBs) remain the primary infrastructure for storing and managing structured data across enterprise and scientific domains. Natural-language (NL) interfaces to RDBs aim to let users ask questions without writing SQL, but real user needs go beyond SQL-style lookup: some questions require reasoning over the observable database state, while others require predictive inference from historical relational records under temporal constraints. Existing benchmarks address these goals in isolation. To address this gap, we introduce RDL-Bench, a benchmark for task-aware question answering (QA) over real RDBs. RDL-Bench organizes diverse user questions into reasoning-oriented questions, whose answers are determined by the current database state, and prediction-oriented questions, whose answers depend on future outcomes under temporal constraints. Each instance contains an NL question, task metadata, schema information, temporal context, either executable evidence or target-construction logic, and denotation-level ground truth. RDL-Bench supports two evaluation settings: native solvers under their intended capabilities, and task-aware modular systems where a router dispatches each question to an appropriate execution module.

</details>


### [241] [Fault Detection and Bit-Error Rate Diagnostics in Optical Wireless Links Using Edge-AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21402)
*Sarthak Bhattarai,Sheshadri Shikhar Bandyopadhyay,Suprabh Dhakal,Jitendra Kumar Manandhar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于ESP32-S3微控制器和TinyML的光无线通信自诊断接收节点，通过片上提取物理层遥测特征（BER、V_signal、SNR_dB、L_ambient）并集成INT8量化神经网络，实现本地实时故障分类，消除了云端诊断延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统光无线通信（OWC）的信道诊断依赖外部计算节点或云端处理，存在严重诊断延迟并降低边缘节点自主性，亟需一种能够在资源受限的微控制器上自主完成物理层故障分类的边缘智能方案。

Method: 系统由650nm激光发射端、自由空间光信道和ESP32-S3接收端组成。接收端采用BPW34光电二极管+LM358跨阻放大器进行信号调理，采用1000 bit/s OOK-NRZ调制，使用5采样多数投票机制恢复比特，并实时提取四维特征向量[V_signal, BER, SNR_dB, L_ambient]。训练了随机森林基线模型和FP32全连接神经网络（4-隐层-4），经TensorFlow Lite后训练INT8量化后生成3.32 kB的TFLite Micro模型，部署于ESP32-S3固件中。数据集包含395个样本，覆盖四类工况：正常传输、光学滤波衰减、高环境光干扰、严重遮挡/对准偏差。

Result: 随机森林基线准确率77.22%，FP32神经网络78.48%，量化INT8模型在测试集上达74.68%整体准确率，SRAM占用仅3.32 kB（相比FP32缩减约76%）。100个实时执行周期验证显示正常类V_signal=0.231±0.008 V、SNR_dB=+14.8±0.4 dB、BER≤0.01；高环境光类（L_ambient>180 lux）分类准确率100%；Class 1（滤波衰减）与Class 3（对准偏差）在V_signal（0.15–0.18 V）和BER（0.12–0.20）区间存在物理特征重叠，导致量化后准确率下降3.80%。混淆矩阵显示正常类与高环境光类精确率/召回率均为0.94–1.00，但严重遮挡类召回率仅0.26（F1=0.38）。

Conclusion: 研究验证了在ESP32-S3微控制器上以TinyML实现光无线链路物理层实时故障诊断的可行性，量化模型以极低内存开销提供自感知边缘节点能力。未来工作建议扩展数据集环境多样性、增加同步丢失恢复机制、设计闭环自适应控制（如自动功率调节或机械对准），并探索更高效的曼彻斯特/PPM编码以提升比特率。

Abstract: Optical Wireless Communication (OWC) systems provide high-bandwidth, spatially secure, and RF-interference-free digital transmission. However, direct free-space optical links suffer from extreme sensitivity to line-of-sight disruptions, optical attenuation, high ambient light saturation, and transmitter-receiver misalignment. Traditional channel diagnostic frameworks rely on external computing nodes or cloud-based processing, which introduces severe diagnostic latency and reduces edge node autonomy. This paper presents an autonomous, self-diagnosing optical wireless receiver node that integrates physical-layer signal telemetry extraction with an on-device TinyML classification engine. Built around an ESP32-S3 microcontroller, the receiver recovers 1000 bit/s On-Off Keying (OOK) digital payloads using a 5-sample majority voting mechanism while concurrently extracting real-time channel features: Bit Error Rate (BER), received signal voltage (Vsignal), Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNRdB), and ambient light baseline (Lambient). Evaluated against a Random Forest baseline (77.22% accuracy) and a floating-point neural network (78.48% accuracy), a post-training INT8 quantized TensorFlow Lite Micro model occupying only 3.32 kB of SRAM runs directly on the receiver firmware. The quantized model achieves 74.68% overall accuracy across four distinct operational conditions: normal transmission, optical filter attenuation, ambient light interference, and severe obstruction/misalignment. On-device deployment tests confirm real-time, deterministic fault classification, establishing a practical approach for self-aware optical IoT nodes.

</details>


### [242] [Learning to Forecast on Multiple Spatiotemporal Hierarchies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21414)
*Valentina Moretti,Cesare Alippi,Andrea Cini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Stochastic Hierarchical Regularization (SHR)框架，将多种结构多样化的层次结构作为多任务正则化用于时空预测。训练时每步采样不同层次结构，通过共享参数鼓励学习跨结构通用的表征，并提出一种基于自顶向下方法的递归相容性算子，保证线性时间空间复杂度，从而让训练在层次分布上变得可行。实验证明SHR在多个基准数据集和归纳设置下优于单层次训练和现有SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度层级预测方法通常在单一（且常固定）的层次结构上训练，导致模型对该结构过拟合，且层级结构本身就是模型的关键归纳偏置，不同层次提供不同的学习信号。本文旨在通过联合学习多个结构多样的层次，使模型学到对结构变化鲁棒、对未见数据泛化更好的共享表征。

Method: （1）定义输入图上的层级分布𝒫(·|A)，每步采样一个层级ℋ；（2）构建金字塔式spatiotemporal GNN预测器f_θ，参数跨层级共享，使用k-MIS等图池化方法构建保局部性的层次；（3）优化目标为各层级重构损失的期望；（4）提出递归相容性算子，融合自顶向下分配与子节点间零和残差修正，保证相邻层级相容；（5）推理时从分布中采样R个层级并平均其底层预测。

Result: SHR在Metr-LA、PeMS-Bay、AQI、EngRAD四个数据集及LargeST的GLA归纳设置上均优于单层次基准（HiGP、Fixed hier.）和多种SOTA基线（DCRNN、GWNet、STAEformer等）；敏感性分析表明增加层次多样性与测试时层级平均均能持续降低MAE；递归算子在保持与投影式协调相当或更优精度的同时，将运行时与显存复杂度降至线性。

Conclusion: 将结构多样化的层次作为正则化源，可显著提升时空层级预测精度与对未见图的归纳迁移能力；递归相容算子使跨层次训练在大规模层级下计算可行。未来工作可探索其他层次分布、不同预测架构设计以及时空联合的时序层次。

Abstract: Hierarchical forecasting exploits aggregation structures that expose multiple views of the same underlying spatiotemporal forecasting problem, while ensuring coherence among forecasts. Individual series provide fine-grained information, while progressively coarser aggregates reveal temporal and spatial patterns at different scales. In the associated deep learning architectures, the hierarchy determines which aggregate series are available and how they are processed together with individual series (e.g., through reconciliation or message-passing operators). Different hierarchies thus provide distinct learning signals and inductive biases for forecasting the same collection of time series. Nonetheless, existing architectures are typically trained on a single, often fixed, structure. In this work, we propose a graph deep learning framework that leverages variations across hierarchies as multi-task regularization. We show that jointly learning across these structures can reduce over-specialization to any single hierarchy and improve forecasting performance. Indeed, training across hierarchies provides an inductive bias toward representations that are useful across different structures, and as such, generalize better. Making forecasts coherent with the aggregation constraints for each sampled hierarchy is computationally expensive: to complement the framework, we propose a novel operator-based on a top-down approach-that produces coherent forecasts with linear time and space complexity w.r.t. the hierarchy size. Experiments show that our approach improves forecasting accuracy over training on a single structure and is competitive with current state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [243] [What Does History Add? Calendar Controls and Information-Timing Audits for University Trajectory Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21419)
*Zepei Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一项评估审计研究：在基于规则的大学轨迹模拟器中，通过引入日历控制变量（history-length-only control），审计历史摘要相对于仅当前状态预测器的真实预测价值。研究发现，看似显著的历史摘要优势在引入日历控制后变得不确定，但全历史摘要仍优于其计数控制，且分组别分析显示历史摘要对准备度和资金有明确改善，对疲劳指标则存在支持违反问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在序列预测任务中，使用历史信息往往带来性能提升，但这种提升可能源于日历特征（如已用时间长度）而非真正的历史状态信息。本文旨在区分"历史摘要信息的真实价值"与"额外日历指示符带来的虚假优势"，通过引入低成本的长度控制变量来严格审计历史信息的贡献。

Method: 方法核心是基于规则的大学轨迹模拟器（含11个状态坐标、计划、资源约束与随机执行），重建16,750条路径和804,000条月度记录。使用17种Ridge回归规范与持久性基线，系统分离当前计划、过去状态摘要、过去计划摘要与历史长度指标。关键创新是引入"长度控制模型"（仅附加可用历史计数与非空指示符），并通过配对族自助法计算95%置信区间。在两个评估集上进行验证：原始40族（存在先前任务暴露）和全新的30族（已锁定权重）。

Result: 主要结果呈现明显的条件依赖性：（1）原始40族评估中，6个月历史将6步nRMSE从0.159234降至0.151522（相对降低4.84%），但相对于长度控制仅降低-0.000895，95%区间[-0.001957, 0.000248]包含零，证据不确定；（2）全新30族验证中，相对于长度控制的差异为-0.000558，区间[-0.001783, 0.000728]，仍不确定；（3）全历史模型相对于其计数控制有更清晰的改善（差值约-0.0049，区间不包含零）；（4）分组别分解显示准备度（差值-0.008040，40/40族胜）和资金（-0.002280，39/40族胜）有清晰改善，但疲劳指标差值+0.001135，区间包含零；（5）疲劳预测28.20%违反模拟器[5,90]支持域。

Conclusion: 研究得出条件性结论：紧凑的历史摘要对多个状态坐标具有预测价值，但日历控制和疲劳误差显著改变了6步聚合增益的解释。研究强调评估应明确报告预测时刻的信息合约、添加时钟感知控制、对齐递归与教师强制目标、保留场景组依赖性、并检查每个关键输出而非依赖单一聚合指标。这是评估审计而非新记忆架构，结论限于条件模拟器预测，不适用于真实学生预测、因果行动效应或语言模型记忆。

Abstract: We audit the predictive value of historical summaries in a rule-based university trajectory simulator. Seventeen ridge specifications and persistence separate current plans, past-state and past-plan summaries, and calendar-only history-length indicators. Across training, validation and two family-held-out evaluations, we reconstruct 16,750 routes and 804,000 monthly records. On the original 40-family set, six-month history lowers six-step normalized RMSE from 0.159234 to 0.151522, but its difference from a length-only control is -0.000895 (descriptive paired 95% interval [-0.001957,0.000248]). Fixed weights on 30 families unused in identified prior tasks reproduce this pattern: 0.156480 to 0.150074 versus current-state prediction, but -0.000558 [-0.001783,0.000728] versus the length control. These uncertain comparisons do not generalize to all-history summaries, which improve on their own calendar control. Exploratory decomposition finds clearer preparation-index and funds benefits, whereas fatigue dominates the six-month model's loss and has an uncertain length-controlled benefit. Moreover, 28.20% of its six-step fatigue predictions violate the simulator's [5,90] support. We document family dependence, prior exposure, strict temporal indexing, matched recursive references and independent numerical replay. The task conditions on recorded future plans; it does not evaluate real-student forecasts, causal action effects, autonomous planning or language-model memory. This is an evaluation audit, not a new memory architecture.

</details>


### [244] [Each Reward to Its Relevant Tokens: Reward-Specific Token-Level Credit Assignment for Multi-Reward RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21439)
*Skylar Zhai,Haonan Wang,Zhining Liu,Linxin Song,Xuwei Ding,Jingcheng Liang,Jian Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MRTPO是一种用于多奖励强化学习的token级信用分配方法，通过让策略在带或不带某奖励验证器信息的上下文下重放自身响应，利用Jensen-Shannon距离衡量每个token与各奖励的相关性，将每个奖励的优势仅分配到与其相关的token上，无需辅助模型或token级标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GRPO/GDPO等多奖励RL方法在response级别决定各奖励的权重后，将每个奖励的优势均匀分配到响应的所有token上，但每个验证器通常只检查响应的少量位置（如格式验证器只看标签），导致不相关的token被错误地赋予信用或惩罚，造成信用分配偏差。

Method: 对每个奖励k，构造两个仅在该奖励验证器信息上有差别的上下文（P_all包含全部验证器信息，P_∖k去掉Z_k），用生成该响应的策略θ_old在两个上下文下分别重放响应并计算每个位置的next-token分布，用归一化的Jensen-Shannon距离作为token与奖励k的相关性分数q_{k,t}；按 w_{k,t}=(1-β)+β·q_{k,t}/q̄_k 对奖励k的组标准化优势进行加权分配，再逐token求和S_t^(j)=Σ_k A_k^(j)·w_{k,t}后做batch级rescaling，β在训练初期按smoothstep从0 warm-up；额外对重分配部分做二阶矩约束以防方差爆炸。

Result: 在text-to-SQL（Spider/Syn/Realistic/DK/BIRD，Qwen2.5-Coder-3B/7B）、多约束指令遵循（IFEval/IFBench/MulDimIF/AdvancedIF，Qwen2.5-7B/Qwen3-4B）和工具调用（BFCL-v4，Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B）六个模型上，MRTPO平均性能均优于GRPO/GDPO/SAW/OPSD/CoRT；在text-to-SQL上Coder-7B仅60步即超过GDPO的最终精度，工具调用中格式奖励达到0.8的中位步数：13步（MRTPO）vs 19步（GDPO）vs 34步（GRPO）；响应长度比GDPO短约40%；Replay分析显示在text-to-SQL上80%的距离集中在26%–29%的token上、工具调用上集中在13%–15%；shuffling ablation表明位置信号是增益来源；额外训练时间仅比GDPO多10%–20%，且只对组内变动的奖励做replay。

Conclusion: MRTPO提供了一种与response级奖励加权方法正交的多奖励token级信用分配方案，仅利用各验证器自身的信息（无需辅助模型或step级标注）即可将每个奖励的优势精确分配到其相关token上，在三类多奖励任务上以更快收敛和更高性能优于现有方法，且可与SAW等加权方法叠加；局限性在于要求奖励的验证信息可文本化并能改变策略预测，不适用于响应长度等无验证信息的奖励，且实验限于1.5B–7B模型与固定β=0.5。

Abstract: Language models are increasingly trained against several verifiable rewards at once, such as the correctness and the format of a tool call, or the individual constraints of a complex instruction. Reward-decoupled normalization (GDPO) normalizes each reward separately so that different reward combinations keep distinct advantages, but it still spreads every reward's advantage evenly over the whole response, although each verifier checks only a few positions. We propose MRTPO, which assigns the advantage of each reward to the tokens relevant to it, using the information its verifier checks, without auxiliary models or token-level annotations. For each reward, the policy replays its own response with and without that reward's verifier information, and the per-token Jensen-Shannon distance between the two next-token distributions measures each token's relevance and reassigns the advantage. On text-to-SQL, multi-constraint instruction following and tool calling, MRTPO converges faster and achieves better performance than the compared methods.

</details>


### [245] [Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks: Curse of Dimensionality and Structural Bias](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21480)
*Yunhao Ni,Yuxin Guo,Jie Luo,Wenjun Wu,Lei Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论与实证两方面论证：标准样条KAN在最坏情况下仍受维度灾难（CoD）困扰，其在低维依赖分量上对MLP的优势源于目标结构与归纳偏置的匹配，而非架构本身的普遍逃离CoD能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Liu et al. (2025b)声称KAN能通过维度无关的近似指数"逃离维度灾难"，并在多个toy任务上报告了优于MLP的经验表现。本文质疑这一现象究竟属于KAN架构本身，还是仅仅源于所选目标类（具有平滑KA表示的低局部arity函数）的结构优势。

Method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 理论方面：利用Wang et al.
