设计理念：通过使所有原子步骤成为具有声明契约的独立实体，可实现独立类型检查、作用域约束、限界、测试、追踪与审计，从而将治理从运行时希望提升为编译时保障。

Result: 论文通过完整工作的金融工作流（月份账户对账单 issue_statement.v1）作为端到端示例，对 FAOP 进行说明和验证。

具体结果包括：

1. **FNF-1 应用**：将两个粗粒度叶子（PullTransactionsAndInterest、SaveAndDeliverStatement）分别拆分为 GetTransactions、GetInterest、SaveStatement、SendStatement 四个原子 FAOP，具备独立 LLM 绕行和隔离测试能力。

2. **FNF-2 验证**：编译器拒绝将 SaveStatement 放在 SummarizeActivity 之前（缺少 activity_summary 字段），但接受正确顺序。

3. **FNF-3 规整**：将三个工作流共享的子流程（GetTransactions → GetInterest → ComputeBalance）提取为单一规范 FAOP build_statement_facts.v1，每次调用通过 call(id) 引用而非内联重建。

4. **FNF-4 作用域检查**：验证从根到叶的每个父子边满足工具集单调递减、护栏集单调递增；示例中如果 SummarizeActivity.v1 被编辑调用 delivery_svc，编译器将在部署前拒绝。

5. **扩展应用**：
   - +V：交付循环设定 max_iterations=3，并附带 exhaust 处理 FAOP MarkDeliveryFailed.v1；
   - +O：GetTransactions 与 GetInterest 经 L3 定律并行化；
   - +B：声明各动作叶 τ_max 与 c_max（GetTransactions/GetInterest 各 2s、SummarizeActivity 4s 与 800 tokens、SendStatement 5s），整个交付循环贡献至多 15s。

6. **架构级分类**：示例 λ=1（仅 SummarizeActivity 包含 op_LLM，其他均为确定性），可通过移除该叶子降至 λ=0。

7. **完整签名**：示例编译为 (k, E, λ) = (4, {+V, +O, +B}, 1)；通过账户关闭第二个工作流的演示，展示了命名一致性、规范化复用与跨流程影响分析。

论文承认尚未报告编译器、注册表、执行器的实现细节以及实证研究，未来工作包括反射式规划、事务原子性（+T）以及运行时分解；并指出现有研究中 26.1% 社区贡献技能包含漏洞、40,285 个已发布技能的广泛意图级冗余，证实了规范化需求的紧迫性。

Conclusion: FAOP 理论将 Agent 工作流提升至与关系数据相对应的规范化、形式化和可治理化水平。FAOP 通过将每个工作流视为作用域受限状态上的带类型函数，对 Agent 库施加渐进范式，从而在编译时建立完整性与隔离保证，消除漂移与静默递归。FAOP 代数提供了五条语义保持定律，使安全重构、自动并行化和提取/内联成为编译器重写操作。扩展 +V、+O、+B 处理终止性、优化和资源界限，而 λ 分类为治理提供了形式化依据。每个 FAOP 的签名 (k, E, λ) 将库级合规性转化为可检查的架构属性。SkillBase 在此理论上的实现，如同 PostgreSQL 对数据所起的作用，作为可查询、有模式、有约束的存储系统，使分散的技能文件集合升级为治理资产。

Abstract: Organizations increasingly encode operational procedures as multi-step agent skills, here called Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs), that must be traceable, auditable, reproducible, access-controlled, and bounded in time and cost, requirements that regulated sectors make mandatory. Yet AOPs are typically kept as coarse-grained files, in which steps bundle actions, copied procedures drift apart, any step may reach any tool, and refactoring goes unchecked. We present Functional Agent Operating Procedures (FAOP), a formal theory that brings database-grade discipline to AI agent workflows. FAOP recasts each workflow as a typed function over scoped state and subjects an entire library to four progressive normal forms: Decomposed (FNF-1) splits a workflow into atomic steps, Typed (FNF-2) makes its data flow explicit and type-checked, Factored (FNF-3) gives each shared procedure a single canonical definition so a change propagates instead of drifting, and Scoped (FNF-4) confines every step to least-privilege tool access. Once normalized, every atomic step is a separate entity with a declared contract and can be type-checked, scope-confined, bounded, tested, traced, and audited on its own. A FAOP algebra of provably sound equalities turns refactoring and parallelization into compiler rewrites; orthogonal extensions add verified termination (+V), optimization (+O), and time and cost bounds (+B); and an architectural-level classifier (0-3) determines whether a workflow needs AI at all. Together, these make integrity, isolation, typing, termination, cost, and optimization compile-time concerns across the whole library, not runtime hopes. We implement the theory in SkillBase, an AOP management system (what PostgreSQL is to data, SkillBase is to AOPs), together with a separate executor that enforces these guarantees at run time. A worked financial workflow illustrates the approach end to end.

</details>


### [302] [The World Won't Wait: Evaluating and Teaching Agents Under a Live Clock](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20665)
*Ningxin Pan,Hanyu Li,Yeqing Shen,Ning Ding,Yehui Tang,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 RealtimeBench 基准（180 个任务、6 种游戏类型）以研究在游戏持续运行的实时环境下 LLM 智能体的表现，并提出 TORSI 框架：让慢速教师模型在离线下研究失败并产出可复用指令，快速学生模型在游戏时不调用教师、仅依据指令决策。经两轮改进，Jev 的平均测试得分由 13.51 提升至 24.19，且指令可直接迁移到其他三个模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有游戏基准大多在模型推理时暂停游戏，无法反映真实时延对决策的影响；强大推理模型在暂停条件下表现优异，但因响应过慢而在实时环境下失效。需要一种能在"世界不停等待"条件下评估智能体的基准，以及一种不让学生在实时游戏中等待慢速教师的方法。

Method: 1) RealtimeBench：180 任务、6 游戏类型（Mario、Snake、Tetris、Temple、River、Bird），支持暂停、当前、1.5×、2× 四种时钟模式，使用 0–100 进度评分。2) TORSI（Two-Timescale Offline Recursive Self-Improvement）：慢速教师 GPT-6.1-sol 在反馈任务上分析学生 Jev 的失败轨迹，在保存的状态/慢速环境中离线试错修正，再用学生自身时延在线检验，最终产出可复用指令；候选指令仅在验证集上严格优于当前指令时才被采纳，每游戏类型独立决策，测试集仅用于报告。

Result: 1) 基准对比：暂停条件下 GPT-6.1-sol 在 5/6 游戏上优于 Jev，但实时条件下其均分仅 1.51，低于 Jev 的 13.51；所有模型实时均分≤16.62。2) TORSI 两轮后 Jev 均分由 13.51 提升至 24.19，六类游戏全部改善；教师实践与学生实践互补，缺一不可。3) 与 ACE(13.22)、AHE(16.59)、GEPA(14.52) 相比 TORSI(24.19) 最高，API 成本 $24.39 与对比方法相当。4) 冻结指令零样本迁移到 StartLux 4B(12.22→25.05)、StartLux 27B(16.62→20.43)、MiMo(5.95→7.30)。

Conclusion: 实时智能需要兼顾推理能力与及时行动；RealtimeBench 提供了可控时钟的统一评估框架，TORSI 展示了"离线深思+在线快速行动"范式的可行性——强 LLM 通过离线实践为快速执行者提炼可复用指令，且指令可在不同模型间迁移，为面向真实动态环境的实时智能体研究指明了方向。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can solve complex interactive tasks, yet reasoning and tool calls take time. In continuously changing environments, an otherwise correct action may arrive too late. We introduce RealtimeBench, with 180 tasks across six game types, to evaluate agents while games continue running during inference. Paired evaluations show that GPT-6.1-sol outperforms the faster Jev when games are paused, but falls behind when they keep running. We propose Two-Timescale Offline Recursive Self-Improvement (TORSI): a slow teacher studies failures and tests corrections in paused games between attempts, then writes reusable instructions for a fast student. The student acts without teacher calls during gameplay, and validation scores determine which updates are adopted. Two rounds raise Jev's average test score from 13.51 to 24.19 on a 0--100 progress scale, improving all six game types. The instructions also improve average scores for three other models without retuning. These findings point toward real-time intelligence: enabling powerful LLM agents to remain effective in a continuously changing world by organizing deliberation, learning, and action across timescales.

</details>


### [303] [Evaluating Model Capabilities After Benchmark Saturation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20667)
*Morio Hamada,Jehyeok Yeon,Matteo Migliarini,Justin Olive,Magda Dubois*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究基准饱和后能否利用模型解题transcript（而非仅用得分）来评估模型能力。作者构建了一个回顾性评估框架，模拟饱和场景，比较四种从转录本提取能力信号的方法（确定性特征、追踪嵌入、绝对评分、单播离散评分），发现单播离散评分最优，将预测误差降低5.3倍；但在分布偏移（如推理模型出现）下协议表现不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI能力快速进步，基准测试日益饱和（即多个模型接近满分），丧失区分能力，对AI安全评估和前沿政策制定造成压力。传统解决方案为持续更新基准，但耗时耗力难以匹配模型进步速度。因此需要从现有基准中提取更多信息。基准得分将模型行为压缩为单一标量，丢失了大量信息；transcript（模型解题过程的完整记录）可能保留超越正确性的能力信号。

Method: 作者构建了回顾性预测任务：以一个学期的参考模型（已知能力校准），让其使用同一学期的Transcript评估另一组目标模型在更难的未饱和题目上的能力。四种预测协议：确定性追踪特征（长度、推理、工具调用、词汇模式等13个特征）、追踪嵌入（Qwen3-Embedding-8B）、绝对评分（LLM对单一transcript打1-10分）、单播离散评分（LLM比较两个transcript判断哪个来自更强模型）。基线协议仅使用饱和基准得分（即目标模型均值）。能力真值使用项目反应理论(IRT)对未饱和题目估计。

Result: 单播离散评分显著优于其他协议，MSE=0.26，LLR=0.68 (p=.005)，将预测误差降低5.27倍；其他协议未显著优于基线。能力信息分布在transcript各部分，但集中于特定通道：移除推理使Coding/Cyber/Science预测误差增加3-4倍；移除工具交互使Cyber误差增加4倍但对Coding无影响。存在分布偏移失效：2025年初引入推理模型后，早于该时期的法官系统低估推理模型能力2.1-3.0个能力单位。单播离散评分预测能推广到能力更强的模型和闭源模型。领域间存在不对称传递：智能体任务（Coding/Cyber）的transcript能预测非智能体任务的能力，但反向不行。

Conclusion: 即使基准得分已饱和，正确解决的transcript仍保留超越正确性的能力预测信号。在评估的协议中，单播离散评分提取此信号最可靠，能从饱和基准中预测较难的h-o-out任务上的模型能力。这表明可以延长现有基准的有用性以跟踪模型能力，这对当构建更难评估无法跟上模型进步时的安全和治理决策至关重要。但当前协议在分布偏移（如推理模型出现）下不够稳健，未来工作应不仅关注提取更多信号，还应设计对分布偏移稳健的协议。

Abstract: Rapid advances in AI capabilities are causing benchmarks to saturate. Once several models approach perfect scores, a benchmark loses its power to differentiate between them, and with it its utility for informing AI safety cases and frontier policies. Yet benchmark items produce far more information than the scores we typically extract from them: a full transcript of how each model solved the task. We investigate whether these transcripts can be used to assess model capabilities even after benchmark scores have saturated. We simulate saturation retrospectively using historical benchmark and model releases, and test whether protocols that access only correctly solved transcripts from saturated benchmarks can predict capabilities measured on held-out, unsaturated items. We evaluate representative contemporary approaches for extracting information from model transcripts: pairwise judging, single-transcript absolute scoring, and predictions from deterministic transcript features or embeddings. We find that saturated transcripts retain capability information beyond benchmark accuracy. Amongst our evaluated protocols, pairwise judging performs best, reducing prediction error by 5.3 times compared to a baseline using only saturated benchmark scores. This capability-relevant information is distributed across transcript sections, but concentrated in specific channels of information such as reasoning and tool-calls. However, the predictive power of protocols does not always generalise across distribution shifts -- for example by underestimating the capabilities of the first reasoning models introduced in early 2025. Saturated benchmarks thus retain capability-predicting signal in their task transcripts, but extending the lifetime of existing benchmarks requires methods designed to extract these signals robustly.

</details>


### [304] [Value-Informed Schedule Trimming for Accelerated Sequential Monte Carlo Guidance in Discrete Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20669)
*Jaehyeon Kim,Ziseok Lee,Siyoung Choi,Kyungsu Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VISTA（Value-Informed Schedule Trimming for Accelerated Sequential Monte Carlo Guidance）是一种无需训练的调度选择方法，用于在离散扩散模型中以稀疏方式进行奖励引导的 SMC 推断。其核心思想是将稀疏引导视为对理想全程引导概率路径的近似，推导出ℓ₁路径偏差的可估计上界，并通过少量全程引导预热运行收集的价值统计量，利用动态规划精确优化该经验代理目标，从而在固定预算下自动选择任务特定的引导时间步。在文本、生物序列和图像生成任务上，VISTA 在与手工设计的稀疏调度相同的预算下，通常能获得更优的下游性能，并在多个任务上接近甚至超过全程引导的性能，同时大幅降低推断延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励引导的离散扩散模型在测试时通过 SMC 方法进行引导需要昂贵的奖励评估和（基于梯度时）价值梯度计算，每一步执行引导代价高昂。稀疏引导虽能降低成本，但现有调度通常基于固定启发式（如区间引导或均匀间隔），在不同任务和奖励景观下效果差异显著，缺乏自动化的任务特定调度选择方法。

Method: 1) 将稀疏引导建模为对理想全程引导路径 {π_t*} 的概率路径近似，定义 Total Deviation (TD) 为两路径在所有时间步上的平均 ℓ₁ 距离。2) 证明当 0 < R(x₀) ≤ R_max 时，TD(𝒢) 具有可估计的上界 UTD(𝒢)，其仅依赖价值期望 E[V_⌈t⌉]，无需访问真实边缘分布。3) 通过 M 次全程引导预热运行估计均值价值统计 V̂_t，将预算约束下的经验代理目标 Ŝ(𝒢) = Σ_{t∉̂𝒢} V̂_{⌈t⌉} 的优化问题，通过 O(T²T') 复杂度的动态规划精确求解。4) 调度选定后复用，所有后续生成与相同预算的其他稀疏调度具有相同的每次生成复杂度，无需修改底层 SMC 提案族。

Result: 在 Binary MNIST（SMC-base/grad）、CIFAR-10（SMC-base）、Toxic Text（SMC-grad）、DNA 序列设计（SMC-grad）和蛋白质适应度（SMC-base）等任务上，VISTA 在相同预算下大多数设置中优于手工设计的稀疏基线（Interval-k、Uniform、Top-V、Top-ΔV）。在多个任务上，VISTA 在多样性敏感指标上接近甚至超过全程引导。例如，在 Toxic Text 任务中（T'=15，SMC-grad），VISTA 的唯一毒性比为 0.99，全程引导为 1.00，而每次生成延迟从 204.23 s 降至 38.16 s，加速 5.35 倍。Binary MNIST（SMC-grad）在 T'=24 时，UTD 降至 1.43×10⁻³，优于最佳稀疏基线。CIFAR-10 中，稀疏引导因有限粒子下过度修正反而优于全程引导，VISTA 在 T'=15 时获得 4.28 个唯一有效样本，优于全程引导的 2.18。VISTA 发现的任务特定调度在不同任务间差异显著：Binary MNIST 集中在早期去噪阶段，而 Toxic Text、DNA 和 CIFAR-10 则分布在整个轨迹中。敏感性分析表明仅需少量（如 M=3，M=5 in CIFAR-10）预热仿真即可恢复高质量的调度结构。

Conclusion: VISTA 是首个在无需访问不可处理的全程引导边缘分布的情况下，稀疏 SMC 调度中的目标路径偏差上界的训练无关调度选择器。通过最小化可估计的路径偏差上界，VISTA 在固定计算预算下识别任务特定的引导调度，在图像、文本和生物领域实验中保留甚至超越全程引导性能，同时大幅降低推断延迟。研究表明，对于高效的离散扩散对齐，选择"何时"引导与设计"如何"引导同样重要。局限性包括：需要少量全程引导预热生成、UTD 是保守上界而非直接下游性能目标、加权扩展至非掩码扩散需用户指定的时序加权函数 λ(t)。

Abstract: Reward-guided discrete diffusion enables test-time alignment with downstream objectives, but applying Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) guidance at every denoising step is computationally expensive. Active guidance steps require additional reward evaluations and, for gradient-based proposals, value-gradient computations. Sparse guidance reduces this cost by guiding only a subset of timesteps, but commonly used schedules are fixed heuristics whose effectiveness can vary substantially across tasks. We propose VISTA, a training-free method that automatically selects guided timesteps under a fixed budget. VISTA formulates sparse guidance as approximation of the ideal full-guidance probability path and derives an estimable upper bound on \(\ell_1\) path deviation. Using value statistics collected from a small number of full-guidance warmup generations, VISTA optimizes the resulting empirical surrogate exactly via dynamic programming. The warmup generations can be retained as model outputs, and after schedule selection VISTA has the same per-generation guidance complexity as other sparse schedules with the same budget. Across text, biological sequence, and image generation tasks, VISTA discovers task-dependent schedules and outperforms hand-designed sparse schedules in most tested settings, while approaching or exceeding full-guidance performance on several task metrics. In toxic-text generation, for example, VISTA attains a 0.99 unique-toxic ratio compared with 1.00 for full guidance while reducing post-selection per-generation latency from 204.23 s to 38.16 s, a 5.35$\times$ speedup.

</details>


### [305] [AlphaDiana: A Measurement System for Agents in Verifiable Reasoning Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20675)
*Zhanke Zhou,Zongze Li,Weikai Huang,Xuan Li,Chentao Cao,Xiao Feng,Xiangyu Lu,Jinbo Hu,Yi Xie,Nico Pelleriti,Shiyang Liu,Menghan Lu,Max Zimmer,Brando Miranda,Jiangchao Yao,Bo Liu,Sanmi Koyejo,Sebastian Pokutta,Bo Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AlphaDiana是一个模块化测量系统，通过分离控制数据集、代理、环境和评分器，支持在共享条件下对完整代理进行宏观分析以及对工具、技能和内存等组件进行微观干预。研究发现：代理框架（harness）并不能一致提升推理模型的准确性，且技能引导和历史记忆保留同样不可靠；行为和输出token使用必须结合正确性共同评估，因为低token熵可能伴随错误答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前代理系统的性能评估缺乏统一且细粒度的测量框架，难以将执行条件与结果、行为及资源使用联系起来。代理框架（harness）对推理模型准确性的影响，以及其内部组件（如工具、技能、记忆）的干预效果，尚未得到系统性研究。

Method: 提出AlphaDiana测量系统，采用模块化接口（数据集、代理、环境、评分器），保留框架原生控制循环，并独立控制文件复用与记忆保留。在5个基于答案的基准和2个交互式基准上，测试3个开源模型与3个开源框架的组合，以及2个模型在交互式基准的表现。进行宏观（完整代理）与微观（工具、技能、记忆等组件）干预实验，并关联答案正确性与执行状态、追踪记录与资源记录。

Result: 1) 框架并不能一致提升推理准确性：在模型单独能答对的问题上可能引入损失，抵消在原本答错问题上的收益。2) 组件干预效果不稳定：技能引导与历史记忆保留均不能可靠提升准确性。3) 行为与token使用必须结合正确性评估：低token熵可能伴随错误答案；单次执行输出减少但因准确性下降可能导致单位正确答案的token消耗增加。

Conclusion: AlphaDiana能够在共享任务与资源策略下，关联答案正确性与执行状态、追踪及资源记录，从而支持代理间的比较与失败诊断。代理性能评估必须超越单一准确率指标，综合纳入执行条件、行为模式与资源消耗。

Abstract: Agents pair reasoning models with harnesses that organize model calls, execute tools, load skill instructions, and retain history in memory. Understanding agent performance requires linking execution conditions to outcomes, behavior, and resource use. We introduce AlphaDiana, a measurement system with modular interfaces for datasets, agents, environments, and scorers. It preserves harness-native control loops while controlling file reuse and memory retention separately. AlphaDiana supports macro analyses of complete agents and micro interventions on agent components such as tools, skills, and memory under matched conditions. We study three open-source models and three open-source harnesses on five answer-based benchmarks, with two models also tested on two interactive benchmarks. We find that harnesses do not consistently improve the accuracy of reasoning: gains on questions unsolved by the model alone can be outweighed by losses on questions it answers correctly without tools. This inconsistency extends to component interventions: neither skill guidance nor retained history reliably improves accuracy. Behavior and output-token use must be assessed with correctness: low token entropy can accompany wrong answers, and less output per execution can mean more output tokens per correct answer when accuracy falls. AlphaDiana links answer correctness and execution status to traces and resource records for comparing agents and diagnosing failures under shared task and resource policies.

</details>


### [306] [When Correctness Feedback Erases Evidence: Phase-Separated Completeness Auditing in Verus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20676)
*Adarsh Agrawal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文发现在Verus/Rust形式化验证场景中，规范完备性审计(specification-completeness auditing)与正确性反馈存在"目标反转"冲突：向LLM反馈编译/验证/测试结果会让模型修复"错误程序"，从而摧毁审计所需的"被弱化契约接受但违反真实意图"的反例证据。独立无反馈发现产出的认证见证数是IntentShield反馈循环的两倍以上(59.0% vs 27.1%)，且保留这些见证后修复的规范能带来更高的实现成功率(Phase-Revised达81.3% vs IS-Revised 62.5%)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的形式化验证合成通常采用"失败即反馈"的迭代修复循环，但当任务从"正确实现"转为"审计规范完备性"（寻找弱契约接受但行为错误的程序作为反例）时，反馈循环会自我消除审计所需的关键证据。这种"目标反转"在现有Verus/Rust工作流中尚未被量化。

Method: 在12个Verus/Rust任务上对比四种发现策略：(1)Direct——三次独立无反馈调用；(2)IntentShield——迭代式注入编译/验证/测试反馈；(3)FMI——格式匹配迭代控制，仅用占位反馈文本以分离反馈内容与重启效应；(4)Phase——独立执行Direct策略后冻结候选再移交修复。匹配四次模型族(Claude Sonnet 5、DeepSeek V3.2、Devstral 2、Qwen3-Coder-480B)、三次重复、3次调用预算。见证认证需通过四个闸门：弱契约验证通过、恢复后契约验证失败、编译执行通过、与官方测试用例行为不符。下游用Claude Sonnet 5在16个任务上做规范修复与实现合成对比。

Result: Direct认证85/144(59.0%)个见证，IntentShield仅39/144(27.1%)，任务级均值差31.9pp(sign检验p=0.00635)。FMI拆分：69.6%的差距源于反馈内容，30.4%源于重启多样性。语法解析修复后差距仍达27.1pp；四个模型族全部偏向无反馈；Phase独立执行同样产出85/144见证且单元一致性84.7%(κ=0.68)。下游方面，Phase-Revised规范实现成功率达81.3%，远超IS-Revised的62.5%；92.9%的见证同样在留出测试用例上失败。在Dafny和Lean上效应未复现，划定了Verus/Rust子领域的经验边界。

Conclusion: 正确性反馈与规范完备性审计具有相反的直接目标，Verus/Rust工作流中的反馈循环会使认证见证产出减半。应采用"先保留再修复"的阶段分离流程：先以无反馈方式发现并冻结被弱契约接受的错误程序作为见证，认证其暴露的遗漏义务后，再引入正确性导向的规范修复。审计与修复须明确分离，不可混合同一调用循环。

Abstract: Correctness feedback suppresses the very evidence that specification-completeness auditing is designed to uncover: programs that satisfy a written contract but violate intended behavior. We demonstrate this objective reversal on 12 Verus/Rust tasks across four model families under matched call budgets. Independent no-feedback discovery more than doubles certified-witness yield relative to IntentShield's corrective-feedback loop (59.0% versus 27.1%). A format-matched iterative control places the larger share of this gap in feedback content, not independent restarts. The advantage holds in every model family and survives parser repair. A separate phase-separated execution matches the aggregate yield without reusing responses; most certified witnesses also fail held-out cases. Preserving these witnesses delivers stronger specification repair: Phase-Revised contracts achieve 81.3% implementation success, versus 62.5% for IS-Revised, with Direct-Revised close behind. Both no-feedback witness sources substantially outperform weakened contracts. The effect does not reproduce in the available Dafny and Lean evaluations, establishing an empirical boundary around the studied Verus/Rust workflow. Completeness auditing and correctness repair have opposing immediate objectives. Preserve and certify the admitted failure before repairing it.

</details>


### [307] [Counterfactual Neighborhood Risk Fields: Evidence-Grounded Selective Safety for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20679)
*Tianshi Wang,Jingsong Wang,Fengling Li,Jingjing Li,Xin Li,Lei Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CNRF（反事实邻域风险场），将VLM安全防御从"学习有害性边界"重构为"构建可选择性干预的证据"。通过构建上下文匹配的反事实对，将表征差异作为能力相关风险方向，并单独估计邻域支持度以区分"不熟悉"与"有害性"。在三个VLM和五种多模态越狱攻击上取得86-89%的宏防御成功率，同时保持良性任务效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于表征的VLM安全防御仅学习有害与良性输入的分离，但风险分数的含义和可信度未被建立。风险分数可能混淆"有害能力"与"不熟悉"，造成不安全的合规或不必要的拒绝。需要从边界学习转向构造适用于选择性风险决策的证据。

Method: CNRF框架包含：(1) 反事实证据构建——通过上下文匹配的有害-良性对生成能力方向；(2) 邻域风险场——聚合多个反事实方向估计风险；(3) 受害者自适应筛选——区分局部表征几何模型与内部安全观测模型；(4) 同受害者响应审查——对路由请求进行验证，释放可接受响应或生成能力降低的受限替代品。关键是将风险估计与证据适用性（邻域支持）分离建模。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Gemma-3-12B、InternVL3-8B三个VLM上对五种多模态越狱家族（JOOD、JailBreakV、UltraBreak、HADES、MMJailBench）评估：宏防御成功率达86.06-89.30%，安全-效用综合指标SUS为69.82-77.21，优于HiddenDetect、RCS、VLMGuard、AdaShield、ECSO、CIDER、ASTRA、OH-Defense、CARE等基线。AUROC达87.87-94.50%，TPR@5%FPR达60.76-80.75%。消融实验表明查询匹配参考（pAUROC 89.24 vs 远邻域48.59）和上下文-方向对应性对低假阳性率风险排序至关重要。推理开销增加0.279-0.551秒。

Conclusion: CNRF将VLM安全从边界分类转向证据构造，通过能力相关比较、显式证据支持与同受害者响应验证实现选择性安全。证实可靠证据依赖查询匹配参考与保留的上下文-方向对应性，为风险感知VLM安全提供了可解释的证据构造新视角。

Abstract: Representation-based safety defenses for vision-language models (VLMs) often learn to separate harmful from benign inputs, but separation alone does not establish what a risk score means or when it should be trusted. We introduce Counterfactual Neighborhood Risk Fields (CNRF), an evidence-grounded framework for selective VLM safety. CNRF constructs context-matched benign-harmful counterfactual pairs, uses their representation differences as capability-related risk directions, and estimates neighborhood support separately from risk. This separation prevents unfamiliarity from being conflated with harmfulness and enables selective intervention rather than blanket rejection. A victim-adaptive interface accommodates different safety observations across VLM architectures and routes selected requests for same-victim response review, which either releases acceptable candidates or produces constrained alternatives with reduced harmful capability. Across three VLMs and five multimodal jailbreak families, CNRF achieves 86.06-89.30% macro defense success rate while retaining substantial benign-task utility. Controlled experiments further show that query-matched references and preserved context-direction correspondence materially improve risk ranking in the low-false-positive regime. CNRF thus reframes representation-based VLM safety from learning harmfulness boundaries to constructing applicable evidence for selective risk decisions.

</details>


### [308] [IneqAgent: Agentic Inequality Proving in Lean with Symbolic Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20681)
*Gaolei He,Jinhui Li,Ruobing Zuo,Xia Zeng,Zhengfeng Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: IneqAgent是一个结合LLM推理与符号计算的不等式证明agent框架，在Lean 4中通过引理级蒙特卡洛树搜索协调引理构造、目标重构与符号后端选择，集成SOS、Bernstein和逐次差分替换三种后端产生精确证书。在四个基准测试上以DeepSeek-V4-Flash达到94.09%的总体成功率，并成功验证了Dittert猜想(四维和五维)的强化形式及Holens-Djokovic (4,4)不等式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不等式的形式化证明需要数学推理与精确计算的结合，现有方法存在两个挑战：符号后端依赖目标代数形式与假设；精确证书构造计算昂贵且浮点近似需精确恢复与验证。需要一种框架能够协调LLM推理与多种符号计算后端，并在原始定理层面产出经形式化验证的完整证明。

Method: 提出IneqAgent框架，包含两大模块：(1) 基于引理级MCTS的LLM证明器，采用symbol-aware动作选择、根优先扩展规则，结合Lean启发式评分与LLM进度评分的复合奖励机制；(2) 符号证明模块提供三种精确证书后端——SOS后端基于Putinar型证书并将Kaltofen等人的数值-符号恢复过程扩展到含等式/不等式约束的情况、Bernstein后端结合数值LP与子分划、DiffSub后端通过逐次差分替换在非负正交域上工作。Translator将证书转化为Lean局部证明，agent将其与LLM生成步骤集成为完整证明。

Result: 在MO-INT-20、Ineq-Real、Evan Chen和新构建的LitIneq(74题)四个基准共186题上，IneqAgent以DeepSeek-V4-Flash解决175题(94.09%)，较最强基线Hilbert(75.81%)提升18.28个百分点；在四个backbone上的低LLM推理成本阈值下成功率均高于Direct Agent。消融实验证实MCTS与符号计算组件互补。案例研究获得Dittert猜想四维(稳定性常数1/52)和五维(1/2500)的Lean验证强化形式，以及Holens-Djokovic (4,4)不等式的精确有理SOS证书，后者蕴含四维Merris猜想。

Conclusion: IneqAgent通过引理级MCTS有效协调LLM推理与符号计算，在形式化不等式证明任务上实现最高成功率和低推理成本，能够在研究级数学问题（如矩阵永久子式猜想）上产出完整Lean验证证明。框架展示了将agentic方法与精确符号证书相结合以推进自动形式化数学推理的潜力。

Abstract: Formal inequality proving requires mathematical reasoning and exact computation, often connected through intermediate lemmas and goal reformulations. We introduce IneqAgent, an agentic framework combining LLM reasoning with symbolic computation for inequality proving in Lean4. Lemma-level Monte Carlo Tree Search coordinates lemma construction, goal reformulation, and symbolic backend selection. Complementary sum-of-squares, Bernstein, and successive difference-substitution backends produce exact certificates for local Lean proof generation. The agent integrates these proofs with LLM-generated steps and uses Lean feedback to construct complete proofs checked against the original theorem statements. On four benchmarks, IneqAgent with DeepSeek-V4-Flash solves 175 of 186 problems (94.09%), achieving the highest overall success rate among the evaluated methods. Across four backbones, it achieves higher success rates at low LLM inference cost thresholds than Direct Agent using the same backbone, with lower mean inference costs over each method's successful runs. We also obtain Lean-verified strengthenings of Dittert's conjecture in dimensions four and five, and certify the Holens--Djokovic $(4,4)$ inequality, implying Merris's conjecture in dimension four.

</details>


### [309] [L2G-SR: Learning to Guide LLM-based Symbolic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20685)
*Letian Huang,Xiangyu Wang,Haowei Lin,Di He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出L2G-SR框架，将学习的结构验证器集成到基于LLM的符号回归中。核心思想是用修改后的树编辑距离（TED）作为结构监督信号，训练一个验证器来预测候选公式与隐藏目标公式之间的结构相似度，并将其与数值误差共同用于父代选择。在LLM-SRBench上取得了最先进的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 符号回归中常用的数值误差指导搜索可能偏向于拟合准确但结构错误的代理公式（如α²近似sin x）。仅依靠数值指标不足以可靠地引导公式发现，因此需要一种互补的结构评分来帮助搜索找到结构正确的公式。

Method: 三部分组成：1）修改的TED结构相似度度量：忽略具体常数值、匹配可交换操作数、比较多个代数视图以容忍常见重写；2）学习验证器：两阶段训练（对比学习对齐+TED预测），从观测和候选公式预测到未知目标的TED；3）两信号搜索：将TED验证器输出与数值误差结合，在父代选择和保留时同时考虑两者。验证器采用Transformer架构，包含数值编码器（科学计数法令牌化）、公式编码器（前缀+树地址嵌入）和回归摘要编码器。

Result: 在LLM-SRBench的240个方程（5个领域）中，L2G-SR在Llama3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507两个LLM骨干上均取得了所有指标（NMSE、Acc_{0.01}、TED）的最优或次优成绩。消融实验表明，将结构通道替换为验证MSE会显著降低性能，证明了学习结构指导的价值。验证器的下游价值可能不在于精确估计每个候选的绝对TED，而在于在搜索过程中提供信息丰富的相对结构偏好。

Conclusion: L2G-SR通过学习的结构验证器为LLM引导的符号回归引入了有价值的结构反馈。三个贡献包括：用于结构监督的修改TED、从观测预测结构距离的多模态验证器、以及将学习反馈集成到LLM引导搜索中的方法。计算资源限制下使用了轻量低成本LLM，未来工作将用最新LLM优化框架，并探索将LLM后训练为验证器或直接后训练分析器以改进公式修订。

Abstract: Symbolic regression searches for an equation that explains observed data. Numerical error is commonly used to guide the search, but it alone can favor an accurate surrogate over a candidate with the right structure. We propose L2G-SR, a framework for LLM-based symbolic regression that guides search with a learned structural verifier. We construct structural supervision signal using tree edit distance (TED), accounting for commutative operators and alternative expression forms. A verifier first aligns numerical observations with the formulas, then learns to score a candidate's structural similarity to the target formula. At search time, the target formula is hidden and the verifier complements numerical error in parent selection. An analyst then uses verifier feedback and diagnostic tools to propose revisions, which a generator converts into refined expressions. On LLM-SRBench, L2G-SR achieves state-of-the-art numerical fit, equation level accuracy and TED across the evaluated LLM backbones and domains. L2G-SR demonstrates the value of learned structural guidance for LLM-based symbolic regression.

</details>


### [310] [When Reality Outpaces Cognition: A New Scaling Principle for Reliable Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20764)
*Ahsan Adeel,Talha Bin Riaz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"有效一致认知速度（S_C^eff）"作为新的AI可靠性评估基准，挑战系统在不重新训练的情况下跨越不断增大的观测-现实间隙（Speed of Reality, S_R提升至50倍）执行可靠动作的能力。基于意识的细胞机制启发的Co⁴架构在视觉引导四足运动和赛车任务中显著优于Transformer和gMLP基线，提出"扩展理解力（S_C），而非仅仅扩展算力、参数和数据"作为可靠AI的新扩展原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI范式（包括Transformer、世界模型）在训练条件之外的环境动态变化下可靠性退化问题尚未被系统性地量化。核心问题是：在训练时无法穷尽部署时可能遇到的最大变化速率的情况下，如何确定AI系统的安全运行边界？特别是在任务关键或安全关键场景中，系统必须在环境动态偏离训练分布时保持可靠行为。现有工作（如时序OOD泛化、动作重复、观测延迟等）虽涉及相邻方面，但未提供一个模型无关的、在固定计算资源下系统增大观测-现实间隙的压力测试框架。

Method: 1. **形式化定义**：定义Speed of Reality (S_R)为任务相关环境变化相对于系统观测-动作周期的速率；定义Speed of Coherent Cognition (S_C)为系统区分有效/相关信息并维持可靠行为的能力。引入mind-reality ratio γ = S_C/S_R，γ≥1为同步，γ<1为过载。
2. **S_C^eff指标**：定义为实验测试集S_test中满足预定义行为可靠性阈值τ的最高S_R值，代表经验行为边界。
3. **Co⁴架构**：基于意识处理和觉醒思维的细胞机制，通过Q-/K-/V-两点神经元（TPNs）的三元调制回路实现"验证后再传播"原则——通过调制函数评估证据与局部/全局上下文预测及上下文充分性的匹配度，再放大有效证据、衰减无效证据。计算复杂度为O(N+k²)，其中k≪N，k≤√N。
4. **实验设计**：在赛车（Car Racing）和视觉引导四足运动（easy和complex两个版本）上，将所有架构仅在S_R,0=1训练，然后在不重新训练、计算资源固定的情况下测试S_R最高至50。比较Transformer、gMLP与Co⁴变体（含Apical Amplification (AA)和Apical Driven + Awake (ADA)调制形式）。

Result: **视觉引导四足运动（Easy任务，τ=500）**：
- Co⁴-AA: S_C^eff = 20（在S_R=20时仍满足阈值，S_R=30时跌穿）
- Co⁴-ADA: S_C^eff = 10
- Transformer: S_C^eff = 2
- gMLP: 在基线即不满足可靠性条件，S_C^eff未定义

**视觉引导四足运动（Complex任务，τ=300）**：
- Co⁴: S_C^eff = 20（相比Transformer的S_C^eff=2，可靠运行范围扩大10倍）
- Transformer: S_C^eff = 2
- gMLP: 在S_R=10后即跌穿阈值

**Car Racing（τ=300）**：
- Co⁴: S_C^eff = 4（约100次迭代收敛）
- Transformer: S_C^eff = 2（需近500次迭代收敛）

**注意力可视化**：Co⁴表现出比Transformer更稀疏、选择性更强的注意力模式，注意力在远距离时集中在即时相关可穿越区域，随障碍物接近而转移；Transformer注意力更为分散，覆盖背景区域。

Co⁴在匹配参数量的条件下实现更高的行为可靠性和更低的FLOPs（O(N+k²)对比标准注意力的O(N²)）。

Conclusion: 本文提出S_C^eff作为新的可靠AI基准，确立"扩展S_C，而非仅仅扩展FLOPs、参数和数据"的新扩展原则。Co⁴架构（受意识处理的细胞机制启发）在零样本时序泛化上显著优于Transformer和gMLP基线，作者假设其优势源于更强的"具身想象力"（grounded imagination）能力。证明Co⁴调制方程的消融实验移除了大部分性能优势，证实上下文调制对习得任务表现的功能重要性。未来工作将把该挑战应用于最先进AI和新兴世界模型，以及主动推断等计算框架，并明确研究具身想象力的底层机制。

Abstract: This paper challenges the understanding capabilities of existing AI paradigms and emerging world models by asking a fundamental question: How quickly can reality change before an intelligent system can no longer reliably perceive, reason, and act? We formulate this as a theory- and model-agnostic challenge in which systems must infer reliable actions for increasingly distant future states across a growing observation--reality gap. We operationalize this challenge through the effective Speed of Coherent Cognition (\(S_C^{\mathrm{eff}}\)), defined as the highest tested Speed of Reality (\(S_R\)) through which a system continuously satisfies a predefined behavioural reliability criterion from baseline. As a proof of concept, reinforcement-learning agents are trained at the baseline \(S_R\) and evaluated, without retraining, as \(S_R\) is increased by up to \(50\times\) while computational resources remain fixed. We compare Transformer and gated-MLP baselines with \(Co^4\), an architecture inspired by cellular mechanisms implicated in conscious processing and awake thought. Across the tested scenarios, \(Co^4\) achieves substantially higher \(S_C^{\mathrm{eff}}\) than the baselines, motivating \(S_C^{\mathrm{eff}}\) as a new benchmark and the scaling of coherent cognition as a principle for reliable AI.

</details>


### [311] [ARIA: Runtime Inspection and Amendment for Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20780)
*Bolin Shen,Yushun Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ARIA提出了一种面向LLM多智能体系统（MAS）的运行时检查与修复框架，通过将执行验证的修复转化为可复用的监督信号，构建了首个大规模失败-修复配对数据集（3,953对），并通过三阶段后训练（结构化SFT、结果锚定偏好学习、执行反馈策略优化）使紧凑模型学会在执行进行中判断何时干预以及如何修正，使7B模型在事后和运行时修复场景下均取得SOTA性能，并可泛化到未见过的框架和骨干模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM多智能体系统通过分工协作提升复杂任务表现，但局部错误会沿依赖链传播，使可纠正的小错演变为整体任务失败。现有事后诊断和测试时重复重执行的方法存在三大挑战：缺乏将失败与执行验证修复配对的大规模监督；缺少系统化的源配置选择策略；逐事件修正无法直接转化为对未完成轨迹的干预策略。

Method: 核心方法包含两部分：(1) **数据集构建**：在4个MAS框架、6个基准、8个宿主模型上采集超过24,000条轨迹，提出基于"修复最优性"的源选择规则 S(c)=(1-a(c))r(c)，通过"修复归因"(RA)将局部失败机制映射为干预方案，仅保留修复后通过基准评估而原始版本失败的配对，最终得到3,953对验证修复对；(2) **三阶段后训练**：阶段1为结构化SFT学习输出 (诊断, 切点, 替换) 并联合训练检查门控；阶段2为DPO偏好学习，将验证修复优于失败延续，并对诊断做基于"校准兄弟"的提升度排序；阶段3为执行反馈的策略优化（GRPO），奖励包含任务恢复、有害干预惩罚和执行开销，诊断与修复token使用单独归一化优势，对检查门控使用配对种子的结果差奖励。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-7B骨干的事后修复中，ARIA整体SR达35.3%（优于DoVer 5.69%、Who&When 31.6%），且EB最低；在运行时修复中ARIA以更低HIR取得最高SR（21.4%，HIR 2.00%）；泛化至未见的Magentic-One系统时，各规模下SR与域内几乎一致；消融表明三阶段互补：阶段2主要降低HIR，阶段3主要提升恢复，完整管线同时改进SR和HIR；模型规模从1.5B到14B单调提升性能与选择性，跨族控制Llama-3.1-8B表现接近Qwen2.5-7B。

Conclusion: ARIA确立了"执行验证修复学习"作为提升MAS可靠性的一条有效路径，将昂贵的修复搜索从测试时转移到数据构建与训练中，使单一紧凑模型在一次前向传播中输出诊断、切入点和替换续段，并通过前缀级门控实现选择性干预，在事后与运行时修复、跨框架与跨骨干泛化、低执行开销与低有害干预率方面均展示了优越性，为构建更可靠的LLM多智能体系统提供了新范式。

Abstract: In LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS), a local mistake can propagate as other agents build on it, turning a correctable error into a failed task. Diagnosing completed runs or repeatedly re-executing them to search for corrections does not provide a learned policy for intervening while execution is still in progress. We present Agent Runtime Inspection and Amendment (ARIA), a framework for learning when and how to repair ongoing multi-agent executions. Our key intuition is to turn execution-verified repairs into reusable supervision, moving repair search into data construction and training so that a learned model can intervene at runtime without repeatedly testing alternatives. First, we collect over 24{,}000 successful and failed trajectories across four multi-agent frameworks, six benchmarks, and eight host models. From these trajectories, we construct the ARIA dataset, to our knowledge the first large-scale dataset pairing failed multi-agent trajectories with execution-verified repairs. It contains 3{,}953 verified repair pairs, each specifying what went wrong, where to intervene, and how execution should continue. Then, we develop the ARIA framework for MAS-agnostic runtime inspection and amendment, designed to integrate with any MAS that exposes execution trajectories and supports continuation replacement. Using verified repairs as training examples, we teach a compact model to recognize when intervention is needed and how to correct an ongoing run. The aim is to learn repair strategies that apply to related failures in new configurations, rather than merely reproduce individual corrections. Finally, the trained ARIA model demonstrates strong repair performance in both post-hoc and runtime settings, with generalization to unseen frameworks and host models. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [312] [Open-world AI: a Tale of Three Requirements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20782)
*Jianyu Zhang,Léon Bottou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对开放世界AI提出三项核心要求（推理时学习、丰富表示、预测解耦），并通过理论推导与8B规模语言模型实验，定性地验证了满足这些要求的模型能随相关任务数据的积累而持续提升，反之则会退化，且无法通过单纯扩大规模或交错层类型来修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI主要在"封闭世界"范式下运作：通过明确的成功标准收集i.i.d.数据并迭代改进，但这限制了机器仅能处理训练任务，即便大语言模型展现出广泛的上下文学习能力，其本质仍是工业化的封闭世界循环，且现代上下文学习存在脆弱性（更多演示反而降低性能）。论文重新审视1956年达特茅斯提案的初衷——让机器获得处理未预建任务的通用能力（versatility），即"开放世界AI"的需求。

Method: 论文以任务共享潜在因子为建模假设，将训练目标围绕贝叶斯最优预测分解为两部分：(1) 表示永久丢弃信息的度量ℓ_θ，(2) 内学习器距离贝叶斯最优的差距ℓ_f。由此推导出三项要求——推理时学习（任务在训练时未知）、丰富表示（大l下ℓ_f消失使优化压力落在表示上）、预测解耦（小l下表示分组以匹配输入输出的低维分组以降低样本复杂度）。并预测两个设计要点：一致的内学习器（l→∞时ℓ_f→0）以及将目标任务与相关任务分开处理的二阶段长上下文。实验在1.5B和8B规模语言模型上对比Memory Mosaics（一致的高斯核回归内学习器）、Transformer（rope注意力，位置衰减限制有效记忆）、DeltaNet（固定状态大小）、Hybrid SWA、Hybrid DeltaNet等架构，采用定性比较（看符号不看数值），以k-means聚类构建任务和"相关任务"。

Result: Memory Mosaics（满足所有要求）在所有评估长度下都受益于更大的训练长度l，且GSM8K微调精度随l系统提升；而不满足一致性要求的Transformer、DeltaNet、Hybrid SWA、Hybrid DeltaNet则随l增大性能退化或停滞。预测解耦实验中，G（组/头数）增大时Memory Mosaics精度提升，Transformer和Hybrid SWA则下降。推理时增加相关任务数量时，单阶段模型在训练长度附近达到峰值后下降或持平，而二阶段Memory Mosaics+和二阶段Transformer+持续改进，且8B规模下趋势不变（即便Memory Mosaics参数量更少）。结论：满足三项要求的模型随相关任务数据积累而提升，其余则退化，规模和层类型交错均无法修复。

Conclusion: 开放世界AI要求机器能够处理未预建的新任务。论文通过理论推导得出三项核心要求（推理时学习、丰富表示、预测解耦）及两个预测（一致的内学习器、分离目标与相关任务），并在语言模型上以定性方式验证：满足要求的模型随训练长度或相关任务数量增加而改进，不满足的则退化。研究表明结构而非单纯规模才是通往开放世界AI的关键要素。

Abstract: The closed world asks AI for specialized competence and lets it manufacture the iid data its theory assumes: a fixed criterion licenses collecting examples until the task is covered. The open world asks for versatility --- taking up tasks a machine was not built for, from few examples and with little prior from a human designer --- and offers data that is grouped, not shuffled. Its tasks are not known in advance, so a machine must do inference-time learning (1st requirement). Modeling tasks as sharing latent factors and decomposing the training objective, we derive two more: a *rich representation*, retaining more than iid generalization requires, and a predictive disentanglement that aligns inputs and outputs into matched low-dimensional groups. The analysis further predicts the need for a consistent inner learner, and the benefit of long contexts spanning related tasks. We test these claims on language models up to 8B, asking whether a model has a property (qualitative) rather than how much it wins (quantitative). Models that meet the requirements improve as data from related tasks accumulates; the rest degrade, and neither scale nor layer-type interleaving repairs this.

</details>


### [313] [EvolvingBrain: An Adaptive Skill System for Multi-modal Agents Self-Evolution in Open Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20786)
*Runxuan Liu,Jingqi Shi,Baoxin Wang,Honghong Zhao,Haoyuan Xu,Yueqing Sun,Jiafeng Liang,Tao He,Dayong Wu,Qi Gu,Shijin Wang,Ming Liu,Bing Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EvolvingBrain框架,通过自适应技能系统实现多模态智能体在开放世界中的自我进化,在VAB-Minecraft和DiscoveryWorld两个基准上显著提升任务成功率,并具备良好的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态智能体在开放世界交互中自我进化能力有限:监督微调只能实现模仿而无法主动组织经验,基于结果的强化学习虽促进探索但未能充分利用中间轨迹信息。现有技能方法主要从成功轨迹提取流程性指导,未能同时学习成功与失败轨迹,缺乏环境反馈驱动的知识验证与进化机制,也缺少根据当前状态进行多粒度知识组织与检索的方法。

Method: 提出EvolvingBrain,采用冻结的多模态智能体加外部"技能大脑"的两层架构,包含两大组件:(1) 分层技能自进化:从模型自身成功/失败轨迹中提取过程模式(Procedural Patterns)与问题模式(Problematic Patterns),通过多轮环境交互迭代进化,形成由Domain Skill(领域技能)、Plan Skill(规划技能)、Action Skill(动作技能)与Trap Skill(陷阱技能)组成的分层技能架构,Trap技能通过重试机制验证与修订;(2) 状态感知自适应执行:将长程交互历史抽象为结构化摘要记忆(Structured Abstractive Memory),包含已确认进展、未解决问题、失效尝试等,通过状态感知门控(Plan/Action/Trap)与图邻居+全局原子库检索,将相关技能按当前状态融合为临时Active Guidance,实现多粒度知识的动态调用。技能大脑在测试时冻结,所有技能仅来源于目标智能体自身的轨迹。

Result: 在VAB-Minecraft和DiscoveryWorld两个开放世界基准上,使用Qwen3.8-27B、Kimi-K3、GPT-5.6-Sol三种骨干模型进行评测:相比直接执行,平均成功率分别提升11.64和8.44个百分点;在VAB-Minecraft上优于MMSkills基线6.97个百分点。消融实验验证了Trap技能(额外+3.49/+3.37 pp)、自适应粒度检索、迭代自进化(3轮vs 1轮,平均+3.89/+3.60 pp)的贡献。在DiscoveryWorld的域外泛化测试中,30个未见主题任务的平均成功率提升10.37 pp,且域内到域外的性能下降幅度小于直接执行方式(12.42 vs 14.36 pp)。实验还揭示能力-粒度对齐现象:弱模型受益于细粒度显式指导,强模型偏好紧凑的高层抽象。

Conclusion: EvolvingBrain通过将成功与失败交互提炼为层次化、模型特定的技能大脑,并按执行状态检索融合所需知识,实现了多模态智能体在开放世界中的自进化。该方法在三个骨干模型、两个基准上均取得一致性能提升,并能泛化至未见领域。局限在于:尚未在更广泛的真实场景中验证,在线技能进化效率有待提升。

Abstract: Multi-modal agents have made significant progress in interacting with open worlds. However, their ability to self-evolve remains limited. Supervised fine-tuning enables imitation but not active experience organization, while outcome-based reinforcement learning promotes exploration yet underuses intermediate trajectory information. Therefore, we propose EvolvingBrain, which uses an adaptive skill system as the brain for agent self-evolution, consisting of two following components. Stratified Skill Self-Evolution: extracts Procedural Patterns and Problematic Patterns from model-specific trajectories, summarizes experience by generating skills, and evolves through multiple interactions with the open world, ultimately forming a Stratified Skill Architecture consisting of Domain, Plan, and Action/Trap Skills, which provides the agent with a multi-granularity knowledge repository and a novel evolution approach. State-Aware Adaptive Execution: summarizes long-horizon interactions into Structured Abstractive Memory and uses it to guide the State-Aware Skill Fusion Strategy, enabling the agent to utilize knowledge according to its current state. Experiments on VAB-Minecraft and DiscoveryWorld demonstrate that EvolvingBrain improves success rates on open-world tasks and exhibits generalization capabilities. Our code is provided in the supplementary materials and will be publicly released in the camera-ready version.

</details>


### [314] [When Reasoning Traces Conflict with Evidence: How Answer Configuration Shapes Evidence Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20805)
*Shaoang Li,Yanhang Shi,Jian Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了大语言模型在答案生成阶段如何处理推理痕迹(thinking trace)与当前证据之间的冲突,发现"答案配置"(answer configuration,即续写模型自身思维还是进行独立的答案调用)显著影响模型是否遵从当前证据,但几乎不影响从痕迹中获得的准确率收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多阶段工作流中,模型先产生的推理痕迹可能在答案生成阶段与新证据产生冲突。研究者需要厘清两个独立的问题:(1)痕迹对最终答案准确率的贡献;(2)当痕迹与当前证据冲突时,答案遵循哪一方。传统仅通过删除痕迹来评估的方法无法区分这两个性质。

Method: 设计交叉冲突协议:为HotpotQA桥接型和MuSiQue两跳型问题构造两个版本的支持证据(原文E₀与编辑版E₁,替换gold答案为同类型反事实答案),由验证模型确认后保留683对HotpotQA与417对MuSiQue证据对;每个模型从两个证据版本分别生成痕迹r₀、r₁,保留两个痕迹各自明确陈述各自证据版本的答案的配对;在答案阶段比较两种配置:(1)续写——在模型自身思维块中插入痕迹继续生成;(2)独立调用——以用户消息形式输入痕迹并关闭思维;两种配置共享相同的痕迹与证据。在gpt-oss-20b、Gemma4-E4B、Qwen3-14B(以及辅助的Qwen3-4B/8B/32B、Qwen3.5-4B、DeepSeek-V4-Pro)上,测量证据遵循率与痕迹贡献,并进行答案时间消融、推理时间消融、跨阶段替换与修复,以及输入顺序、验证指令与重新推理的对比实验。

Result: 三种模型在HotpotQA与MuSiQue上,独立调用相对续写将证据遵循率提高29.9至60.6个百分点(95% bootstrap区间均大于零);而删除痕迹在两种配置下造成的准确率损失差异不超过4.7个百分点。续写在65.6%至87.0%的冲突中重复痕迹的过时结论。输入顺序(证据在痕迹之前还是之后)解释了Gemma4-E4B与Qwen3-14B配置差距的60%至91%,但对gpt-oss-20b影响较小。验证指令几乎不能削弱痕迹的束缚(73.6%仍遵循痕迹,而续写为72.2%),但重新推理在86.6%的冲突中遵循当前证据。痕迹的价值大部分集中在最后一行;移除最后一行损失2.9至8.5点EM,只保留最后一行在2.0点EM以内。干扰项削弱独立调用的纠错能力(尤其Qwen3-14B)。

Conclusion: 利用痕迹与遵从该论据是可分开的性质:删除痕迹测试无法揭示答案在冲突中遵循哪个来源。基于当前证据的证据遵循型评估应同时报告痕迹贡献、冲突响应与匹配单元准确率,并明确说明答案配置(痕迹位置、思维开关、输入顺序、指令、输出预算)。实践上,在推理后接收到新证据的系统应优先使用独立调用纠正;重新推理是更强的纠正但代价更高;阶段分离的消融支持在撰写痕迹之前改善检索证据。

Abstract: A reasoning trace retained at answer time plays two roles: it can raise accuracy, and it can compete with the current evidence when the two disagree. We disentangle these roles by crossing verified evidence versions with the traces generated from each and answering from the same traces and evidence under two configurations: continuation of the model's own thinking and a separate answer call. Across three model families (gpt-oss, Gemma4, Qwen3) on HotpotQA and MuSiQue, the separate call raises evidence-following over continuation by 29.9 to 60.6 points. On the same pairs, removing the trace lowers accuracy by similar amounts under both configurations. Yet continuation repeats the stale conclusion in most conflicts, and the separate call follows the current evidence far more often. Benefiting from a trace and deferring to it are therefore distinct properties. Further analyses show that the final line of a trace carries most of its value, gold evidence helps most before the trace is written, distractors weaken correction under a separate call, and renewed reasoning, unlike a verification instruction, follows the current evidence in most conflicts. Because trace deletion alone cannot reveal which source an answer follows, evaluations should report both properties together with the answer configuration.

</details>


### [315] [A Self-Improving Agent that Grows its Own DSL: Oracle-Free Operator Induction for Exact Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20809)
*Yun-Shiuan Chuang,Yirou Ge,Yixi Li,Yiming Bian,Zijie Pan,Jenna L. Ballard,Uma Kona,Linsey Pang,Prakhar Mehrotra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需奖励、无需评判模型、无需答案键的自改进智能体机制，在一个小而精确的领域特定语言（DSL）上通过内外双循环自主扩展可计算能力。内循环通过两个独立编写的表达式在每条记录上的一致性来扩展可回答问题集；外循环在能力缺口被反复请求时自动编写新算子，并仅在独立实现一致且满足守恒律的条件下接纳，从而无需真值标签即可精确验证。实验表明内循环将可回答问题类型扩大约三倍，外循环在三个独立起始集上自主接纳了基础闭包之外的算子；接纳规则在变异研究中以0/138的误接纳率拒绝全部错误算子变体，且独立参考由不同模型家族（Gemma-3-27B）生成时同样保持可靠。同一机制无需代码修改即可迁移至商业账本（BookSQL）和临床病历（EHRSQL/MIMIC-III）两个不相关领域，可回答集分别增长超十倍和近二十倍；在Qwen、Mistral、Gemma、Llama四个模型家族中均保持门的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自改进智能体依赖奖励信号、评判模型或库压缩等"教师式"信号来接纳新技能，但这些信号无法保证答案的精确性——错误技能同样可能得分高、说服评判或压缩漂亮。在需要精确答案的场景（如事务表上的总额计算）下，这类信号不足。本文要回答的更困难问题是：能否在没有奖励、没有评判、没有答案键的条件下，让智能体扩展其可计算能力，同时保持每个答案可被可信赖的程序精确检查。

Method: 单一冻结模型运行两个嵌套在小型精确DSL上的循环。内循环（InnerLoop）：在不增加算子的前提下，模型提出新问题并用当前算子编写表达式求解；再用独立编写的第二个表达式验证，若两者在每条记录上的值签名（value signature）一致且结果是新的，则接受。外循环（OuterLoop）：当内循环反复请求某个超出当前算子闭包的能力时，模型统计最被请求的缺口并自行编写新算子；接纳需通过"无神谕验证门"，包括（1）差分测试——两个独立实现必须在所有验证记录及模糊输入上完全一致；（2）蜕变测试——必须满足基于已有可信算子陈述的守恒律（如按组分组的总和等于全体总和）；（3）下游回环——该算子解锁的每个新问题仍须通过内循环的独立一致性检验。整个基底（substrate）采用"无方法"（method-free）的Python子集，禁止属性访问与方法调用，保证可审计性且无法逃逸到任意计算。

Result: 内循环在金融事务QA上将可回答类型从10种基础扩展到约63种（在三轮内），平均每轮+18.3种；外循环在三个独立起始集上分别接纳6、5、2个不同的按组聚合算子，均位于各自起始闭包之外，无诱导控制组在新问题上得零分。接纳规则在138个单点变异算子上实现0/138的误接纳（独立参考），即使参考由不同模型家族（Gemma-3-27B）独立生成亦然；最坏相关情形下仅10/138漏过。同一机制在BookSQL上将15→162种（超十倍增长）、在EHRSQL上将13→248种（近二十倍增长）。在Qwen3系列4B到32B密集模型和Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE模型上门的可靠性均成立；Mistral-Small-24B、Llama-3.3-70B同样可以驱动自扩展，Gemma-3-27B因编译率较低而扩展较少但仍无误纳。人工验证（3位标注者盲评150个问题-表达式对和53个诱导算子）显示89%表达式忠实、97%问题良构、所有诱导算子的两套独立实现被一致判定为等价。

Conclusion: 本文证明了"无教师"自扩展的可行性：一个冻结模型通过双循环机制和一个仅依赖独立一致性加守恒律的接纳门，能够在无需奖励、评判或答案键的情况下精确扩展其DSL。三层验证（差分、蜕变、回环）相互补足；最常被请求的能力——按组聚合——可纳入，而缺乏守恒律的"众数取值"则被合理地排除。该方法在多个领域和模型家族间可迁移，但接纳产出仍受基底吞吐量限制（多数草稿因引用方法调用而被沙盒拒绝），且扩展轮次和定标到极大多轮仍未系统验证。

Abstract: A self-improving agent has to decide which new skills to keep, and in practice it keeps whatever earns a high reward, convinces a judge model, or compresses its library, even when the skill is wrong. That is fine until the answers have to be exactly right: over a table of transactions, a total is either right or wrong. We ask a harder question: can an agent grow what it can compute with no reward, no judge, and no answer key, and still be exactly right? A single frozen model runs two nested loops over a small, exact domain-specific language (DSL). The inner loop answers new questions only when two independently written expressions agree on every record. The outer loop discovers its own missing capability and authors an operator for it, admitted only when an independent second implementation agrees and the result obeys a conservation law, all without ground truth. The inner loop roughly triples the answerable-question set, and the outer loop self-extends on disjoint starting sets, inventing operators outside the starting closure; a no-induction control answers none of the new questions. The admission rule is empirically sound: it rejects 138 of 138 buggy operator variants under an independent reference, even one written by a different model family, where the admit-if-it-runs, self-consistency, and compression signals the field relies on admit most of them. Unmodified, the same mechanism self-extends on two further domains with unrelated schemas, business-ledger and clinical-encounter question answering, growing their answerable sets more than tenfold and nearly twentyfold. The loop transfers across model families too: run with further proposers, the gate stays sound and independent families self-extend comparably, with only the induction yield tracking each proposer's DSL fluency.

</details>


### [316] [Temporal Specification Guidance for Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20822)
*Avishree Khare,Hideki Okamoto,Bardh Hoxha,Georgios Fainekos,Rajeev Alur*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Temporal Specification Guidance（TSG），一种无需训练的推理时框架，通过将时序逻辑规范（Metric Temporal Logic）转化为可微分数分，并将梯度转化为注意力偏置来引导文生视频模型的采样过程，在220条提示的11类时序约束基准上，相对CFG将规范满足准确率提升9.5–20个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文生视频模型虽然能生成提示中提及的视觉概念，但常常无法满足自然语言描述中的时序需求（顺序、时刻与持续性）。作者希望引入形式化时序逻辑作为可执行目标，将时序约束转化为可引导生成的方向。

Method: TSG框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 利用视频–文本注意力提取视觉概念在潜空间时间维度上的存在迹（attention-derived temporal traces）；(2) 提出LogSTOP——一种对Metric Temporal Logic（MTLf）的高效可微和对数域量化语义，支持O(|φ|·Tz)的线性时间评估；(3) 计算规范分数对注意力迹的梯度，作为注意力logit偏置施加到各层各头中，从而改变条件前向传播的输出方向。生成的"规范引导方向" d_{k,φ} 与CFG方向 d_{k,cfg} 线性组合为 d_{k,tsg}，无需对transformer权重反向传播。规范可由LLM从prompt中抽取或手动提供。

Result: 在自建的220条prompt（11类区间定时约束：状态转移、有序出场、持续存在、交叠交接、退出与回归等）基准上，使用CogVideoX-2B/5B、Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B、Wan2.2-TI2V-5B、Wan2.2-T2V-A14B共五个模型，TSG将规范满足准确率相对CFG提高9.5–20个百分点，且峰值GPU显存几乎不增加（注意力图分离梯度图）。在TempoControl严格定时基准上，TSG比CFG提升17.6–22.0个百分点，匹配甚至略超完整TempoControl的时序精度，但峰值显存降低约62%（79.43→30.52 GiB）、延迟降低约4.9×。可视化质量（VBench MUSIQ-SPAQ）在四个模型上下降≤3.0分，A14B上提升3.2分。最佳引导强度为ρ=1，过度引导会降低准确率。

Conclusion: TSG证明形式化时序规范加可微满足目标为视频生成的时序控制提供了灵活接口，无需重训练或外部概念分类器，仅通过注意力干预即可在多模型、多架构（CogVideoX和Wan）上显著提升时序约束满足度。局限是受限于模型潜在时间分辨率，不能实现帧级细粒度时序控制。

Abstract: Text-to-video models often generate the visual concepts requested in natural language prompts but fail to satisfy their intended ordering, timing, and persistence requirements. We propose representing these requirements as specifications in a formal Temporal Logic, and introduce Temporal Specification Guidance (TSG), a training-free inference-time framework that turns temporal specifications into executable objectives for guiding video generation during sampling. TSG scores traces of visual concept evidence using differentiable quantitative semantics and uses the score's gradients to construct a specification-guided denoising direction. We instantiate this framework with video-text attention traces, efficient differentiable scores for Metric Temporal Logic, and gradient-derived attention biases. This instantiation requires neither an external concept classifier nor backpropagation through the video transformer. Its attention-steered forward pass yields a denoising direction that augments classifier-free guidance (CFG). On a benchmark of 220 prompts spanning 11 categories of temporal constraints, including ordered object entry and state transitions, this instantiation improves specification satisfaction accuracy over CFG by 9.5-20 percentage points across five models, with minimal memory overhead. These results demonstrate the potential of temporal specifications and differentiable satisfaction objectives as a flexible interface for controlling video generation.

</details>


### [317] [Confidence-Calibrated Inference Expansion for Evaluator-Guided Test-Time Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20836)
*Weida Liang,Kenji Kawaguchi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种面向评估器引导的测试时推理的置信度校准推理扩展控制器，将推理分配建模为三动作决策（trust/fallback/expand），通过动作特定置信度估计、校准及局部不确定性惩罚来优化效用-计算权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着评估器引导的自适应测试时推理（如采样更多候选链、重排序、自我修订）日益普及，部署时面临核心的局部控制问题：在每个中间推理状态，是否值得为该实例再投入一个推理单位的计算？原始评估器分数不足以回答此问题——高验证分数不等于应停止，低判断分数也不意味着应回退。需要一个计算感知的决策机制。

Method: 将评估器引导推理建模为三动作（trust/fallback/expand）有限期控制器：trust 输出当前评估器优选答案，fallback 输出保守答案（宽度扩展中为多数投票，修订扩展中为回滚），expand 再进行一次推理步。对每个动作学习一个轻量级 sigmoid 置信度头，并用离线完整阶梯回溯提供与控制器对齐的目标进行训练，再用独立校准集做后置校准（Platt/温度/保序回归）。从校准残差估计动作特定的局部不确定性半径 β ε̂_p，对模糊决策施加惩罚。理论方面：证明了局部动作一致性引理（2δ_J < Γ* 时控制器与最优策略一致）和沿展开路径累积的有限期置信度遗憾界，以及访问状态覆盖下的轨迹遗憾界。实验在 MATH/AIME25 的验证器引导宽度扩展和从 OpenThoughts-114k 筛选的判断引导修订扩展两个场景下评估，使用 Qwen3-4B/8B 与 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B，部署目标为 U=S−λC（λ=0.02）。

Result: 在 MATH/AIME25 宽度扩展上，置信度+不确定性控制器在效用 0.715、计算量 0.547 处工作点，匹配 N=48 多数投票效用但计算量减少约 45%，相比校准选择的固定策略（N=32 多数投票，效用 0.707/计算 0.781），效用提升 0.008，计算量减少 30%。在通用推理修订扩展上达到效用 0.673/计算 0.529，相比固定深度策略（0.668/0.632）效用提升 0.005，计算量减少 16%。校准将所有动作头的 ECE 降低；90% 覆盖目标下展开头经验覆盖率为 0.882（宽度）和 0.861（修订）。四个 Qwen3-8B 种子配对 Student-t 检验：在所有 8 个种子-场景中计算量都低于 fitted Q，效用区间包含零，方向混合（宽度 2/4、修订 3/4 利于该方法）。消融显示分离头部+每动作校准贡献最大（宽度效用 +0.004），局部不确定性额外减少宽度计算 0.039/修订 0.050，加入 fallback 动作贡献宽度 +0.006/修订 +0.010 效用。修订动态显示在第 3 轮时成功率从 0.681 轻微下降到 0.673（修正率 0.101 vs 损坏率 0.058），随后第 4 轮回升至 0.688。

Conclusion: 该工作将评估器引导的测试时推理重新定位为不确定性下的资源分配问题，并证明所提出的轻量级三动作控制器（动作特定置信度+校准+局部不确定性惩罚）在两种扩展机制下都能以更低计算达到与固定策略可比的观测效用。理论结果刻画了评分误差与计算调整动作差距的关系及沿展开路径的遗憾累积。实践启示是：评估器反馈应作为停止-继续决策的输入而非单纯的置信替代物，推理分配具有实例依赖性。

Abstract: Evaluator-guided reasoning presents a local control problem at every step: trust the current answer, return a fallback, or spend more inference. We formulate this choice as a compute-aware three-action controller, scoring terminal actions by predicted answer success and expansion by a rollout-based continuation-success surrogate, with compute cost priced explicitly. A local action-gap analysis characterizes when score errors can change a decision, while an expected regret bound accounts for errors along the realized expansion path. Guided by this analysis, we learn and calibrate action-specific confidence estimates, with local uncertainty penalties for ambiguous decisions. On held-out width expansion and revision tasks, the controller improves observed utility over calibration-selected fixed policies while reducing normalized online compute by about 30% and 16%, respectively. Across four Qwen3-8B seeds, compute is lower than fitted Q in both settings, while utility differences are small and mixed. The results frame evaluator-guided reasoning as resource allocation under uncertainty, rather than a uniformly stronger reasoner.

</details>


### [318] [Evolving Together, Failing Apart: The Skill-Policy Co-evolution Trap in Self-Improving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20845)
*Yujie Feng,Xiaobin Wang,Jinluan Yang,Xiaonan Shi,Pengjun Xie,Philip S. Yu,Xiaoming Wu,Jieping Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了技能-策略协同进化（skill-policy co-evolution）范式中被忽视的"协同进化陷阱"：现有评估方法在固定的"交付技能库"上测试策略，而部署时技能库会持续漂移，导致协同进化的策略对其共训练的技能库过度依赖，性能大幅下降。论文提出CODA（CO-evolution Drift Audit）评估协议，量化这种脆弱性：最坏情况下会损失交付库增益的52-93%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有协同进化方法（如SkillRL、ReSkill等）报告的"峰值性能"是在与其协同训练的固定技能库上测得的，但实际部署中技能库会不断修改、新增或删除。现有评估协议无法捕捉这种部署时的技能漂移，可能高估策略的真实可用能力。

Method: 1）理论分析：将现有方法共享的"合作式接受规则"（cooperative acceptance，即仅保留能提升当前策略性能的技能）形式化为理想化选择规则，证明交付的(策略,技能库)对在其候选邻域内必然处于局部峰值，使得任何内容级修改都无法提升性能。2）实证方法：提出"协同进化脆弱性曲线"（co-evolution Fragility Curve），沿训练轨迹追踪检查点对固定扰动的敏感度变化。3）提出CODA协议：在五个扰动轴（语义改写T1、不完整T2、误导性T3、生态系统变化T4、自主性移除T5）上审计交付对，搭配固定改写套件。指标包括：净技能收益门控、一致性率CR（T1下结果翻转比例）、抗性率RR（T2/T3下保持任务可解的比例）、最坏情况成功率SR_min。

Result: 在SkillRL/ReSkill/Evolving-RL/ARISE四种方法、五个基准（ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld、Mind2Web、AMC23）的六个设置上：1）理论预测在18/18个轴-设置对中验证成立（无内容级改写能超越评价噪声）。2）最坏情况成功率比峰值低5–13分，吞噬了52–93%的交付库相对无技能基线的增益。3）一致性率77.5–87.0均低于噪声底线（91.9–94.4），即13–23%的任务在含义保持的改写下翻转结果，而解码噪声仅导致6–8%翻转，表明策略过度依赖用词而非语义。4）脆弱性随训练推进而增加（5/6设置中至少一个内容级轴的Drop斜率显著为正）。

Conclusion: 该工作将协同进化的评估目标从"在协同训练库上的峰值性能"重新定位为"在技能持续演化时仍能稳定使用技能的能力"。CODA协议提供了一个共享标准，供未来方法审计其交付策略-技能库对的部署稳健性。本研究指出了问题并提供了测量工具，但未提出缓解方法；未来方向是面向银行扰动分布（而非单一固定银行）训练的分布式目标。

Abstract: Skill-policy co-evolution, in which an agent's policy model and its skill bank improve each other during training, is a promising paradigm for self-improving agents. Current evaluations score the co-evolved policy on the final bank it trained with (the delivered bank). After deployment, however, skills may be rewritten, added or removed more frequently than the policy model is retrained, leaving the policy to operate on a drifted skill bank that neither the training objective nor existing evaluation protocols address. In this paper, we first establish, through theoretical and empirical analysis, that the fragility hidden by this blind spot is not incidental. The acceptance rule these methods share (cooperative acceptance) ties a policy's competence to the bank it co-evolved with, leaving it fragile once skills drift, regardless of the implementation; empirically, sensitivity to skill drift grows as co-evolution training proceeds. We therefore introduce the CO-evolution Drift Audit (CODA), a deployment-oriented evaluation protocol that simulates skill drift and, alongside success rate under worst-case drift, introduces two new metrics: a consistency rate under meaning-preserving edits and a resistance rate to corrupted skills. Across four co-evolution methods and five benchmarks (six settings), worst-case success is 5-13 points below the peak measured for each delivered pair, erasing 52-93% of the delivered bank's gain over the no-skill baseline. CODA thus reframes the target of co-evolution, from peak performance on the co-evolved bank to the ability to harness skills however they evolve, and provides a shared standard against which future methods can be audited.

</details>


### [319] [Anticipatory Commonsense with Moving Objects: An ASP-Based Framework for Predictive Reasoning with Interacting Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20867)
*Julius Monsen,Jakob Suchan,Mehul Bhatt*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个用于复杂动态环境中交互运动预测的声明式（declarative）混合AI框架，结合ASP（Answer Set Programming）进行高层常识推理与基于能量的优化进行低层轨迹评估，在Argoverse 2基准上实现可解释的事件级轨迹预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前端到端的轨迹预测方法侧重于几何精度，缺乏对交互行为"为什么发生"的语义解释能力，难以满足AI可信度（可解释性、可验证性）的要求，特别是在自动驾驶等安全关键领域。人类驾驶员能够构建时空心理模型，预测交互结果，而这正是物理AI所需的核心能力。

Method: 三阶段混合框架：(1) 基于事件演算的ASP模型，刻画交互式运动轨迹的动态特性（fluents与events）；(2) 语义引导的预测，通过溯因推理（abduction）生成分支轨迹未来（branching trajectory futures）；(3) 基于能量的优化模型（EBM），结合多样性过滤与上下文/轨迹双编码器，对候选轨迹进行排序与筛选。低层轨迹预测采用车道引导的恒速模型。

Result: 在Argoverse 2测试集（19,178场景）上：top-1 minADE=5.11m, minFDE=12.90m，相比恒速基线（7.75m/17.44m）显著提升；与无预期基线几何精度相当但增加多样性与可解释性。EBM在top-1选择时明显优于多样性过滤（5.11m vs 5.48m minADE），并在所有k值上提升事件级指标（EF1, NESE）。每场景平均运行约2.8秒，ASP求解开销极小（0.12s grounding, 0.007s solving）。

Conclusion: 该框架通过将事件结构作为预测的"基底"而非"渲染"，使得每个分支轨迹都携带可检验的事件级假设，为可信赖AI提供了形式化、可验证的解释机制。相较于DeMo、MARC等方法，在保持竞争力的预测精度的同时，提供了真正的语义级可解释性与溯因推理能力。未来工作将结合神经符号视觉技术与视觉语言模型。

Abstract: We present a general declarative framework for anticipatory reasoning about interactive motion in complex dynamic environments. Our focus is on (explainable) anticipatory space-time mental model formation at a semantic level to heuristically guide low-level motion computation. Our method is hybrid, modular and elaboration tolerant integrating: 1) An ASP model characterising the dynamics of interactive motion trajectories; 2) Semantically-guided prediction for deriving `branching trajectory futures'; and 3) An energy-based {optimisation} model to evaluate, rank and filter anticipations. We evaluate with the Argoverse 2 benchmark, where each anticipated trajectory carries an explicit, inspectable event-level hypothesis, unlike end-to-end stochastic prediction.

</details>


### [320] [A Multi-Tiered AI Accessibility Model (MAIAM): Proportionate Access and Capability Limits for Comprehensive Frontier AI Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20921)
*Chai K. Toh,Vasu Raj Jain*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出多层级人工智能可及性模型（MAIAM），主张将AI系统按能力而非发布形式分为三层（学习、探索、前沿），并结合SAFE AI Operating Point框架，强调"能力边界"与"可及性边界"需并行管理，挑战了开源/闭源二元辩论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前关于发布强AI系统的争论被简化为"API vs 开源权重"的二元对立，但实际上混淆了"系统能变得多强"与"谁可以以何种条件获得某种能力"这两个独立决策。作者认为这一框架错位阻碍了对AI治理的实质性讨论。

Method: 提出MAIAM（Multi-Tiered AI Accessibility Model）三层分类体系：第1层"学习用AI"（能力受限、广泛可及）、第2层"探索用AI"（研发用途，需注册身份与使用控制，随能力提升而收紧）、第3层"全规模前沿AI"（仅通过结构化、可记录、可问责的渠道获取）。基于能力、自主性、领域后果、用途/安全四维度给出层级分配标准；将MAIAM与SAFE AI Operating Point结合，形成"能力边界+可及性边界"的双轨治理结构。

Result: 论证了发布前沿类权重等于放弃开发者发布后的一切安全杠杆；通过安全微调可被以低成本（数百美元）从开放权重中剥离的证据，说明对基础模型的评估无法反映其衍生模型表现；提出可及性应与能力、安全性、风险成比例的核心原则。

Conclusion: 仅靠能力限制无法确保AI安全，必须叠加由监管机构管理、按能力/用途/风险分级的可及性制度；能力边界决定"不能跨越的安全上限"，可及性边界决定"谁可以在上限内获得何种能力"，二者缺一不可。

Abstract: Most debate about releasing capable AI systems treats the choice as binary: keep the model behind an API, or publish the weights. That framing runs together two separate decisions. One is how capable a system may become. The other is who may obtain a given capability, and on what terms. This paper is about the second decision. We propose a Multi-Tiered AI Accessibility Model (MAIAM) that sorts access by purpose, safety, and capability instead of by release artifact. Tier 1, AI for Learning, is broadly accessible and deliberately capability-bounded. Tier 2, AI for Exploration, serves research and development under registration, identity, and usage controls that tighten as capability rises. Tier 3, Full-Scale Frontier AI, is available only through structured, recorded, and accountable access. The principle behind the tiers is that accessibility should be proportional to capability, safety, and risk. We show why publishing frontier-class weights forfeits every safety lever a developer has after release, and, using evidence that safety fine-tuning can be stripped from open weights for a few hundred dollars, why an evaluation of the base model says little about its derivatives. We give criteria for assigning a system to a tier along capability, autonomy, domain-consequence, and usage/safety axes, and combine MAIAM with the SAFE AI Operating Point into a two-part framework: a Capability Boundary that fixes the safety limits not to be crossed, and an Accessibility Boundary that fixes who may obtain a capability below that limit. Capability limits alone do not make AI safe; a tiered access regime administered by regulating bodies is also needed.

</details>


### [321] [Defining and Generating Compositional Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20922)
*Eric Elmoznino,Tejas Kasetty,Blaise Agüera y Arcas,Yoshua Bengio,Guillaume Lajoie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文利用算法信息论，为组合结构（compositionality）提供了一个严格的数学定义：通过比较部分模型和整体模型之间无法互相恢复的结构信息量，来量化整体中涌现出的"新颖组合结构"。作者还通过可计算的近似方法，将定义反转用于生成具有层次化重用结构的字符串和图像，并探讨了其对深度学习架构设计和开放性学习课程设计的启示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合结构是自然和人工系统中产生复杂性的核心机制（如分子→细胞→器官→生物体的层级构成），但学界一直缺乏对其精确的内在定量度量。现有的形式化方法通常依赖于预设的语法、语义因子或组合规则，无法回答"对于任意对象，其内在的组合结构在哪里、有多少、如何跨尺度组织"这一基本问题。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 提出了一种基于算法信息论的定义：把对象分解为部分与整体，用最小描述长度（MDL）的奥卡姆剃刀模型来表征其结构，将"新颖组合结构"定义为：整体的最优模型相对于部分模型的不可恢复信息量，即 $C(x_a, x_b \to x) := K(m_x \mid m_{x_a}, m_{x_b})$。通过递归分解树（compositional structure profile）记录对象在多个尺度和位置上的组合结构。为处理不可计算性，采用经验上的两步编码方案：字符串用上下文无关文法（基于 MR-RePair 扩展），图像用坐标神经网络（CPPN）作为概率模型；条件压缩通过规则对齐/微调或路由学生网络来近似衡量。生成时采用 NSGA-II 和 NEAT 进化算法优化结构剖面。

Result: 在字符串和图像两种域上的实验显示，优化该定义产生的奖励能够生成明显具有层次化重复和部分-整体组织的对象：在字符串上产生更深的文法（更高嵌套层级）以及点图中更密集的模式分布；在图像上产生更连贯统一、特征可重组的结构，而非仅堆叠独立区域。相比之下，仅优化结构复杂度 $K(m_x)$ 而不施加组合性压力的奖励则产生更扁平或碎片化的结果。此外，作者验证了所提定义与其他组合性度量（算法互信息、部分信息分解、涌现理论、形式语法/组合语义、装配理论等）的关系：组合性可推出互信息，反之不一定；该定义在部分-整体内在设置上避免了PID对外部目标的依赖；对最大分解树的存在性与一致性给出了理论分析。

Conclusion: 该定义真正捕捉到了组合性，而非仅仅是复杂性、规律性或共享信息。基于此，研究者提出了对深度神经网络深度、课程学习和开放性学习的新视角：有效的模型应在多尺度上组合更低尺度的结构；学习历史 $x_a$ 与新经验 $x_b$ 之间的高 $C(x_a, x_b \to x)$ 表明课程引发了真正的新颖结构而非单纯重复或无关信息，可作为构建开放性学习课程和自主探索策略的原则。未来工作需要解决分解树的内在选择（提议最大总分解得分）、经验近似的稳定性及与不同编码器的鲁棒性问题。

Abstract: Compositional structure is pervasive in nature and across scales: atoms combine into molecules, molecules into cells, and cells into organisms, while further compositional hierarchies appear within each level. More broadly, compositionality, the reuse and recombination of parts into novel structures, is a fundamental source of interesting complexity in both natural and artificial systems. Yet despite its importance, and despite our apparent ease in recognizing it, mathematical accounts capturing what we intuitively mean by compositional structure remain limited. Here, we fill this gap by formalizing a simple idea: compositional structure emerges when parts, considered together, reveal shared structure that is not captured when those parts are modeled separately. We express this idea using algorithmic information theory, the mathematics of information and compression, which provides a natural way to identify structure in arbitrary data without specifying in advance what that structure must look like. Applied across scales, our definition informs where and how compositional structure emerges within an object. Using tractable approximations, we then invert the framework to generate compositional objects: we specify the desired form of their compositional structure without prescribing their particular content, and optimize directly over strings and images. The resulting objects exhibit readily recognizable hierarchical reuse and part-whole organization, suggesting that the definition captures compositional structure rather than merely complexity, regularity, or shared information. Finally, we discuss implications for machine learning, including a new perspective on depth in neural architectures and principles for constructing compositional data curricula capable of supporting open-ended learning.

</details>


### [322] [SkillNEO: Non-Elitist Evolutionary Optimization of Agent Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20926)
*Enze Ma,Chunyu Miao,Yankai Chen,Jie Yang,Liancheng Fang,Kening Zheng,Hanrong Zhang,Muyao Xu,Xinle Yu,Chengze Li,Wei-Chieh Huang,Ziwei Ren,Yunhao Du,Zhixiang Shen,Xue Liu,Philip S. Yu,Zhen Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SkillNEO提出了一种非精英进化优化框架，用于通过比较执行证据分别选择部署版本和待改进版本来进化LLM代理技能。它在SkillsBench上将GPT-5.4 Mini的平均奖励从49.1%提升至66.4%，且进化后的技能无需进一步修改即可迁移到更强的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能进化方法通常要求新版本即时超越父版本（精英选择），但技能修复往往需要多步协同编辑，单次评估的奖励可能掩盖部分修复的进展。这会导致有用的中间版本被丢弃，从而错失最终改进的机会。需要一种能将"部署就绪性"与"作为进一步修复起点的价值"区分开的机制。

Method: SkillNEO采用非精英的逗号选择策略，将技能版本的使用与继续改进分开决策：(1) 每个候选版本保存完整技能包及其执行记录；(2) 父代选择仅从当前代已完全测量的子代中筛选，无需子代超越父代；(3) Proposer通过比较同一版本重复运行、父-子运行和兄弟运行的执行轨迹，识别应保留的有效步骤和待修复的失败；(4) Skill Editor将提议转化为完整的子代技能包，支持指令、脚本和资源的协同编辑以及跨分支的嫁接；(5) 归档回溯允许使用创建后收集的证据重新修改早期版本。

Result: 在86个SkillsBench任务（覆盖8个领域）中，SkillNEO将GPT-5.4 Mini的平均奖励从49.1%提升至66.4%，进入GPT-5.5和GPT-5.6 Luna使用原始技能的性能区间；所有8个领域均有提升（5.6至27.4个百分点）。在41个修改任务中，冻结后的技能使Luna提升10.5个百分点，GPT-5.5超出原始技能参考10.6个百分点。搜索历史显示：75.9%有改进的任务在最终路径上使用非现役父版本；163个低分版本获得进一步编辑，其中45个最终拥有被部署的后代；零奖励版本也能产出最终部署版本。

Conclusion: 技能进化可以将较弱模型的部分进展转化为可复用的程序性知识，惠及更强的代理。将部署选择与开发选择分离，并利用比较执行证据指导修订，能保留精英选择会丢弃的中间修复。进化后的技能可冻结后跨模型复用，表明程序性知识积累能够跨任务和跨能力水平传递。

Abstract: Agent skills turn procedural knowledge into reusable artifacts, allowing LLM agents to accumulate and refine expertise through experience. Building on this, skill evolution iteratively improves skills using execution feedback. However, improvement may require several interdependent edits, so low-reward versions can still be worth developing. Requiring immediate reward gains can discard useful partial repairs before their benefits emerge. Non-elitist evolution allows new versions to receive further edits despite scoring below earlier ones. For agent skills, this calls for evidence of what to preserve and repair next. We introduce SkillNEO (Non-Elitist Evolutionary Optimization for Agent Skills), which separately selects a version to use and versions to keep improving. Comparing how related versions perform the same task reveals working steps to preserve and remaining failures to fix. It can also revisit and revise earlier versions using later evidence. Across 86 SkillsBench tasks in eight domains, including software engineering and office work, SkillNEO raises GPT-5.4 Mini's average reward from 49.1% to 66.4%, within GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6 Luna's original-skill range. Mini executes tasks, proposes revisions, and edits skills; final evaluation uses the same task instances. Gains span all eight domains. The same skills improve stronger models without further editing. On the 41 tasks with modified skills, reuse improves Luna by 10.5 percentage points and places GPT-5.5 10.6 points above its published original-skill reference. Execution records show these skills can benefit stronger models even when Mini still fails some task requirements. Search histories also show lower-scoring versions leading to skills ultimately selected for use. Together, these findings show that skill evolution can turn a weaker model's partial progress into reusable procedural knowledge for improving more capable agents.

</details>


### [323] [RAC: A Relational Agent Contract for Constraint-Governed Engineering Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20935)
*Kaiyuan Zheng,Fengqing Jiang,Yichen Feng,Zubin Aaron Assadian,Yuetai Li,Bhaskar Ramasubramanian,Basel Alomair,Luyao Niu,Radha Poovendran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RAC（Relational Agent Contract）是一种面向约束驱动工程任务的智能体-工具交互契约，通过将智能体的动作限定为对命名对象间的"关系"（如"C1靠近U1"），而把可机械推导的具体几何或时序后果交由专用工具实现，从而解决判断-推导耦合导致的工程任务失败问题。在PCB布局布线、作业车间调度和嵌入式代码生成三个领域，RAC在所有九个评估模型上都取得了最高通过率，并显著降低令牌消耗与延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工程智能体在受精确耦合约束的任务（如PCB布局、调度）中频繁失败。作者将根因诊断为"判断-推导耦合"（judgment–derivation coupling）：智能体既要做出语义决策，又要自行推导具体的几何坐标或时序数值。研究发现，语义决策的天然载体是"关系"——它不可由上下文推导、但一旦确定其后果可被求解器机械计算，由此提出以关系作为智能体动作的契约。

Method: 1. 形式化约束驱动工程任务为τ=(c,r,Y,Φ)；2. 定义契约C=(O,A,E,V,F)：观测O（权威工程状态）、动作A（仅关系集合，无坐标）、实现器E（确定性/种子受控的推导与实现）、独立校验器V（评估Φ）、反馈F（返回失败原因与可修复证据）；3. 关键边界：A中剔除工具可推导的字段，将完整关系集合一次性提交由E联合实现；4. 在PCB、调度、嵌入式三个领域实例化该契约，并设计包括直接坐标生成、坐标+Python、候选解选择、顺序关系、需求委派在内的多种基线。

Result: 在98个PCB任务上，九个模型平均清洁通过率从最强基线（仅需求委派）的74.0%提升至90.9%（+16.9个百分点），且在八个模型上同时降低令牌消耗，延迟亦最低；在30个LA作业车间调度实例上，最终方案质量通过率从代码介导交付的59.6%提升至96.3%，首方案即可通过率达93.7%；在141个四款微控制器嵌入式任务上，通过率由SourceLite基线的50.9%提升至72.1%，并节省约39%令牌；契约增益在不同智能体框架（Native/Codex/Claude Code/OpenCode）和变更板尺寸/封装后重用关系时均稳定保持。

Conclusion: 接口设计是工程智能体能力的一阶来源：明确把语义判断留给智能体、把可机械推导的后果交由领域工具，可显著提升约束驱动工程任务的可靠性、效率与可移植性；并证明模型能力的强弱不能替代契约设计。

Abstract: Engineering agents must produce artifacts that satisfy exact, coupled constraints. Existing solutions often require agents to make semantic decisions and also derive consequences such as precise geometry or timing from those decisions, leading to failures in constraint-governed engineering tasks. In this paper, we introduce RAC, a harness-agnostic contract for the action and feedback layer of engineering agents. It specifies authoritative observations, semantic actions, tool-based realization, independent verification, and repair evidence. The agent decides which relations an artifact should satisfy; specialized tools derive their concrete consequences. On PCB placement, routing, and repair tasks, RAC achieves the highest clean-pass rate for all nine evaluated models, averaging 90.9%, compared with 74.0% for the strongest baseline, requirements-only delegation. In job-shop scheduling, direct relational actions achieve 96.3% quality pass versus 59.6% for code-mediated delivery with access to the same scheduling backend. Our evaluations on 141 embedded-code tasks across four microcontroller identify the action contract as a source of agent capability: preserving semantic control while delegating mechanically derivable outputs improves the reliability of constrained artifacts.

</details>


### [324] [MAI-Gym: An Open All-in-One Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training across Mobile and Computer Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20939)
*Panrong Tong,Quyu Kong,Pengxiang Li,Tianyu Xia,Hanzhang Zhou,Lei Wang,Chenglin Cai,Long Li,Long Chen,Jianan Zhang,Zhengwen Zeng,Xu Zhang,Gongjie Zhang,Yue Wang,Steven Hoi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MAI-Gym是阿里Token Hub推出的开源一体化平台，统一了GUI智能体在移动、电脑和Web环境中的评估、数据收集和在线强化学习训练。它支持10个基准测试、可扩展至20,000个并行环境实例，并具备自动化合成可重置模拟应用和跨应用任务的能力。基于该平台训练的9B模型MAI-Gym-9B在MobileWorld和OSWorld-Verified上分别取得78.4%和76.2%的成绩，在10B参数以下的开源GUI智能体中达到最优。此外，在虚拟购票应用上训练的RL能力可迁移到真实物理手机，将任务成功率从28.8%提升至48.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然带可验证奖励的在线强化学习在数学、编程和工具使用领域取得了快速进展，但将其扩展到GUI智能体仍面临两大核心挑战：(1) GUI环境难以大规模扩展且难以保持一致性——与代码沙箱不同，GUI实例不能被并发共享，每个尝试都需要独立的手机、电脑或浏览器实例并重置至已知状态；(2) 真实GUI学习需要连贯、可重置的环境状态和多样化任务，而现有任务合成方法往往依赖孤立的输入文件或共享样本数据，限制了任务的多样性和真实感。现有GUI平台要么只关注基础设施（单一平台、有限并行规模），要么只关注数据（不开放训练代码），无法同时满足两方面的需求。

Method: MAI-Gym采用四大关键技术设计：(1) 共享rollout管道——评估、数据收集和在线RL训练复用相同的观察处理、上下文构建和动作执行，确保智能体行为一致性，并支持10个基准测试（3个移动、4个电脑、3个Web）和20,000个并行环境实例的自动管理、重置和恢复；(2) 自动化应用合成——编程智能体构建两类可重置模拟应用：真实世界服务克隆（支持事务类工作流的安全练习）和全新界面应用（研究智能体适应性）；(3) 跨应用世界构建与任务合成——先从persona和场景构建连贯世界，在多个应用中填充共享人物、事件和事实的互连文件和记录，再从中生成需要跨应用检索和推理的任务，需求先于代码验证器生成并通过执行验证；(4) 失败驱动任务合成——利用不成功轨迹的诊断针对模型弱点定向生成任务。训练采用GRPO算法（分组基线替代价值函数），并支持GUI与CLI混合动作空间（基于Qwen-UI-Agent）。

Result: 主要实验结果包括：(1) MAI-Gym-9B在MobileWorld上达78.4%，在OSWorld-Verified上达76.2%，在10B参数以下开源GUI智能体中达到最优，超越UI-Venus-2-9B（75.2/70.8）、SCALECUA-Qwen3.5-9B（12.8/68.7）以及更大的GUI-Owl-1.5-32B（43.9/56.5）；(2) 在5个训练环境之外的基准测试中，RL均一致地提升了SFT预热检查点的性能，展示了泛化能力；(3) 仿真到真实迁移效果显著——在购票应用克隆上训练后，真实手机应用52个任务的成功率从28.8%提升至48.1%；在全新应用上训练可将保留任务成功率从25.8%提升至45.2%；(4) 平台成功支持了一次跨移动和电脑任务的在线RL联合训练运行。

Conclusion: MAI-Gym通过统一可扩展执行基础设施与自动化环境和任务合成，填补了现有GUI智能体平台的关键空白。该工作有四大贡献：(1) 统一可扩展平台，支持10个基准测试和20,000个并行环境；(2) 自动化应用与任务合成，包括可重置模拟应用和跨应用连贯任务世界；(3) 最强10B参数以下开源GUI智能体MAI-Gym-9B；(4) 开源框架、合成技能、49个模拟应用及配套任务、2000个执行测试任务（MobileWorld和OSWorld各1000个）和模型检查点，支持可复现研究。结果表明合成环境中学到的能力可有效迁移到真实场景，为大规模GUI智能体训练提供了新的研究基础。

Abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has driven rapid progress in mathematics, coding, and tool use, but scaling this success to GUI agents remains challenging due to the high cost of interactive environments and the scarcity of realistic training tasks. We introduce MAI-Gym, an open all-in-one platform that unifies GUI agent evaluation, data collection, and online RL training across mobile, computer, and web environments. Through a shared rollout pipeline, MAI-Gym ensures consistent agent behavior across evaluation and training, supports ten established benchmarks, and scales to 20,000 parallel environment instances. Beyond scalable infrastructure, MAI-Gym enables automated synthesis of diverse GUI applications and challenging tasks, including resettable mocked apps and coherent cross-app worlds with execution-validated task verifiers. Using MAI-Gym, we train MAI-Gym-9B, a unified 9B agent for mobile and computer use, achieving state-of-the-art performance among open GUI agents under 10B parameters: 78.4% on MobileWorld and 76.2% on OSWorld-Verified. Importantly, RL in a mocked train-ticketing app transfers to its real-world counterpart, improving task success on a phys- ical phone from 28.8% to 48.1%. We release the framework, synthesis skills, mocked apps, 2,000 verified tasks, and the model checkpoint to support repro- ducible research and further advances in scalable GUI agent training.

</details>


### [325] [LEV: Thinking Fast and Deep with Looped Decision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20951)
*Dingjie Song,Zhiling Yan,Yuxuan Zhang,Lichao Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LEV 是一种"系统 1.5"决策模型，通过在原生循环语言模型（looped language model）上循环运行同一解码栈 R 次来加深推理，而非生成文本 token。该模型在每一步读取选项并联合训练所有步，使单一检查点可在任意深度作答。配合一个轻量级 stopper 以无标签方式按题动态选择深度，可在 50ms 延迟内比同延迟的密集模型与级联更准确 5.4–8.8 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有决策模型（如 Jev、Kev）对每个问题花费相同算力，无法对难题加深思考；而思维链推理模型每题都要为生成的 token 付费。本研究旨在让决策模型能够按问题难度自适应增加计算，同时避免生成文本带来的开销。

Method: 在原生循环预训练的语言模型（Ouro / Nanbeige4.2）上叠加指针式判别头与 LoRA 适配器；每个循环步后读取选项并预测概率分布，联合训练所有步使单检查点支持任意深度。一个轻量级 stopper 以"当前答案是否与最深步答案一致"为目标拟合，且阈值在无标签请求上设定，从而实现按题动态深度。

Result: 在三种循环骨干（1.4B、2.6B、3B）上，深度增加带来准确率提升且主要来自难题：LEV-2.6B 在 JevBench 上从深度 1 的 63.2% 提升到深度 4 的 76.2%。按需深度比同成本固定深度混合略优或持平，计算量节省 15%–24%。在 50ms 以下延迟，LEV-1.4B 与 LEV-3B 比同延迟密集模型与级联准确率高 5.4–8.8 点。

Conclusion: 原生循环骨干将深度转化为推理时可配置的设置，使单个决策模型能够按问题在延迟与准确率之间权衡。基于与最深答案一致性的无标签停止规则胜过基于置信度的早期退出规则。未来方向包括可恢复浅层正确答案的停止目标，以及更大规模循环骨干的扩展。

Abstract: Decision models answer typed questions about an input with one probability per option, computed in a single forward pass without generating text. Like the fast System 1 of dual-process theory, they answer at once, but their depth is fixed at training time, so they spend the same computation on easy and hard questions. Models that reason in generated text can think longer, but they pay for every extra step in decoded tokens. We present LEV, a decision model that thinks deeper by rerunning its layers in a loop instead of generating tokens. LEV builds on a language model pretrained as a loop, reads the options after every loop step and trains all steps jointly, so one checkpoint can answer at any depth. On three looped backbones, accuracy rises with depth on the same weights, mostly on hard questions, and a 2.6B LEV goes from 63.2% at depth one to 76.2% at depth four on JevBench. On-demand depth, set per question by a small stopper with a threshold fitted on unlabelled requests, saves 15% to 24% of the computation at a cost of under one accuracy point, level with or slightly above a fixed mix of depths. On a locked test set, the 1.4B and 3B models are 5.4 to 8.8 points more accurate than dense (non-looped) models and cascades of the same latency below 50 ms.

</details>


### [326] [StepSafe: Learning Timely Intervention with Context-Aware Safety Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20960)
*Siyi Gu,Kunhan Gao,Chao Peter Yang,Sukanta Ganguly,Rex Ying,Arman Cohan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 StepSafe（一种基于 Qwen3-4B/8B 的步级推理安全护栏）及其训练框架 ASPO（包含阶段对齐策略优化 SAPO 和自适应反馈自蒸馏 AFSD），旨在让智能体安全监控器在正确的时机（既不过早也不过晚）进行干预，从而在五个智能体安全基准上取得开源护栏中的最优安全-效用帕累托前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体安全监控存在三大挑战：(1) 缺乏判断"何时"和"为何"干预的步级标注（仅有轨迹级二元标签）；(2) 轨迹级/步级 GRPO 的信用分配机制无法区分每一个决策的正确性，并将干预步淹没于大量常规安全步中；(3) 安全步缺乏监督信号，使监控器无法学习"何时不干预"，导致误报。需要一种能够在风险信号出现到不可逆伤害发生之间的"干预窗口"内做出及时决策的步级推理护栏。

Method: ASPO 包含两个互补信号：1) SAPO（阶段对齐策略优化）将每个决策与同一可见前缀下的其他响应比较，使用基于标注里程碑（信号 s、边界 b、最后可预防步 h）的时间感知干预时刻表打分（信号前偏好 Continue，澄清窗口偏好 Ask，边界后偏好 Stop），并通过对安全步和干预步进行分层类别预算平衡两类步；2) AFSD（自适应反馈自蒸馏）让模型自身作为教师，在干预步接收标注的违规分类与证据描述，在安全步接收从学生自身误报中挖掘的"自适应误报规则"，通过门控 OPSD 提供 token 级监督。训练数据通过多智能体红队（基于错误日志和分类覆盖缺口）扩展，每步带有违规分类和干预窗口标注。

Result: 在 ASSE-Safety/Security、R-Judge、AgentHarm、ATBench 五个基准（4033 条轨迹）上，StepSafe-4B/8B 取得 J 指数 53.0/54.4，刷新开源护栏最优；其 ASR 接近前沿闭源模型（21.7 对比 18.0-22.2），同时保持较高效用（74.8/80.0）；消融实验证实 SFT、SAPO、AFSD、红队各自贡献不同（对违例识别、时机校准、误报平衡、覆盖增强的分工）。与 StepGuard（46.2）相比，StepSafe 在匹配 ASR 时多用 5.8 个效用点，匹配效用时少 5.1 个 ASR 点；28.6% 的不安全轨迹首次干预恰好落在边界步。

Conclusion: StepSafe 验证了将"干预时机"作为显式学习目标的可行性：通过阶段对齐的信用分配解决"何时"问题，通过自适应反馈自蒸馏解决"为何"与"何时不"问题；预执行监控不能替代形式安全保证，应与访问控制、沙箱、人工监督协同部署。主要局限在于离线效用指标不衡量真实任务完成度、步级标签由语言模型生成可能继承偏见。

Abstract: Safety in agentic systems is inherently sequential: whether an action is safe depends on prior actions, tool outputs, information disclosures, and interactions among agents. Recent work has shifted agent safety guardrails from post-hoc trajectory-level assessment toward step-level action diagnosis and proactive risk prediction, yet existing training objectives provide limited supervision for how step evidence accumulates over time and when it becomes sufficient to justify intervention. We propose \methodlong~(ASPO): a training framework for step-level timely intervention. Pre-fix level stage alignment allows crediting each decision at its own step: it compares each response with the other responses sampled at the same prefix and rewards the action that fits the stage, continuing before the risk is visible, asking while clarification can still avert harm, and stopping before harm is irreversible. Adaptive feedback self-distillation further credits the reasoning behind each decision, with the model itself as a teacher that sees the step annotations on intervention steps and rules mined from its own false alarms on safe steps. Its training data carry a violation taxonomy and an intervention window at every step and are extended through self-evolving multi-agent red-teaming. Finally we present \textsc{StepSafe}, a step-level reasoning guardrail with timely intervention, that achieves the state-of-the-art peformance among open-source guardrails across five agent-safety benchmarks on safety-utility pareto curve with Youden's $J$ of 53.0 (4B) against 46.2.

</details>


### [327] [MSP: Modality Self-Play for Training Multimodal LLMs Without Paired Cross-Modal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20965)
*Robert Moseley,Md Kaykobad Reza,Ameya Patil,Edward Ayrapetian,Salman Asif*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MSP（Modality Self-Play）训练框架，通过"代理文本描述+对比编码器桥接"替代真实的非文本配对数据（如音频-视觉配对），实现多模态组合的零样本涌现。在多个多模态基准测试上达到SOTA或具有竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多模态大模型依赖大规模配对多模态数据进行训练，但此类数据采集成本高、难以跨模态组合扩展，成为进一步发展的根本瓶颈。核心问题是：能否在训练中从未观察真实非文本配对数据的情况下，学会跨模态推理？

Method: 两阶段训练框架：(1) Phase 1：使用单模态-文本对独立训练各模态的投影器（frozen对比编码器+MLP projector+LoRA on Qwen3-8B）；(2) Phase 2：自博弈组合训练——冻结的Phase-1模型以一个真实模态为锚点，生成对未见模态的代理文本描述；通过岭回归学到的文本-模态桥（text-to-modality bridge）将代理文本编码映射到模态编码空间，再经投影器注入LLM，实现跨模态对齐。遵循"one-real-anchor rule"——任何样本只用其一个模态，从不同时使用两个真实非文本模态。

Result: 在三个多模态基准上取得优异成绩（零样本设置）：MUSIC-AVQA达65.65%（超GPT-4o +15.57pp，超OneLLM +18.05pp）；AVQA达85.73%（零样本SOTA）；OmniBench达43.26%（与Gemini-1.5-Pro和Baichuan-Omni-1.5相当）。消融研究证实代理+桥分别带来显著提升（代理贡献+12.7至+12.85pp，桥再贡献+2.67至+7.05pp）。通过logistic probe和logit lens分析表明：真实与代理特征在残差流中仍可区分，但最终输出层词汇空间高度对齐（Δ=+0.166音频，+0.124视觉），说明模型通过LM-head读出而非隐藏表征融合来实现代理-真实对齐。

Conclusion: MSP证明代理介导的对齐足以让多模态组合涌现——无需真实非文本配对数据，仅靠单模态-文本对、预训练对比编码器和模态分布桥接校准即可实现有效的跨模态推理。这为数据受限场景下的多模态学习提供了可扩展、数据高效的替代方案，挑战了"大规模配对多模态数据是跨模态推理必要条件"这一核心假设。局限在于依赖代理文本质量和对比编码器的覆盖范围。

Abstract: Large multimodal models have achieved remarkable progress by scaling model capacity and training on massive paired multimodal data. However, this paradigm introduces a fundamental bottleneck: aligned multimodal datasets are expensive to curate, difficult to scale across diverse modality combinations, and increasingly constrain further progress. We introduce Modality Self-Play (MSP), a training framework for multimodal foundation models based on proxy-mediated modality composition. Instead of relying on paired cross-modal data, MSP uses anchor-supporting proxy textual descriptions of unseen modalities as semantic bridges during training. Given an observed modality (e.g., image or audio), the model generates proxy descriptions for complementary unseen modalities, which are then encoded and aligned with the observed modality through learned bridges, enabling cross-modal interaction without real paired non-text supervision. Our central hypothesis is that proxy text, combined with contrastively trained pretrained encoders, provides sufficient semantic structure for multimodal composition to emerge. We show that MSP enables zero-shot modality composition: models trained only with a real anchor modality and accompanying proxy descriptions can integrate and reason over multiple modalities at inference time despite never observing real paired non-text data during training. Empirically, MSP achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on multiple multimodal benchmarks. Ablation studies further demonstrate that learned bridges improve alignment, while anchor-supporting proxy descriptions enable effective cross-modal composition. MSP removes the need for real paired non-text (e.g., audio-vision) supervision, while continuing to rely on modality-text pairs, pretrained contrastive encoders, and modality-distribution bridge calibration.

</details>


### [328] [Deep Reinforcement Learning for HPC Job Scheduling: A Statistical Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21008)
*Justin M. Cheney,Clement N. Nyirenda*

Main category: cs.AI
