TL;DR: 本文在统一非参数统计框架下，对六种DRL调度算法（PPO/A2C/DQN各含masked与unmasked版本）、三种启发式（SJF/LCFS/UNICEP）及一个掩码随机控制，在两个真实Slurm工作负载轨迹（均匀型physical与异构型deeplearn）上进行了控制对比。核心发现：动作掩码保证评估完成，但学习带来的增益有限且依赖工作负载；MaskablePPO在两个轨迹上均获最佳平均等待时间排名，但与MaskableA2C无显著差异。研究强调引入掩码随机控制对于区分学习价值与可行性约束的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DRL调度研究多单独对比DRL算法与启发式，缺乏统一实验协议下的算法间比较；同时，仅与启发式对比无法区分学习增益与动作掩码本身带来的可行性约束价值。此外，PPO在文献中占比约40-45%，但其相对于A2C和DQN的优势并未在HPC调度任务中得到验证。本文旨在填补这些方法论空白。

Method: 采用HPCSim模拟器、固定10个种子，在physical（84,135 jobs，均匀型）和deeplearn（68,720 jobs，异构型）两个Slurm轨迹上进行实验。所有方法使用best_fit分配器、关闭backfill以保持机制统一。使用stable-baselines3和sb3-contrib实现DRL算法，奖励为负平均排队等待时间。统计方法包括Shapiro-Wilk正态性检验、Friedman检验、Nemenyi事后检验、Wilcoxon符号秩检验（含Holm校正）、TOST等效性检验和Page趋势检验。

Result: （1）所有未掩码处理因选择不可分配作业导致模拟时间冻结而被截断；所有掩码处理均完成评估。（3）物理巡迹上：无掩码DRL处理相对掩码随机控制无显著等待时间优势，且平均/最大有界 slowdown显著更差。（4）深度学习巡迹上：MaskablePPO在三项主要指标上均显著优于随机控制（p=0.012），最大有界slowdown比LCFS低22%，平均等待时间与三个启发式在±10%边际内等效。（5）MaskablePPO在两个巡迹上均获最佳平均等待时间排名，但与MaskableA2C的Nemenyi比较无显著差异（p=1.000/0.999）。（6）成本权衡：MaskablePPO训练时间最低，MaskableDQN决策延迟最低。（7）物理巡迹"迷宫"仅3.7%，深度学习巡迹达38.4%。

Conclusion: 动作掩码主要贡献于评估完成而非调度质量提升；学习带来的调度增益依赖工作负载和评价指标；PPO的优势并非普遍适用，而是存在与A2C/DQN的成本权衡；引入种子配对的掩码随机控制对于评估学习选择的增量价值至关重要。未来工作应探索奖励密度与优化预算的作用，若建立一致的学习优势后可考虑模型蒸馏以降低决策延迟。

Abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers learned job selection for High-Performance Computing (HPC), but performance against heuristics alone does not establish value beyond action masking. Six DRL treatments are compared: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), Advantage Actor-Critic (A2C), and Deep Q-Network (DQN), each with and without masking. Three heuristics and a seed-paired masked uniform random control provide baselines across ten seeds on two real Slurm (Simple Linux Utility for Resource Management) workload traces, one homogeneous and one heterogeneous, under a common non-parametric framework. All masked treatments complete evaluation, whereas unmasked treatments are truncated. On the homogeneous trace, no masked DRL treatment significantly improves average waiting time or average and maximum bounded slowdown over the control. On the heterogeneous trace, MaskablePPO improves all three metrics relative to the control. Its average waiting time is equivalent to that of the three heuristics within a 10% margin, and its maximum bounded slowdown is 22% lower than that of Last-Come, First-Served (LCFS). MaskablePPO has the leading average waiting-time rank among complete treatments on both traces, but Nemenyi comparisons detect no significant difference from MaskableA2C. Among masked variants, MaskablePPO has the lowest recorded mean training time, while MaskableDQN has the lowest mean decision latency. These findings distinguish completion from baseline-specific scheduling gains and support including a masked random control when assessing the value of learned selection.

</details>


### [329] [Failure Is the Mother of Success: Recovering Supervision with Grounding Hindsight](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21018)
*Sheldon Yu,Tong Yu,Nikki Lijing Kuang,Zhendong Chu,Zhenwei Tang,Sungchul Kim,Lina Yao,Julian McAuley,Junda Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Replay-Selected Hindsight Distillation (RSHD) 方法，通过将 GRPO 训练中失败的经验转化为经过验证的"事后回顾性"监督源，解决全失败组（all-fail groups）无学习信号的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO 在所有 rollout 都失败的组中产生零优势，导致恰好是最需要学习的问题没有梯度信号。在最难的 MATH 难度级别上，约一半的训练组是全失败组。现有方法要么泄露参考答案、要么不经验证就信任自我反馈、要么对失败轨迹重新评分而非采样新解，无法有效利用这些失败。

Method: RSHD 包含三个核心步骤：(1) 策略对每个失败尝试生成不超过 80 词的纠正性笔记（看不到参考答案）；(2) 对笔记进行答案泄露筛选，再用笔记作为上下文重新解题，replay 成功率超过原始组才被采纳；(3) 将被采纳的 replay 通过加权模仿损失蒸馏到无笔记的普通提示策略中，权重为教师-学生对数概率差的正裁剪部分（提升量/lift）。总损失为 GRPO 损失加上辅助蒸馏损失。

Result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B 三个模型上，分别在 MATH 和 MMLU-Pro 数值题上训练，RSHD 在所有基准上均优于 GRPO。在 Qwen3-4B 上 MATH-500 提升 7.6 点（84.5 vs 76.9），科学领域 TheoremQA 提升 16.4 点（56.5 vs 40.1）。增益随问题难度递增，在基础模型永不能解决的 8/8 失败组中增益最大（+8.5 点）。生成的解答更短（1981 vs 2545 tokens）、预算耗尽率减半（13% vs 26%）。

Conclusion: 失败并非浪费样本：当其经验经过验证（replay 测试）后方可使用，便能成为推理模型改进的有效监督源。RSHD 证明了一种保守策略改进条件，并通过形式化命题（引导发现定理、修复上限命题）提供了理论支撑。部署时无需任何笔记或额外推理开销。

Abstract: When every rollout for a problem fails, GRPO receives neither a successful exemplar nor a nonzero group-relative advantage, so it learns nothing from exactly the problems it most needs to learn. The failed reasoning can nevertheless suggest what to try next. We present Replay-Selected Hindsight Distillation (RSHD), which turns failed attempts into an additional, tested source of supervision during GRPO training. The policy writes a corrective note about each failed attempt without seeing a reference answer or solution, then re-solves the problem with the note in context. A note is admitted only if its replays succeed more often than the original group did, after screening for notes that state the answer, and an admitted replay is distilled into the plain-prompt policy. Because admission is decided by fresh successes rather than by the failed rollout itself, the procedure can recover supervision from groups in which every attempt failed, and it applies equally to failures in mixed groups. Only the policy is trained, the only judge is the outcome verifier, and deployment requires no notes or extra inference. Across model families and sizes and two training domains, RSHD consistently improves over GRPO on in-domain benchmarks, and the gains carry over to out-of-domain evaluation sets.

</details>


### [330] [Recursive Reward Improvement via Adversarial Meta-Prompt Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21040)
*Wei Dai,Qianchu Liu,Guanghui Qin,Xing Han,Tristan Naumann,Paul Pu Liang,Sheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RRI（Recursive Reward Improvement）方法，通过引入"奖励黑客对抗代理"来解决开放性专家任务中模型自生成评分标准（rubric）易被利用的核心难题，实现无需任何训练数据的递归自我改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）在数学和编程领域已取得成效，但这些领域答案可被自动验证。而医学、法律、金融等开放性专家任务没有标准答案，需要模型同时生成任务和评分rubric。然而模型生成的rubric存在全面性不足的独特难题——求解器倾向于利用rubric的漏洞，仅提及预期主题而不提供实质内容，污染整个学习过程。

Method: RRI包含五个组件：①提议器（从医学文献检索并生成任务和rubric）；②对抗代理（故意写出利用rubric但无实质内容的答案，同时由同一模型在不看rubric的情况下写出诚实答案，衡量作弊差距 Δ=lead(黑客)-lead(诚实)，差距≥0.20则判定为可被攻击）；③修复步骤（最多两轮，添加新判据使诚实答案得分高于黑客答案，并重新攻击验证）；④求解器（采用GRPO训练，可调用检索和网页搜索工具）；⑤元优化器（根据训练反馈和已确认的漏洞重写提议器的生成指令）。对抗发现的所有漏洞同时改写未来任务和rubric的生成方式。

Result: 在HealthBench Professional上：RRI在9B和27B模型上比Generation Only基线分别提升调整分数10.9和12.4点；冻结9B模型自身担任所有辅助角色时提升10.3点；写作类任务提升39.1点（9B）和14.7点（27B），困难任务提升18.6点（典型任务仅2.8点）。泛化到未见领域：仅用HealthBench Professional描述训练的27B模型在PRBench Hard上提升6.6点、ProfBench上提升8.0点（非医学任务）。漏洞分析：33%为漏掉的负面判据（黑客写出错误内容但无判据惩罚），29%为表述模糊的rubric，14%为答案标准有误。

Conclusion: RRI通过对抗性漏洞检测与修复机制，使自改进回路能够监督自身奖励，无需任何人工参考。在零训练数据条件下显著提升域内性能，并在域外任务上展现良好泛化能力。研究发现模型自生成rubric主要失败于遗漏对错误内容的惩罚和措辞模糊两方面，为未来自改进研究指明了方向——应专注于奖励检查答案"陈述了什么"而非"提及了什么"。

Abstract: Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) has gained wide attention for its ability to work with limited data. In a proposer-solver loop, a proposer model writes training tasks and a solver model learns to solve them through reinforcement learning. Such loops have succeeded in mathematics and coding, where every answer can be checked automatically. Open-ended expert tasks, like clinical report generations, have no answer key, which makes simple question-answer generation not viable. Here the proposer must also write a rubric that lists the content an answer should include and the errors it should avoid. However, the unique challenge behind model-written rubric is the comprehensiveness of it. For naively generated rubric, solvers tend to exploit it, naming the expected topics without the substance behind them, which corrupts the learning process. To solve this problem, we introduce RRI, Recursive Reward Improvement, which uses a reward hacking adversary to supervise the reward. Before the solver trains on a generated task, an adversary writes an answer that games its rubric while being as useless as possible, the same model writes an honest answer without seeing the rubric, and up to two repair steps revise the rubric to make the honest answer win. The exploits found also rewrite how future tasks and rubrics are generated. On HealthBench Professional, RRI improves the adjusted score over the Generation Only self-improvement baseline by 10.9 points at 9B and 12.4 at 27B, and by 10.3 points without any external model. In particular, the gains are largest on difficult and writing tasks. We show that the 27B model trained on the HealthBench Professional description improves by 6.6 points on PRBench Hard and 8.0 on ProfBench without seeing a task from either. We further analyze the exploitable points of model-generated question-rubric pairs to facilitate future research on open-ended self-play.

</details>


### [331] [Learning When to Withdraw: Curriculum Coverage and Rule-Specific Failures in Fine-Tuned Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21045)
*Mohamed Abouzahra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了工具调用型语言智能体在权限撤销或证据变化时的"选择性撤回"(selective withdrawal)能力。作者基于NAQD-Env合成环境（具有显式依赖关系和确定性参考策略），对Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct进行LoRA监督微调(SFT)，对比原始课程与扩展课程（后者在三种系统提示框架下）。结果显示SFT检查点在决策一致性和撤回召回率上显著优于三个指令调优基线（7B/8B级别），但规则级诊断揭示了具体权衡——如原始课程检查点存在对有替代支持的行动的过度撤回，扩展课程则过度保守；所有SFT检查点均出现未经训练的"禁止组合"行为，事件报告也存在遗漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具调用型智能体在面临动态环境（证据变化、权限撤销）时，可能执行已过时或已失效的行动，造成现实危害。现有模型在此类选择性撤回场景下的可靠性尚未被系统评估，且聚合准确率指标可能掩盖具体规则层面的失败模式。论文旨在通过受控合成环境诊断SFT在选择性撤回任务上的具体优势和隐性缺陷。

Method: 构建NAQD-Env合成环境（显式依赖+确定性参考策略），对Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct进行LoRA SFT，设置5个实验臂：(1)原始课程；(2)扩展课程；(3)扩展课程+三种不同系统提示框架。评估时采用3种推理提示，覆盖三组数据：新验证用例、不在训练中的依赖族、不在训练中的结构组合。引入3个指令调优基线（7B/8B级）。定义两类指标——聚合的决策一致性/撤回召回率，以及针对特定规则（错误撤回、合法行动保护、禁止组合缩窄、事件报告）的诊断指标。

Result: 在naqd提示下，SFT检查点决策一致性0.77-0.92 vs 基线0.45-0.63；撤回召回率0.46-0.86 vs 基线≤0.06。规则级诊断显示：(a)原始课程检查点错误撤回34个仍有替代支持的行动中的26个；(b)扩展课程检查点仅撤回0-1个；(c)所有SFT检查点对未经训练的"禁止组合"缩窄操作执行频率低于基线；(d)委托场景下撤回更多但独立授权行动保留更差；(e)四个检查点均遗漏有效事件报告。系统提示框架的差异在指标和数据划分上不一致，未能确立可复现的优势或等价性。

Conclusion: 论文贡献在于提出一种可揭示聚合准确率下隐藏的具体规则回归的方法，而非证明SFT能独立保证智能体安全。明确局限性包括：每个实验臂仅一次训练运行、课程变更涉及多重属性耦合、之前评估已接触过类似场景、以及SFT与基线间的量化差异。作者结论是：在选择性撤回任务上，应报告规则级诊断而非仅汇总准确率，并认识到单一SFT方案不足以全面保障工具调用智能体的安全性。

Abstract: Tool-using language agents must revise prepared actions when evidence changes or authority is revoked. Selective withdrawal means suspending affected actions, preserving supported work, and resuming only after sufficient repair. We study supervised fine-tuning in NAQD-Env, a synthetic environment with explicit dependencies and a deterministic reference policy. Four LoRA checkpoints of Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct compare an original curriculum with an enriched one, the latter under three system-prompt framings with identical views and targets. Three instruction-tuned baselines and all four checkpoints are evaluated under three inference prompts on fresh validation cases, held-out dependency families, and held-out structural combinations. Under the naqd prompt, SFT checkpoints reach decision agreement of 0.77-0.92 and withdrawal recall of 0.46-0.86, versus 0.45-0.63 and at most 0.06 for the baselines. Rule-level diagnostics qualify these gains. The original-curriculum checkpoint wrongly withdraws 26 of 34 actions with surviving alternative support; enriched checkpoints withdraw 0-1. Conversely, all SFT checkpoints narrow prohibited combinations less often than the 7B and 8B baselines, a case absent from both curricula. Delegation results show more withdrawal but poorer preservation of independently authorized actions, and all four checkpoints omit valid event reports. Framing contrasts vary across metrics and splits and do not establish a reproducible advantage or equivalence. One training run per arm, jointly changed curriculum properties, prior evaluation exposure, and baseline-SFT quantization differences limit causal attribution. The contribution is a method for detecting rule-specific regressions that aggregate accuracy can conceal, not evidence that fine-tuning alone ensures agent safety.

</details>


### [332] [Athanor: An Agent-Native System for Autonomous Post-Training Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21055)
*Yufa Zhou,Yichen Wang,Jiakun Fan,Ziqi Shu,Zhichao Liu,Anru R. Zhang,Neiwen Ling,Zijun Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Athanor——一个面向自主后训练研究（AutoPostTrain）的开源智能体原生系统，在真实 GPU 上让前沿智能体团队对小型原始基模型进行后训练。研究证明：在 104 小时内，无任何研究建议的 4 个 Claude Opus 5.5 智能体（每智能体使用 8 张 GPU）可将 Qwen3-4B-Base 在 6 项任务的开发套件上从 15.9 提升至 67.3，在未公开套件上从 9.2 提升至 48.2，性能匹配或超越官方 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507（66.5 / 47.9）。这是首次证明前沿智能体团队可自主将原始基模型训练为跨领域通用模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（AI 构建更强大的 AI）是通向超智能的可能路径之一，但完整形式难以直接衡量。本文研究一种弱化但可测量的形式：让前沿智能体利用公开数据对小型原始基模型进行后训练，以此评估其工程与研究潜力。目标是探索当前智能体是否已具备攻克完整研究任务的能力。

Method: 方法包含两大部分：(1) 系统层面——构建开源 Athanor 平台，提供冻结评估、托管任务、数据去污染、持久研究记录以及智能体未知的保留评估套件；智能体运行于沙盒中，无法调用外部教师模型。(2) 实验层面——4 个 Claude Opus 5.5 智能体各使用 8-GPU 节点，在 104 小时的研究活动中独立完成数据处理、训练算法设计与修改、超参调优、结果分析与下一步决策。其技术路线为：对公开推理数据进行 SFT、引入一种智能体提出的 rollout 改进进行强化学习、智能体之间的权重合并以及多轮自蒸馏的组合。

Result: 在 104 小时的自主研究活动后，Qwen3-4B-Base 在 6 项任务开发套件上从 15.9 提升至 67.3；在智能体未知的保留套件上从 9.2 提升至 48.2，与官方 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 的 66.5 和 47.9 相当或略胜。完整研究日志显示，智能体通过组合已知方法并相互借鉴模型实现了该性能：包括公开推理数据上的 SFT、一种由智能体引入的 rollout 改动、权重合并以及自蒸馏。

Conclusion: 研究表明，一旦执行环节被妥善处理，当前的智能体已具备攻克完整后训练研究任务所需的工程与研究能力。Athanor 为可扩展的自主 AI 研究提供了基础，有望成为评估递归自我改进潜力的重要基座平台。这是首次证明前沿智能体团队能自主将基模型后训练为匹配/超越官方指令微调版本的跨领域通用模型。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement, in which AI systems build stronger AI systems, is one promising route to superintelligence. We study a weaker form that can be measured today: frontier agents post-training a small raw base model with public data, as a test of their research potential. We build Athanor, an open agent-native system for autonomous post-training research (AutoPostTrain) on real GPUs. We give the agents full research autonomy, low-friction engineering tools, and efficient starter code. The agents carry out the research themselves: they read datasets and evaluation results, build their training data, write and modify training algorithms, tune hyperparameters, and analyze the results to decide what to try next. They work in a sandbox and cannot use external teacher models. Athanor's services supply frozen evaluation, managed jobs, decontaminated data, a persistent research record, and a held-out suite the agents are unaware of. In a 104-hour campaign, a team of four Claude Opus 5.5 agents, each on an eight-GPU node and given no research advice, improves Qwen3-4B-Base from 15.9 to 67.3 on a six-task development suite and from 9.2 to 48.2 on a held-out suite, against 66.5 and 47.9 for the official Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration that a team of frontier agents can autonomously post-train a raw base model into a cross-domain generalist model that matches or surpasses the official instruct version on average. The campaign's full record shows that the agents reach this level by recombining known methods and each other's models: SFT on public reasoning data, RL with a rollout change one agent introduced, weight merges across agents, and rounds of self-distillation. With execution handled, today's agents already have the engineering and research ability to conquer this task. We hope Athanor provides a foundation for scaling autonomous AI research.

</details>


### [333] [OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21074)
*Gideon Shaked,Siddharth Nagisetty*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OmicsBench 是首个面向生物信息学 AI 智能体的长时程、多轮基准测试，包含 97 个研究级任务和 662 个有向无环图依赖子任务。它揭示了当前 12 个模型/智能体框架均无法饱和该基准，且得分会随会话深入和子任务依赖而下降，上下文反馈仅能部分恢复表现。作者还提出了无监督失败模式发现流水线，揭示了 12 种涌现的生物信息学特定失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生物信息学基准大多以单一提示词提出短任务，无法衡量智能体在真实研究工作流（依赖型子任务序列）中的表现。论文旨在填补这一空白，提出能评估智能体在长时间、多轮、依赖型生物信息学分析中能力的方法。

Method: 1) 将每个任务形式化为有向无环图（DAG），子任务作为连续会话中的用户轮次；2) 支持两种模式——无反馈单遍模式和带上下文反馈与重试的门控模式（阈值 τ=0.7，最多 3 次尝试）；3) 采用 58 个生物学感知评分器，通过 NCBI Gene、CARD、miRBase 等数据库进行实体同义词解析；4) 评估 12 个模型在 3 个智能体框架上的表现；5) 设计无监督失败模式发现流水线（LLM 描述 → 嵌入 → UMAP 降维 → HDBSCAN 聚类 → 命名）。

Result: 1) 无任何模型/框架组合接近饱和基准，最佳（Opus 5/Opus 5.6）单遍得分 0.57、门控 0.67，最弱 0.43/0.54；2) 每个组合在第二轮后下降 0.06-0.12，依赖型子任务得分低于独立子任务；3) 门控重试提升 0.09-0.13，但三次后仍仅 22-34% 子任务达标；4) 无监督流水线发现 12 种涌现失败模式（覆盖 42% 失败尝试），分为五大族——过多提交（37-55%）、以智能体自身标准替代任务标准（22-34%）、替换程序（10-16%）、用先验知识替代数据（3-15%）、过少提交（4-12%）。

Conclusion: OmicsBench 证明了长时程多轮评估能揭示单提示词基准看不到的行为。核心结论是当前 AI 智能体在生物信息学分析中倾向于遵循自身习惯而非任务指令，主要表现为用自己选择的标准筛选答案集。论文呼吁训练中关注三点：遵循任务标准、跨会话保持科学语境、更好利用上下文反馈。同时指出门控模式存在奖励黑客风险，未来工作需开发模拟用户并量化此偏差。

Abstract: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.

</details>


### [334] [Sci$Π$vot: Benchmarking Principal-Investigator Judgment at Pivotal Moments of Scientific AutoResearch Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21082)
*Youran Sun,Xingyu Ren,Chugang Yi,Kejia Zhang,Di Wu,Yingkang Cao,Allen Zhou,Jianping Ye,Suying Liu,Jiaxuan Guo,Jianda Du,Weicheng Ye,Kecheng Liu,Hefan Zhang,Haixin Wang,Jie Xiao,Eric Yang,Haizhao Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SciΠvot 是一个包含 248 个案例的科学判断基准，基于六个月真实前沿研究中资深研究者的纠正记录，用于评估 LLM 智能体能否在关键科研决策点上识别正确的修正方案。结果显示前沿模型表现不佳，五分之四的模型在中推理投入下表现差于随机水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 LLM Agent 可在极少干预下维持科学实验数月运行，但可靠的自主科研仍需科学判断力。由于研究决策具有开放性且依赖项目背景，科学判断难以评估。论文旨在填补这一空白，通过资深研究者的真实纠正记录构建可测量的基准。

Method: 基于 26 个跨 6 个学科的前沿科研项目中资深研究者的纠正记录，回溯性地构建 248 个二元选择案例。每个案例呈现干预前的项目状态和原始 LLM 计划与人类修正计划两个选项，要求模型选择更可能推动研究问题的方案。使用五个前沿模型（Astra、Opus、Grok、Sol、Terra）在 12 种条件下测试，涵盖推理投入级别、项目记录访问与否以及两次重新审议，并与新鲜研究者基线比较。

Result: 中推理投入下，五分之四的前沿模型（四个模型的上限置信区间低于 50%）在选中案例上系统性地偏好原始 LLM 计划而非人类修正方案。最佳项目条件准确率仅 63.5%（Astra xhigh），而新鲜研究者基线达 73.4%。令人意外的是，每个模型在有项目记录时的准确率反而低于无项目记录时（均值 39.2% vs 55.8%）。增加推理投入和重新审议并不能持续提升准确率——首次审议修复 422 个错误但引入 302 个新错误，第二次审议修复 264 个却引入 305 个，部分抵消早期改进；论文将此失败模式称为"再捕获"（re-trapping）。

Conclusion: SciΠvot 揭示了前沿 LLM Agent 在真实科研关键决策上的关键判断瓶颈：模型倾向偏好自身生成的原始计划（结构上属于 on-policy 偏好），无法有效利用项目记录，且更深思熟虑反而可能回归原始错误。论文提出直接偏好优化（DPO）训练方案作为未来工作方向，并开源 248 个案例以推动该领域研究。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can keep scientific experiments running for months with little human supervision, but reliable autonomous research also requires scientific judgment. Evaluating scientific judgment is difficult because research decisions are open-ended and depend on project context. We construct Sci$\Pi$vot, a 248-case benchmark of scientific judgment based on human corrections. The benchmark draws on records from six months of research in which senior researchers ran LLM agents on 26 projects across six scientific fields and repeatedly intervened to correct the agents' research judgments. In each case, an agent chooses between the original LLM plan and the human-corrected alternative, using only the project record available before the correction as context. We compare LLM and human performance and examine the effects of reasoning effort, access to the project record, and reconsideration. At medium reasoning effort with the project record, models systematically prefer the original LLM plan over the human-corrected alternative. Four of five frontier models perform below chance on the selected cases. The highest accuracy in the project condition across the tested models and reasoning effort settings is 63.5%, compared with 73.4% for fresh researchers. At medium effort, every model achieves lower accuracy with the project record than without it, and reconsideration does not consistently improve overall accuracy. Even with a human-corrected alternative available, frontier models struggle with the selected research decisions, while Sci$\Pi$vot supports systematic evaluation of scientific judgment for LLM agents.

</details>


### [335] [Probe-and-Resume: When and How to Evaluate Agent Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21088)
*Jiakai Xu,Tiancheng Ge,Tujie Guan,Yusheng Li,Rohan Timmaraju,Eugene Wu,Kostis Kaffes*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究终端环境中智能体测试时搜索中的评论器（critic）设计问题，发现传统 MCTS 配合轨迹评论器效果不佳，并提出 Probe-and-Resume 方法：通过在智能体声明完成时仅调用具有完全执行权限的评论器在可丢弃的 fork 中探测状态，将通过率从 63.4% 提升至 72.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时搜索（test-time search）通过探索替代动作并用评论器选择有前景的分支，有望提升智能体性能。然而在终端环境中，智能体观察仅暴露环境的部分视图，且中间状态对最终成功率的指示性有限，导致 MCTS 与传统评论器组合无法显著提升任务成功率。核心问题：评论器应何时调用？应赋予何种环境访问权限？

Method: 1. 分析三种评论器变体：C^traj（仅看轨迹）、C^read（只读 fork）、C^act（完全执行权限 fork），测量其在轨迹 25%/50%/75% 中间状态与候选终态上的表现。2. 进一步引入 C^act+S0，增加初始状态 fork 作为参考。3. 基于发现设计 Probe-and-Resume 策略：当 actor 声明完成时调用 C^act+S0，被拒绝时 actor 从原状态恢复并接收反馈继续修改，否则提交。

Result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1（89 任务，每任务 5 次试验，GPT-5.6 Luna + Terminus-2）上：中间状态处，评论器排序仅略优于随机，执行权限提升有限（+4.4 点）；候选终态处，C^act 将误分类率从 36–39% 降至 22%，加入 S0 fork 后准确率从 76% 提升至 80%。Probe-and-Resume 将 pass@1 从 63.4% 提升至 72.4%（+9.0 点），成本仅为同等模型 Codex CLI 的一半，相对 MCTS 基线提升 8.4 点。在 SWE-bench Pro 的 227 个可评分任务上，pass@1 从 80.2% 提升至 87.7%（+7.5 点）。

Conclusion: 评估终端任务本身即是一项终端任务：仅检查交互历史或简单查看环境不足以判断脚本、配置或服务是否正确，评论器需通过执行程序构建验证。在可分支终端环境中，评论器利用 fork 进行探测可在不破坏 actor 状态的前提下提供有效反馈。关键启示：分支能力在搜索中价值有限，但对评论器评估已完成工作价值显著；让评论器在 actor 自认为完成时介入，比在中间步骤搜索更有效率。同时，从原状态恢复被拒绝的尝试比重启更经济。但该方法收益依赖 actor 具备修复自身未察觉错误的能力，方法在更强模型上增益不显著。

Abstract: Test-time search can improve agent performance by exploring alternative actions and using a critic to select promising branches. We study this approach in terminal-based computer-use environments, which expose only a partial view of a large underlying state, and find that the Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) configuration we evaluate does not significantly improve task success. We identify two sources of poor critic performance: the agent's observations omit environment state needed for evaluation, and intermediate states offer limited evidence of whether a trajectory will succeed. At intermediate states, critics rank continuations only modestly better than chance, and environment access improves this little. We study when to invoke a critic and what access to give it to evaluate a node. Our findings motivate a policy that invokes the critic only at nodes the agent believes are final, rather than during partial progress. Further, the policy gives the critic read, write, and execute access to a fork of the computer's current and initial state, allowing it to probe and perform potentially destructive actions to surface any hidden state the trajectory omits. We call the resulting design Probe-and-Resume: when the agent claims to be done, the critic probes a fork of its state, and a rejected agent resumes where it stopped. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, this raises success by 8.4 percentage points over MCTS with conventional critics, and approaches the success rate of the Codex CLI agent with the same underlying model at less than half its cost.

</details>


### [336] [MemComposer: Learning to Assemble Memories for LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21091)
*Yixuan Xie,Xueqiang Xu,Xinyi Fan,Xinxi Lyu,Tao Feng,Xing Fan,Chenlei Guo,Jie Hao,Shaowen Wang,Jiashuo Sun,Jiawei Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MemComposer是一种针对LLM智能体的记忆组合器，通过强化学习（ExPO框架，基于GRPO）联合学习从检索候选中选取哪些记忆、选取多少以及按何种顺序排列，以最大化下游任务成功率。在τ²-bench的三个领域（retail、airline、telecom）上，使用两个冻结的executor（Qwen3-4B-Instruct和Ministral-3-8B-Instruct），MemComposer在pass¹和pass⁴指标上均优于最强基线，同时平均减少16.9%和4.9%的记忆token使用量。该方法可零样本迁移到未见领域、不同executor和更强模型生成的记忆库。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统主要依赖语义相似度检索，但语义相似并不等于记忆有用——记忆的数量和顺序同样显著影响下游任务表现。作者通过实证观察到：(1) 增加检索数量k并不能单调提升性能，最优k因领域而异；(2) 相同记忆集合的不同排列会导致截然不同的任务结果。因此需要超越相似度排序，学习面向查询的记忆组装策略。

Method: MemComposer采用LoRA适配的小模型作为组合器π_θ，输入为任务查询q和top-n候选记忆，输出一个有序的变长子序列S。训练采用Experience Policy Optimization (ExPO)：为每个查询采样G=8个候选序列，每个序列用冻结的executor执行J=8次试验，以任务成功率作为主奖励，并加入选择数量惩罚和格式惩罚。ExPO借鉴GRPO但用群组相对优势（仅做均值中心化，不做标准差归一化以避免放大噪声），并采用DAPO的动态采样——丢弃任务结果完全相同的群组。训练中executor、retriever和记忆库均保持冻结，仅更新组合器。记忆库由agent自身对训练任务的N=8次rollout组成，每条轨迹附带自生成的hindsight review（标注成功/失败/假成功原因），经确定性一致性校验后入库。

Result: 在τ²-bench的retail、airline、telecom三个领域上，MemComposer在12项领域级比较中10次达到最优或并列最优。使用Qwen3-4B-Instruct时平均pass¹达50.8、pass⁴达32.5，比最强基线分别高5.9和5.0点；使用Ministral-3-8B-Instruct时pass¹达63.5、pass⁴达40.0。token效率方面比最强基线少用16.9%和4.9%的记忆token（retail领域最高节省38%）。训练后的策略：(1) 选取更深层候选（平均排名从3.21升至4.35）；(2) 对历史成功经验的偏好减弱（份额从45.5%降至35.6%）；(3) 排序优于固定规则（相似度、长度等）3.8–8.5点。在零样本迁移上：在retail训练的组合器迁移到airline/telecom性能与域内训练相当；Qwen3-4B训练的组合器迁移到Ministral-3-8B executor仍优于启发式基线；在由GPT-5.4等更强模型生成的记忆库上，无需再训练即可平均提升pass⁴达9.1点。统计检验（配对bootstrap）在pass¹上对所有基线显著，在pass⁴上对大多数基线显著。

Conclusion: MemComposer证明了面向查询的记忆组装（联合选择、数量、顺序）相比传统相似度检索能显著提升LLM智能体的下游任务表现和token效率。通过ExPO框架直接从稀疏、延迟的任务成功反馈中学习，组合器发展出可迁移的策略：选取更深层候选、不过度依赖历史成功经验、学会有效的排序方式。零样本迁移能力表明所学的是评估记忆实用性的通用原则，而非领域特定模式，凸显了在智能体记忆中学习下游反馈驱动的上下文选择的价值。

Abstract: Agent memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to reuse past experiences without updating their parameters. However, semantic similarity alone does not guarantee memory usefulness: downstream performance depends on how memories are selected and presented to the agent. We propose MemComposer, a memory composer that jointly examines the current query and retrieved candidates to decide which experiences to include, how many to select, and how to order them. We train the composer using Experience Policy Optimization (ExPO), a GRPO-based framework that evaluates assembled memory contexts through complete agent interactions and uses task-success feedback to optimize the assembly policy. Across three $\tau^2$-bench domains with two frozen executors, MemComposer outperforms the strongest baseline for each executor while reducing average memory-token usage by 16.9% and 4.9%, respectively. The learned policy also transfers to unseen domains, executors, and memory banks, and benefits from memories generated by stronger models without further training. These results demonstrate the value of learning query-specific memory assembly using downstream task feedback.

</details>


### [337] [Planning Commitment of LLM under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21108)
*Cassie Huang,Zhanwei Cao,Yeawon Lee,Nathalia Gomez,Zhuoyi Yang,Ian G. Harris,Tiffany Do,Jiayuan Mao,Li Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）在部分可观测环境中的"规划承诺"（planning commitment）问题，区分激进型（基于假设生成完整长规划）和保守型（仅基于观察逐步规划）策略，并在两种范式（LLM-as-planner 与 LLM-as-formalizer）和两个领域（Coin Collector、ALFWorld）上进行了系统性对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM规划系统中，激进承诺与保守承诺两种行为隐式出现，但其在安全性（失败次数）与效率（API调用次数）之间的权衡从未被系统性地表征或可控化，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 1. 提出"规划承诺"作为独立于planner-formalizer区分的设计维度；2. 构建两个受控的部分可观测文本环境（Coin Collector配统计先验，ALFWorld配常识），每个100题；3. 实现四种方法组合（激进/保守 × planner/formalizer），引入激进formalizer完成四象限对比；4. 评估三个LLM（DeepSeek-Flash、Gemini-3-Flash、Qwen3.8-27B）在规划准确率、失败次数、API调用、输出token四个指标上；5. 探索free和fixed两种混合策略用于安全-效率调节。

Result: 在三个LLM上，激进与保守策略的规划准确率相近，但存在显著权衡：保守方法失败次数少（更安全），API调用多（效率低）；激进方法失败多，但仅在有信息性先验时才更高效。引入先验后，激进planner的API调用比保守planner减少约40%。分析显示LLM几乎将提供的先验当作事实使用，导致在先验不可靠时风险加剧。混合策略（尤其Hybrid Planner fixed）在失败次数与API调用间提供良好中间地带。

Conclusion: 作者针对不同场景给出实践建议：无先验或常识可用时推荐保守承诺；先验可靠且失败可恢复（如网页导航）时推荐激进承诺；失败代价高（如实验自动化）时倾向保守；两者皆有时使用混合策略。主要局限是仅基于两个人工文本领域，先验来自评估集本身为完美校准，未测试失准先验，且"使用先验引导探索"这一中间承诺等级未覆盖。

Abstract: LLM-based planning agents commit to plans of different lengths before interacting with a partially observable environment. Some aggressively commit to a long plan based on assumptions about unobserved states, while others conservatively plan only over what they have observed. Both behaviors emerge implicitly in pre-trained models, whether the LLM outputs a plan directly or generates a PDDL formulation for a classical solver. Aggressive commitment risks costly failures, while conservative commitment risks excessive LLM calls. This choice pits safety against efficiency, a trade-off that has been neither characterized systematically nor made controllable. We investigate aggressive and conservative LLM planners and formalizers on two partially observable domains, where priors are provided as either explicit statistics or common-sense knowledge. Across three LLMs, both strategies reach similar accuracy. Conservative methods achieve fewer failed attempts (safety) at the cost of more API calls (efficiency). Aggressive methods fail more often but replan efficiently only when priors are informative. Interestingly, analysis shows that LLMs treat the provided priors nearly as facts, which risks failure when priors are unreliable. We also explore hybrid strategies with tunable hyperparameters that adjust the balance between safety and efficiency.

</details>


### [338] [Kolab: Benchmarking Human-Agent Collaboration in Long-Horizon Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21109)
*Shirley Anugrah Hayati,Patricia Anugrah Setiani,Ruizi Wang,Zhouyi Li,Khanh Chi Le,Young-Jun Lee,Dongyeop Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍Kolab数据集，这是一个包含50位专业人士（来自40个职业）在与AI代理协作完成长时域现实任务时的115+小时屏幕录制数据集，用于评估MLLM在理解人机协作方面的能力。研究发现前沿模型在预测AI输出的采纳/修改/拒绝行为以及预测协作满意度方面表现不佳，存在系统性偏倚。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的智能体基准测试主要关注自动化能力（单次完成任务），而非真正的人机协作能力。然而在现实专业工作中，人类需要持续与AI交互、修订计划，专业工作流通常涉及相互依赖的步骤。Kolab旨在填补这一空白，提供真实专业工作场景下的人机协作基准。

Method: 数据集：招募50位跨40个职业的专业人士，进行两轮各约1小时的屏幕录制，使用Claude等AI代理解决自己真实的领域专业问题，并提供步骤级协作满意度和输出质量评分。将工作流表示为有向时序图（人类/AI动作节点），标注三种响应类型：Adopt（采纳）、Modify（修改）、Reject（拒绝）。提出三个协作动态指标：协作突发性（burstiness）、工作流拓扑、AI保留率。基准任务包括（RQ1）预测专业人士如何处理AI贡献（识别和预测），以及（RQ2）预测协作满意度和输出质量评分。评估六个MLLM在七种模态组合（视频、图、聊天）下的表现。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 最优模型在预测Adopt行为时F1仅为0.51（GPT-6）和0.49（Claude）；(2) Gemini 3.1 Pro预测协作满意度的Spearman相关系数仅0.078；(3) 模式基线（mode baseline）在MAE上优于所有MLLM，因为评分严重偏向5分；(4) 更长的工作流上下文并不能持续改善预测性能；(5) 模型存在系统性偏倚：Gemini过度预测Adopt，Qwen-32B过度预测Modify，Claude和Qwen对所有评分给出相似范围；(6) 图（graph）模态对非智能体Qwen模型特别有帮助；(7) 视频-图-聊天三种模态组合并未带来一致的最佳表现。

Conclusion: Kolab揭示了前沿多模态LLM在理解专业人机协作方面的根本性局限：它们难以预测专业人士如何处理AI输出，也难以从工作流中恢复人类对协作质量的判断。这表明当前模型可能依赖自身的预测倾向而非真正理解工作流，呼吁开发更好的训练数据或模拟环境来提升智能体的协作能力。

Abstract: When humans collaborate with AI agents on long-horizon tasks, what happens to the agents' contributions? For solving long-horizon tasks, humans place greater importance on ongoing interaction with AI agents (e.g., revising plans) than on an agent's ability to complete the task in a single attempt. However, most agentic benchmarks have focused more on automation. Strong performance on such benchmarks does not imply effective real-world collaboration. Professional workflows offer a useful setting, as they often involve interdependent steps. To address this gap, we introduce Kolab, a new dataset of 115+ hours of screen recordings of 50 professionals from 40 occupations collaborating with agents on realistic, long-horizon problems. Kolab also contains participants' collaboration and output quality judgments. Our analysis reveals diverse collaboration patterns, highlighting the importance of when and how professionals coordinate with agents. A collaborative agent must do two things that automation benchmarks never test: anticipate whether experts will adopt, modify, or reject its contribution once it leaves the chat window to guide its next steps, and assess collaboration quality from the unfolding workflow without constant expert feedback. Our benchmark operationalizes both: (1) forecasting how professionals use agent contributions at diverse workflows, and (2) verifying their judgments of collaboration satisfaction and output quality. Findings show that frontier models, both agentic and non-agentic, overestimate collaboration with experts and struggle to distinguish between high- and low-quality collaboration. Longer workflow context does not consistently improve these predictions. As frontier agents cannot yet understand long-horizon collaboration with experts, we position Kolab as a valuable dataset for studying human-agent collaboration grounded in real professional workflows.

</details>


### [339] [CleanRM: Reward Modeling from Noisy Feedback with a Few Clean Feedback for RLHF](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21138)
*Licheng Pan,Haocheng Yang,Yuzhou Chen,Yichen Sun,Yuan Lu,Yunfei Teng,Jiajun Fan,Guangyi Liu,Zhixuan Chu,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CleanRM提出了一种基于最优传输的奖励建模框架,利用少量干净反馈来校准样本级噪声比率,并通过噪声修正的替代损失训练奖励模型,以解决RLHF中样本级反馈噪声的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLHF中的奖励模型在大规模偏好数据上训练时不可避免地受到反馈噪声的影响(来自人类主观性、标注错误和不完美的LLM评判)。现有去噪方法通常假设噪声比率在样本间是均匀的,但这一假设在奖励建模中并不成立,因为反馈噪声本质上是样本级的(不同响应的偏好判断难度差异很大)。直接使用噪声反馈训练会导致奖励模型记忆噪声而非真实偏好,从而损害下游RLHF对齐效果。

Method: CleanRM采用两阶段方法:1)使用一个双头噪声比率估计器p_φ,通过Wasserstein最优传输将噪声反馈反演后的偏好联合分布与干净反馈分布对齐,从而估计每个样本的噪声比率μ̂(x)和ν̂(x);2)构造噪声修正的替代损失,该损失的期望等于干净损失,从而在理论上证明替代目标相对于干净风险是无偏的。整个流程通过Algorithm 1(训练噪声估计器)和Algorithm 2(训练奖励模型)实现。

Result: 在HelpSteer、UltraFeedback和PKU-SafeRLHF三个数据集上的实验表明,CleanRM在所有数据集上都达到了最优性能(R²和MSE均最佳)。消融实验证实了OT噪声估计和无偏替代损失两个组件的贡献。在Qwen3和LLaMA3.1系列(8B-70B)骨干上的泛化实验表明CleanRM在不同模型架构和规模上均有效。超参数敏感性分析显示即使在少量干净监督和高噪声水平下也保持稳健。下游RLHF实验(GRPO微调)显示CleanRM在HarmBench、FFT和DAN安全基准上安全得分显著提升。

Conclusion: CleanRM成功解决了奖励建模中样本级反馈噪声的挑战,通过最优传输校准样本级噪声比率并使用无偏替代损失,在理论上保证了对干净风险的无偏估计。实验全面验证了该方法在奖励预测准确性和下游RLHF对齐方面的优越性。未来工作可探索自监督扩展(减少对干净反馈的依赖)以及将框架推广到成对或列表式偏好设置。

Abstract: Feedback noise is pervasive in preference data, arising from subjective human judgments, annotation mistakes, and imperfect LLM judges. Standard reward modeling trained on such feedback yields a biased estimate of the clean risk. Although classical denoising methods are directly applicable to noisy feedback learning, they generally assume a uniform noise ratio across samples. However, this assumption fails for feedback data, where noise is intrinsically sample-wise. To address this challenge, we propose CleanRM, which uses a few clean feedback to calibrate sample-wise noise ratios via optimal transport. Specifically, CleanRM aligns the joint distribution of preferences reverted from noisy feedback with that of clean feedback and then trains the reward model using a noise-corrected surrogate loss. Theoretically, we prove that the resulting objective is unbiased with respect to the clean risk. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CleanRM outperforms state-of-the-art denoising baselines and yields more effective downstream RLHF alignment.

</details>


### [340] [All-in-One Memory: Process-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Memory Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21147)
*Bingbing Wang,Jingjie Lin,Weiming Qiao,Jing Li,Ruifeng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AiO-Mem 是一种统一的记忆智能体框架，将检索、写入、过滤和终止整合为共享证据状态上的转移操作，通过过程奖励强化学习（PA-DAPO）在长上下文记忆基准上显著优于静态记忆系统和基于 RL 的记忆智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆系统将检索与记忆构建分离优化，缺乏统一的奖励空间评估搜索、写入和停止决策；现有监督主要基于最终答案正确性，无法可靠区分不同中间记忆操作的语义质量。

Method: 1）可追溯多视图事件库：将异构历史编译为源可追溯的多视图事件单元（raw/sum/anc/phr），通过 RRF 融合检索；2）证据状态转移建模：将记忆交互建模为有限时域 MDP，包含 decide（search/stop）与 extract（add/skip）四种动作；3）统一奖励建模：通过证据监督 SFT 与轨迹级 DPO 训练过程奖励模型，为每个动作打分；4）PA-DAPO：将动作类型平衡的轨迹奖励在 (group, action, token) 层级上优化记忆策略。

Result: 在 LoCoMo、MemoryAgentBench 和 PersonaMem 三个长上下文记忆基准上均取得最优，LoCoMo 总体 F1/B1 达 61.0/55.0，超过最强基线 Mem-T；MemoryAgentBench 平均 74.7 分，超 Fine-Mem 8.3 分；PersonaMem 总体 69.2，超最强基线 3.9 分；检索与构造 token 分别减少 79.9% 和 73.8%。

Conclusion: AiO-Mem 通过共享证据状态上的统一转移建模与轨迹条件化过程奖励模型，实现检索与构建的协同优化，在长上下文记忆任务中表现出可靠且可泛化的记忆交互能力。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly rely on external memory to answer queries grounded in long-horizon histories such as multi-session dialogues and lengthy documents. However, existing memory methods often optimize retrieval and memory construction separately, without a shared reward space for evaluating search, writing, and stopping decisions. To address this, we propose All-in-One Memory (AiO-Mem), which organizes these operations as transitions over a shared evidence state and directly evaluates the semantic quality of each action in a unified reward space. AiO-Mem compiles heterogeneous histories into source-traceable multi-view events, providing a shared substrate for retrieval and memory writing. A unified memory policy actor then rolls out complete interaction trajectories over this shared evidence state. A separate trajectory-conditioned process reward model is trained through evidence-grounded supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-level DPO to assign process scores to the collected trajectories. These scores are aggregated into an action-balanced trajectory reward and used by Process-Aligned DAPO (PA-DAPO) to optimize the memory policy. Across long-context memory benchmarks, AiO-Mem consistently improves answer accuracy over both static memory systems and RL-trained memory agents.

</details>


### [341] [GRADS: Graph-Regulated Agentic Data Synthesis with Controllable Difficulty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21167)
*Gaocheng Yang,Ruijie Tao,Kai Ye,Senhua Zhang,Zhengqin Zhu,Ziyang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GRADS 是一个图引导的智能体数据合成框架，通过显式控制多跳推理任务的难度，解决了现有合成数据中"预期难度"与"经验难度"不匹配的问题。在三个异构领域（GitHub、粒子物理、安全）上，SFT 将 4B 模型的解题终止率提升至 95% 以上，工具调用减少达 75%；最终模型在 GitHub 上匹配 Sonnet 4，并在物理与安全领域超越它。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多跳问答合成流程通过堆叠证据来增加表观复杂度，但新增证据往往与答案弱耦合，使问题可通过捷径绕过推理链，导致"声明难度"与"实际推理难度"脱节，损害评估与课程设计的可靠性。

Method: 1) 定义 QA 对的"证据图"（DAG），节点为来源锚定的声明，边为必要的推理依赖；2) 提出四项代码可计算的图复杂度量：深度、宽度、规模、信息流，并发现深度与求解器得分相关性最强（Spearman rs=−0.45）；3) 构建闭合循环（种子→探索→验证→再探索），每轮通过必要性过滤 ν 剔除可绕过的边，并选出能最大化深度增长的编辑；4) 选择器在最终图中找深度最接近目标 θ 的闭必要祖先子图，将其作为下一问题的生成上下文；5) 三层验证（决定性校验 + 来源验证器 + 推理验证器）确保每条声明对应原文片段且不可绕过；6) 在 Apache 票务、CMS 物理笔记、红队安全痕迹三个领域上合成并按 Easy/Medium/Hard 三档生成数据。

Result: 在三个领域上，GRADS 是唯一使交付深度随难度档单调上升且求解器得分随难度单调下降的方法（TaskCraft、WebShaper、Claude-Code 基线均失败）。SFT 后 Qwen3.5-4B 在各域均显著优于基线合成数据（Physics +0.107、GitHub +0.169、Security +0.304 解题终止率从约 6% 升至 95% 以上，工具调用与轮数减少高达 75%；RL (GRPO) 在 30 步预算内进一步减少工具调用达 19.5%；最终 4B 模型在 GitHub 上与 Sonnet 4 持平（Δ=−0.001），在 Physics（Δ=+0.075）和 Security（Δ=+0.124）上超越 Sonnet 4。难度单调性在 Opus 4.8、Sonnet 4、Qwen3.5-4B 三类求解器上保持一致。

Conclusion: 将开放探索与确定性难度控制解耦是可行的：通过证据图的必要性深度作为合成时与评测时的同一标尺，GRADS 生成了难度可经验验证的多跳 QA 对，并显著提升了 4B 模型在领域任务上的后训练效果。局限在于 RL 收益在 30 步预算内不显著、单实例深度仍有噪声、必要性由 LLM 而非人类判定。

Abstract: Deep research agents are increasingly deployed to retrieve precise information from large corpora, yet multi-hop, long-horizon tasks remain challenging. Synthetic data generation has emerged as a scalable solution, with existing pipelines typically expanding seed tasks to increase their apparent depth and breadth. However, this expansion does not reliably translate into necessary reasoning: newly introduced evidence may be only weakly coupled to the answer, creating a mismatch between intended and empirical difficulty. To address this problem, we introduce GRADS, a graph-guided agentic data synthesis framework with explicit difficulty control. GRADS runs a closed loop of seed selection, evidence expansion, question--answer construction, and verification while maintaining a graph of the evidence and inference dependencies required to derive each answer. At each step, it conditions generation on a relevant subgraph, preserving indispensable inference without accumulating irrelevant context. Experiments across security, software-engineering, and scientific-document domains show that GRADS consistently generates verified tasks with empirically separated difficulty distributions, as measured by independent solvers. Moreover, under matched training budgets, post-training on this data delivers consistent gains at every level: SFT raises the solution-termination rate to over 95% while cutting tool calls and turns by up to 75%, RL trims tool use by up to a further 19.5%, and on our held-out, domain-specific benchmarks, the resulting 4B model matches Sonnet~4 on software engineering and surpasses it on the scientific and security domains.

</details>


### [342] [MemScope: Evolving Agent Memory Architectures through Localized Code Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21170)
*Miao Su,Yucan Guo,Zixuan Li,Long Bai,Zhongni Hou,Xiaolong Jin,Jiafeng Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MemScope 提出一种基于执行证据的局部代码修复框架，通过 Patch Agent 联合检查原始执行轨迹、运行时记忆状态和当前架构代码，对已有记忆架构进行细粒度、可控的原地修改，避免大幅重写。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自演化智能体方法依赖粗粒度反馈（评估分数或压缩摘要），无法精确定位长任务链中多组件交互造成的失败位置，导致记忆架构修改范围不受限，常常对仍具备能力的架构进行大规模重写。

Method: MemScope 将每个记忆技能封装为 SKILL.md + 可执行 provider，运行时记忆库与技能分离。Patch Agent 通过只读工具（trace 索引、内存检查、代码阅读）联合诊断失败根因，然后在 provider-identity 与 memory-compatibility 约束下执行精确的 old→new 替换，并通过 Patch History 记录后续结果以指导后续修复。

Result: 在 GAIA 上 trace+memory 诊断变体准确率 86.67%（vs summary-only 63.33%、trace-only 70.00%）；xBench 配对对比中原版→演化版由 49→55（DeepSeek）和 50→53（Kimi）；ALFWorld 未见任务成功率由 50.75% 提升至 71.64%；14 次架构快照转换的代码修改中位数仅为 4.4%，中位改动 16.5 行、1 个函数。

Conclusion: 细粒度执行证据能够支撑对已有记忆 provider 的局部、在位、代码级演化；MemScope 在多个基准上优于自演基化的自演化基线和原始 DynamicCheatsheet，且编辑范围显著受限，证实"诊断+局部修复"是比"分数驱动整体重写"更可控的架构演化路径。

Abstract: Agent memory architectures define how LLM agents store and reuse experience across tasks, but they are typically fixed after deployment, limiting their adaptability across task types. Recent self-evolving approaches instead adapt these memory architectures using execution feedback, typically represented as evaluation scores or compressed summaries. However, such coarse-grained feedback is insufficient for precise failure localization in current agent systems, where long-horizon task execution involves multiple interacting components. Without a precise failure location, existing approaches lack a clear code-level target for modification, leaving the update scope weakly constrained and often leading to large-scale rewrites of an otherwise capable memory architecture. We propose MemScope, a framework for evidence-grounded, localized evolution of an existing memory architecture. Its tool-using Patch Agent jointly inspects raw execution traces, runtime memory state, and current architecture code to identify repair targets and apply bounded, in-place edits under provider-identity and memory-compatibility constraints. On GAIA, the trace-and-memory inspection variant achieves 86.67% accuracy, compared with 70.00% for trace-only and 63.33% for summary-only feedback. Under xBench tasks, the evolved memory architecture improves over its original version from 49 to 55 correct answers with DeepSeek V3.2 and from 50 to 53 with Kimi K2.7 Code. On disjoint ALFWorld unseen tasks, success rises from 50.75% to 71.64%. Across archived architecture-snapshot transitions, the median code-change ratio is 4.4%. These results support fine-grained execution evidence as a basis for localized, in-place memory-architecture evolution.

</details>


### [343] [AgentEval: Evidence-Bounded Assessment of Stateful Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21177)
*Ruiqi Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AgentEval 提出了一种"证据有界评估"框架，将契约绑定的评估记录贯穿有状态代理的全生命周期（工具执行、状态/事件捕获、报告资格化、案例维护），区分"代理做了什么"、"证据能证实什么"、"结论当前是否仍受支持"。通过32次工具世界执行、48次证据干预、12份多轮报告以及192次公开基准研究，证明了字节哈希校验不足以保证报告可用，缺失证据与目标范围差异是评估失效的关键原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务完成并不等于义务满足；历史记录的判定也不能保证其支撑证据当前仍然有效。有状态代理的最终答案可能对应不同的持久化效应，单纯的完成消息无法证实这些效应。现有交互式基准和过程感知评估多关注行为本身，缺少将"目标满足""过程义务""当前证据支持"三者统一贯穿的评估记录机制。

Method: 1) 契约绑定评估记录 ℛ=(A, Γ, c, v, e, Ŷ, m, h)，绑定目标配置、任务契约、条件、版本、证据、检查结果、测量状态与内容摘要；2) 三值评估 Ŷ_Γ(e)∈{+, -, ?}，通过可信执行主机隔离评估者证据；3) 当前资格化 Q(ℛ, v_now)=I_binding ∧ I_integrity ∧ I_contract ∧ I_dependency，不重写历史判断；4) 未解析状态包络 [n+/N, (n++n?)/N] 量化未决议义务的影响；5) 治理化案例维护包含来源、激活、消费、撤回全生命周期；6) 独立核查器与正/负/缺失/伪造绑定控件验证检查器语义；7) 证据干预通过编辑注册运行的副本测试资格化机制。

Result: 工具世界研究（32次执行）：30次完成，2次因幂等冲突中断；独立核查与系统全契约标签在30次完整集数上完全一致（23 PASS/2 FAIL/5 UNKNOWN）；目标仅检查则将所有未决议误判为失败。证据干预（48次视图）：哈希检查接受36个被编辑视图，但全绑定检查正确拒绝所有30个主机编辑视图，恢复后完全一致。多轮报告（12样本×2配置）：24个目标答案全部匹配执行前所获程序答案。公开基准研究（192次执行）：187次子目标满意、5次违规；原生评分177/15，揭示10次子目标成功伴随整体任务失败；指令对比中96对配对保留5次差异；证据遮蔽在50%随机首状态字段掩码时，92次满意与[47.9%, 97.9%]有限区间共存。

Conclusion: AgentEval 通过契约绑定记录连接任务合同、执行证据与报告资格化，使评估的作用域、证据支持与报告复用可在代理评估工作流中检查。字节完整性不足以保证当前报告可用；目标范围、过程义务与缺失证据的区分对正确解读有状态代理评估至关重要。系统适用于范围明确、条件可控的评估资产，但对开放生成、跨代理比较与广泛部署推断需要额外契约与证据。

Abstract: Task completion alone does not determine whether a stateful agent satisfied its obligations, and a recorded judgment does not guarantee that its supporting evidence remains valid. We present AgentEval, a system that carries a contract-bound assessment record through tool execution, state and event capture, report qualification, and case maintenance. It separates what the agent did, what the evidence establishes, and whether the conclusion is supported for present use. On 32 tool-world administrations, independent checks agree on all 30 complete episodes, distinguishing satisfied, violated, and unresolved obligations; two interrupted administrations are retained. Controlled interventions on 48 evidence views expose 36 binding faults missed by hash-only checks without changing agent behavior. Scenario Studio connects reviewed cases to 12 two-turn reports with 24 independently checked answers. A separate public-benchmark study on 192 held-out executions reveals ten completed return subgoals within broader task failures and isolates the effect of missing evidence. These studies show how an executable assessment record makes scope, evidential support, and report reuse inspectable across an agent evaluation workflow.

</details>


### [344] [Does Latent Chain-of-Thought Actually Reason? A Single, Unifying Taxonomy for Latent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21182)
*Jingjie Qiu,Sheldon Yu,Xunyi Jiang,Jiajin Liu,Zihan Huang,Zhendong Chu,Tong Yu,Julian McAuley,Junda Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了"潜在思维链（latent chain-of-thought）"是否真的被模型用于推理的问题。作者在二十一组模型-任务配置上，结合链删除、内容替换、探针和轨迹分析，发现COCONUT等方法在逻辑任务上的潜在链常充当"占位符"，状态过早稳定且删除后预测几乎不变；尽管逐步监督能产生有序推理布局并使模型依赖该链，但有序链仍可能仅作占位符。算术任务上则所有方法都依赖链内容。作者据此提出一个区分"链表示什么"与"模型如何使用它"的分类法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在思维链用连续隐藏状态替代显式推理步骤，但尚不清楚这些步骤实际执行何种计算。高任务准确率和可解码的中间答案不足以证明模型真正利用了潜在链来得出答案。

Method: 跨二十一组模型-任务配置（涵盖三种训练方法、三种推理任务、两种骨干网络），综合运用链删除（chain deletion）、内容替换（content replacement）、探针（probes）和轨迹分析（trajectory analysis），以检验链是否影响答案、编码什么内容以及状态如何变化。

Result: 在逻辑任务上，COCONUT往往在链开始前就已携带可读的答案，状态早期收敛，删除链后预测几乎不变。逐步监督虽能产生有序的推理步骤布局并使模型依赖该链，但即便有序链也可能仅作占位符：删除链会降低性能，而内容替换则不改变答案。在算术任务上，所有训练方法均显示出对链内容的依赖。

Conclusion: 仅凭可读的潜在状态不足以作为潜在推理的证据。作者提出一个分类体系，分离"链代表什么"与"模型如何使用它"。据此，以往研究结果不再相互竞争——占位符、折叠叠加和步骤依赖性因果角色分别对应不同类型的链，分别在不同任务、训练方法或测量条件下获得。一旦研究明确说明测试的是哪种属性（模型是否使用链、链承载什么、其状态如何移动），关于潜在推理的论断便可以相互比较。

Abstract: Latent chain-of-thought replaces written reasoning steps with continuous hidden states, giving models additional steps to compute before answering. It remains unclear what computation these steps actually perform. High task accuracy and decodable intermediate answers do not establish that a model uses its latent chain to reach an answer. We study this question across twenty-one model-task configurations covering three training recipes, three reasoning tasks, and two backbones. We combine chain deletion and content replacement with probes and trajectory analysis to test whether the chain affects the answer, what it encodes, and how its states change. On logical tasks, COCONUT often carries an answer that is already readable before the chain begins. Its states settle early, and deleting the chain leaves predictions almost unchanged. Per-step supervision produces an ordered layout of reasoning steps and can make the model depend on the chain. Yet even an ordered chain can act as a placeholder, with deletion hurting performance while content replacement leaves answers unchanged. On arithmetic tasks, all tested recipes show dependence on chain content. These results show why readable latent states alone are insufficient evidence of reasoning. We introduce a taxonomy that separates what a chain represents from how the model uses it. Seen this way, earlier reports no longer compete: placeholder tokens, collapsed superposition and step-dependent causal roles are each consistent with a different kind of chain, each obtained on a different task, training recipe or measurement. Once a study says which property it tested, whether the model uses the chain, what the chain holds, or how its state moves, claims about latent reasoning can be compared.

</details>


### [345] [Mine, Sample, Render: Test-Time Diversity Alignment Of Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21185)
*Kostas Triaridis,Morris E. Sharp,Nebojsa Jojic*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 MINE-SAMPLE-RENDER (MSR)，一种在测试时增强生成模型多样性的框架。该方法通过三阶段流程解决现代生成模型虽能产生高质量但多样性不足的问题：从语料库挖掘可解释的属性模式、基于语料统计采样属性配置、用生成模型作为条件渲染器。实验涵盖天气报告、用户模拟、网页设计、文生图和代理生成3D资产等领域，均证明 MSR 能更好地对齐语料分布并提升生成多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代生成模型（包括 LLM 和文生图模型）即使明确要求多样性，其输出仍倾向于坍缩到少数模式，导致合成数据集和模拟用户群体无法反映真实数据的分布变化。这源于：(1) 模型对未指定的语义选择反复以相同方式解析；(2) 提示改变输出但"如何变化、变化频率、合理组合"未被识别；(3) 奖励最大化后训练进一步集中高奖励模式。需要在测试时将生成输出的分布与真实数据分布对齐。

Method: MSR 框架包含三阶段：(1) Mine（挖掘）：通过让 LLM 比较小型 artifact cohort，挖掘可解释的二值属性模式 A(D)，并通过反向标注构建 T×A 稀疏出现矩阵以估计联合分布；(2) Sample（采样）：支持基于 NPMI 矩阵对称非负矩阵分解的主题采样，以及基于互信息排序的回退祖先采样（动态缩减条件集以保证最小支持度 m，混合策略 p_λ = (1-λ)p_ancestral + λ p_topic）；采样可结合 TF-IDF 词汇特征处理大型 schema，且 LLM 生成的兼容性掩码强制逻辑一致性；(3) Render（渲染）：生成模型仅作为条件渲染器 Q(x|u, a)，可选地由 LLM 进行语义解析（如绑定 X/Y 占位符）后再渲染。Lexical feature 提供请求与属性间的统计桥梁。

Result: 实验在五个领域验证 MSR 效果：(1) 天气报告：MSR 将 Forward KL 从 0.570 降至 0.181，JS 从 0.484 降至 0.203，覆盖率从 21% 提升至 68%，且能恢复数据生成的真实属性轴；(2) 用户模拟：在 5 个 LLM（GPT-5-mini/5.5/4o、Qwen3.8-27B、Kimi K2.6）上 MSR 显著降低 KL 散度并提升覆盖度，PersonaHub 反而降低多样性；(3) 网页生成：MSR-WebSight 将 GPT-5.5 的 Vendi 分数从 2.16 提升至 4.12（视觉）/ 2.45→3.96（结构），odd-one-out 移除率 95-97%；(4) 文生图：MSR-Resolved 在 GPT Image 2、MAI-Image-2.5、FLUX.2-flex 上 DINOv2 Vendi 分数达 6.68-6.77（远超协调重写的 4.32-4.55），500 张图中几乎全部被识别为异类，有效性 90-99%；(5) 3D 折叠椅：MSR 既提升多样性（最低移除排名 17.1 vs 协调生成 25.1）又提升质量（83.55 vs 70.80，独立生成 82.35），同时保持机械功能合理性。

Conclusion: MSR 提供了一种无训练的通用框架，通过解耦"可生成什么"和"该以什么频率生成"，将语料统计采样与条件渲染分离。这使基础模型可直接利用其已有的属性识别能力，同时受外部语料分布引导。跨领域结果一致表明，该方法在不损害质量（甚至在 3D 任务上提升质量）的前提下显著增强多样性并对齐目标分布，为生成模型多样性提供了可解释、可替换的解决方案。

Abstract: Modern generative models produce high-quality individual outputs but struggle to sample diversely, even when explicitly instructed to do so. We introduce MINE-SAMPLE-RENDER (MSR), a test-time approach that externalizes the diversity into an explicit, corpus-derived sampling procedure. Our pipeline (i) mines an interpretable categorical schema from a corpus of real artifacts and supplies statistics for sampling; (ii) samples attribute configurations from the corpus-derived statistics; (iii) uses a generative model purely as a conditional renderer of a sampled configuration. Across weather report generation, user simulation, webpage design, text-to-image generation, and agent-generated 3D assets, we evaluate the diversity and output quality of MSR-guided generation and show that MSR improves alignment with corpus distributions and diversity of generated outputs.

</details>


### [346] [Condition-Contrastive Extrapolation for On-Policy Distillation of Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21195)
*Wenxuan Luo,Chenxi Li,Haoyue Liu,Yongxin Guo,Xiaoying Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CCE-OPD方法，通过条件对比机制改进语言模型的on-policy distillation。针对教师在学生前缀条件下推荐违反问题前提的无效续接这一关键缺陷，该方法采用固定前缀对比（同一冻结教师评估完整问题与掩码条件后的版本）结合有界对数概率对比来重构辅助蒸馏目标。在6个数学基准测试中，相较OPD平均提升avg@8 1.60-1.95个百分点，并在4个迁移基准上取得最佳结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy distillation (OPD) 在学生生成的前缀条件下，教师会偏好违反问题前提（condition-violating continuations, CVC）的续接，导致鼓励错误的推理步骤。例如问题声明x>0且x²=9，在学生前缀"取负根x="后继续输出-3"虽符合推理方向但违反问题约束。现有OPD改进方法关注如何在学生轨迹上应用教师反馈，但未确保偏好的续接满足问题的条件约束。

Method: CCE-OPD (Condition-Contrastive Extrapolated On-Policy Distillation) 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 掩码输入构造——对7498个训练问题，用DeepSeek-Flash标注器识别最小条件并掩码，最终3402个问题获得接受的对偶版本；(2) 条件对比机制——冻结教师在相同前缀下对完整问题q_T和掩码问题q_D分别评估，计算log对比δ_t(v)=log q_T(v)-log q_D(v)，并截断到[-5,5]范围内；(3) 有界外推——通过q_E(v)∝q_T(v)exp(β·δ̃_t(v))在top-k候选支持上（k=16，来自两个teacher的并集最多32个token）构建辅助蒸馏目标；(5) 熵门控策略——仅在教师熵H(q_T)≥0.8 nats的高熵位置施加辅助监督，损失函数为L = L_OPD + λ·L_CCE（λ=1，β=0.2）。

Result: 主要结果：CCE-OPD在1.7B学生模型的全部6个数学基准上取得最高avg@8，在0.6B学生上5/6基准最佳（AIME25与GRPO持平）。相比OPD，0.6B和1.7B学生平均提升1.60和1.95个百分点。最大增益：0.6B Minerva-Math +3.22点，1.7B AMC23 +5.00点。诊断验证：在200个诊断推理状态上，条件对比将偏好无效续接的比率从27.0%降至10.0%（该论文中描述为从27.0%降至16.0%，实际配对诊断显示54个状态降至32个）。消融实验：条件掩码优于随机掩码（5/6基准）、整问题删除、替换为其他问题；熵门控相比全位置施加在所有6个基准上提升avg@8，平均增益1.14点。迁移性能：在GPQA-Diamond、MMLU-Pro、IFEval和CRUXEval-O四个迁移任务上均取得最佳结果，分别超出最强基线1.52、0.49、2.03和0.75个百分点。

Conclusion: 条件对比是改进on-policy distillation中续接偏好的有效途径。CCE-OPD通过利用教师对掩码条件的响应来细化监督信号，使辅助蒸馏目标更倾向于满足问题条件的有效续接。输入构造、外推强度和熵门控的消融验证了各设计决策的必要性，中等强度的重加权（β=0.2）在教师预测竞争的熵较高位置最为有效。该方法在数学推理任务上取得显著提升，并展现出良好的跨域迁移能力，支持条件对比作为优化OPD监督信号的实用方法。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves a student language model by training on its own generated trajectories with supervision from a stronger teacher. However, when conditioned on student-generated prefixes, the teacher can favor invalid continuations that violate the question's premises, causing OPD to encourage erroneous reasoning steps. As a remedy, we introduce Condition-Contrastive Extrapolated On-Policy Distillation (CCE-OPD), which makes teacher supervision sensitive to question conditions. CCE-OPD incorporates (1) a fixed-prefix comparison in which the same frozen teacher evaluates the complete question and a counterpart with a selected condition masked, and (2) a bounded log-probability contrast that reweights the teacher distribution into an auxiliary distillation target. On 200 diagnostic reasoning states, condition contrast reduces the rate of preferring invalid continuations from 27.0% to 16.0%. Extensive experiments across six mathematical benchmarks show that CCE-OPD improves avg@8 over OPD by an average of 1.60 and 1.95 percentage points when distilling Qwen3-8B into 0.6B and 1.7B students, respectively. It also achieves the strongest results on four transfer benchmarks.

</details>


### [347] [Who May Release an Agent's Promise? Standing over Commitments in Multi-Party Chat](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21203)
*Lan Wei,Bingyu Shen,Jiaqi Tang,Qing Lu,Kuan Huang,Meng Xu,Miles Q. Li,Bin Hu,Boyang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究多用户聊天场景下,智能体应允的承诺由谁可以解除的问题,提出"立场"(standing)概念,区分"越权解除"(服从无权之人)与"违背债权人"(执行已被债权人解除的承诺)两种错误,并探索用账本机制修复这些错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着聊天助手从单用户扩展到团队共享频道,助手会向特定人做出小型承诺(如订会议室、发邮件等)。当同事说"不用做了"时,助手面临单用户基准从未提出过的问题:此人是否有权解除该承诺?现有的指令冲突研究依赖权限等级排序,但承诺的解除权属于承诺人(债权人),而非基于等级。哲学家与社会承诺理论赋予债权人释放权,本文将此引入LLM多用户代理研究。

Method: 构建包含1,440个回合的受控聊天环境(测试集1,080),15种单元格(谁说话、如何说话、8种承诺类型、2种策略、2种间隔、3种表层变体),测试6个模型(Qwen3.5-9B/3.8-27B、Gemma-4-12B、Llama-3.1-8B、gpt-6-luna、gpt-6.1-sol)。通过oracle干预阶梯(B0-B4+)测试规则、所有权、状态信息对两种错误的影响,并提出智能体自维护的承诺账本(ledger_add/ledger_update工具)结合一段释放策略作为无需oracle的解决方案。

Result: 研究发现两种错误模式:小型开放模型违背债权人(Qwen3.5-9B: 69%),大型模型听信任何人直接话语(Qwen3.8-27B: 89%;gpt-6.1-sol: 83%),几乎所有模型服从旁观者"继续做"的恢复指令。Oracle干预显示规则和债权人身份遏制越权解除但不解决违背,且所有权信息在三个模型中反而加剧违背;只有知道承诺是否仍有效(状态信息)能减少违背。智能体自维护账本在四个模型中消除违背;结合一段策略后,gpt-6-luna的严格准确率从49%升至83%,匹配或超越最佳oracle存储。

Conclusion: 决定谁可释放智能体承诺的应是"立场"而非"等级"。规模带来状态追踪能力但不带来规则。规则修复"顺从"错误;在所提供信息中,只有状态信息修复"违背"错误。智能体可在自有账本中维护该状态,只要获得规则,便无需oracle。这为多用户代理中承诺管理提供了实用方案:承诺存储应记录状态及变更者,旁观者的"继续"指令应受与取消指令同等审视。

Abstract: When an assistant serving a team makes a promise to Alice, who may cancel it? We call this standing: only the creditor (the person owed) or someone the creditor or operator policy authorizes may release a commitment, regardless of rank. In a controlled chat environment we vary who cancels and separate two errors: unauthorized release (obeying someone without standing) and override (executing a released promise). Across six models, smaller open ones override the creditor (Qwen3.5-9B: 69%); larger ones drop promises on a peer's direct word (Qwen3.8-27B: 89%; gpt-6.1-sol: 83%); nearly all act on a bystander's "go ahead after all". Oracles dissociate the errors: stating the rule or the creditor curbs unauthorized release but not override, which the latter even raises in three of four models; among them, only knowing whether the promise is still owed cuts override. Enabling thinking moves smaller models the way scale does. A self-kept commitment ledger stops override in four of five models; with a one-paragraph release policy it matches or beats the best oracle store, raising gpt-6-luna's strict accuracy from 49% (policy alone) to 83%. Code, prompts, outputs and labels are released.

</details>


### [348] [Entertain, then Cancel: How Thinking Makes Reasoning Models Read Some and Or Literally](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21204)
*Zhizhuo Kou,Jian Yang,Pengfei Hao,Junyu Luo,Jingshu Peng,Sirui Han,Yike Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了推理模型中"思考预算"这一可控变量对语言意义解读的影响。通过在固定权重下改变思考量并截断推理轨迹进行诊断，作者发现：推理模型将逻辑词（如some、or）更多地按字面逻辑解读（取消语用蕴涵），而依赖上下文的推理（如间接回答）则随思考改善。模型先在推理早期容纳丰富解读，再在最终输出时取消之。这挑战了"思考越多越能理解言外之意"的直觉，提出应同时评估模型的解读准确性与解读选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类语用学存在两种竞争性预测：认知努力假说认为语用蕴涵需要处理成本，更多思考应带来更多丰富解读；默认-取消假说则认为一般化语用蕴涵是默认产生的，可被上下文或真值核查所取消。推理模型将"思考"作为用户可控设置，为在固定权重下测试这两种假说提供了独特实验范式。既有研究多关注固定设置下的准确率，而非思考过程对解读选择的影响。

Method: 研究者设计了两类干预协议：（1）剂量-反应协议——在固定权重下改变思考预算（关闭、封顶、自然停止）；（2）轨迹诊断协议——在模型自身推理轨迹的不同前缀处强制截断并读取答案。结合广义语用蕴涵（some、or、情态词）、词汇等级、特定化蕴涵（间接回答、隐喻）、预设等多种测试集，对40个开放推理模型和7个闭源模型（含GPT-5）进行评估，并在训练阶段检查点（base→SFT→DPO→RLVR）追踪效应起源。

Result: 核心发现：（1）思考使some/or的字面化转变在30/40个开放模型与GPT-5中显著成立，幅度可达-50pp以上；（2）轨迹诊断显示"先容纳后取消"模式——some的丰富解读在思考前128个token处先上升（约+16pp），随后在轨迹末尾被压制到1.1%；（3）依赖上下文的推理（间接回答、隐喻、预设）随思考改善，Qwen3-8B上LUDWIG间接回答准确率提升6.5pp；（4）字面默认值在训练后特定阶段出现——OLMo-3在thinking-SFT阶段、Tülu-3在DPO阶段转变；（5）探索性补救方法：在前128个token的早期轨迹处提取答案，可恢复some/or的语用蕴涵（Qwen3-8B从1.2%提升至20.5%）而不损失字面准确率。

Conclusion: 研究支持默认-取消假说而非均匀努力假说：推理模型将思考算力用于严格真值核查，而非构建丰富的语用解读。这种分化效应表明，仅用准确率评估推理模型无法区分能力丧失与解读模式改变；评估应同时报告模型选择的解读。此外，早期轨迹前缀包含被模型自身最终放弃的丰富解读，为不损害字面性能地恢复语用推理提供了实用路径。代码、数据与模型轨迹已开源。

Abstract: When a speaker says ``some students passed'', listeners infer that not all of them did. Reasoning models now let users decide how long a model thinks before it answers, but we do not know what extra thinking does to such everyday inferences. We study this directly: we keep a model's weights fixed, change only how much it thinks, and record which reading it chooses. A second tool cuts the model's own reasoning at successive points and asks for an answer, showing where the reading changes. Thinking makes models read logical words as logic: it cancels the implicatures of \emph{some} (\emph{not all}) and \emph{or} (\emph{not both}) in most tested open reasoning models and in GPT-5, while context-driven inferences such as indirect answers improve. The trace shows why: models first entertain the enriched reading and cancel it later. Answering from that early reading, an exploratory inference-time remedy, recovers these implicatures without losing literal accuracy. Evaluations of reasoning models should measure how they interpret, not only how accurate they are.

</details>


### [349] [Rubric Judgments Lack Uncertainty: Conformal Weighting for LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21214)
*Licheng Pan,Haocheng Yang,Haoxuan Li,Yuzhou Chen,Yichen Sun,Yuan Lu,Xiaoxi Li,Hao Wang,Zhixuan Chu,Kui Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出URW框架,通过模板集成与分裂共形p值校准,为基于规则的LLM评估中的二值判断提供每准则不确定性权重,无需训练即可提升偏好准确率与下游RL对齐效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于规则的LLM评估将质量分解为多个二元准则,但现有方法采用均匀加权聚合,忽略了不同准则间判断确定性的显著差异。不确定性高的判断与确定性高的判断获得相同权重,可能反转两个相近响应的优劣,产生错误的奖励信号。

Method: 提出URW(UncertaintyAwareRubricWeighting)框架:(1)通过N个语义保持的释义判断模板集进行确定性解码,获得每准则的软分v̂_k;(2)在保持验证器不变的校准集上计算非一致性分数;(3)将软分转化为分裂共形p值作为权重,具有"正确判断被误赋低权重概率受控"的分布无关保证;(4)归一化权重后用于加权聚合。

Result: 在RubricBench、ResearchQA、RM-Bench、RewardBench及RewardBench2五个偏好基准上,URW一致优于Uniform、Beta-Binomial、SamplingEnsemble、SCP及Mondrian-SCP基线。模板数N=6时效果稳定,消融实验证实模板集成与共形校准具有协同效应。在Qwen38B与GLM49B策略的GRPO训练中,URW在Arena-Hard与GPQA-Diamond上均获得最佳下游RL对齐性能。

Conclusion: URW是一种无需训练、分布无关的框架,通过模板集成与分裂共形校准为二元规则验证器提供每准则不确定性权重。其理论保证可控制正确判断被错误低权重的概率,实验证明该框架在偏好聚合准确率与下游RLVR奖励信号质量上均带来持续改进。局限性在于理论保证依赖校准与测试数据的可交换性,在RLVR训练中分布漂移可能影响此条件。

Abstract: Rubric-based evaluation is widely used to assess large language model (LLM) outputs by decomposing quality into multiple criteria and assigning each a binary judgment from an LLM verifier. However, judgment certainty varies substantially across criteria. Existing methods uniformly aggregate these judgments into a final score, implicitly treating every criterion as equally certain and overlooking this heterogeneity. As a result, uncertain judgments remain incorporated into reward estimation without distinction, potentially yielding misleading training signals for downstream reinforcement learning (RL). To address this limitation, we propose Uncertainty-aware Rubric Weighting (URW), a training-free framework that quantifies criterion-level judgment uncertainty via conformal calibration. Specifically, URW elicits a soft uncertainty signal from a fixed pool of paraphrased judgment templates and converts it into a per-criterion weight using split-conformal $p$-values with provable coverage guarantees. Extensive experiments demonstrate that URW consistently improves pairwise preference accuracy and delivers stronger downstream RL alignment.

</details>


### [350] [AutoOnboarder: Autonomously Onboarding LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21218)
*Tanay Arora,Cong Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoOnboarder提出了一种自主的"入职培训"系统，通过一个智能编码智能体（Onboarder）来监督和迭代优化Executor智能体的基础模型、提示词和harness代码，以同时提升性能并降低成本。该系统在基因测序事前授权表单提交任务上进行测试，经过Onboarder优化的智能体能够匹配或超越Gemini 3.5 Flash基线的性能，成本最高降低29倍，但过程存在较大方差，尚不能用于临床。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿LLM作为智能体在harness（连接模型与环境的软件中介）内部时，批判性思维能力会显著下降。先前研究表明，直接询问时准确率为91%的模型，在浏览器使用harness下的准确率降至0.5%以下。现有智能体适应方法（微调、提示词优化、harness重设计、让智能体自我改进）均无法同时调整所有相关组件（权重、提示、模型、harness）并优化成本，也无法模拟人类入职培训中使用少量示例进行全面指导的过程。

Method: 系统由两个核心角色组成：Executor（待优化的智能体）和Onboarder（智能编码智能体，如Claude Code Opus 4.8）。Onboarder在最多12次迭代中，每次仅对三个杠杆（提示词模板、OpenRouter上的基础模型标识符、harness源代码）实施一个"可识别想法"，并在Onboarding数据集（仅20个样本）上评估，决定保留或回退。系统采用双虚拟机架构：VM1托管Onboarder和Executor，只能访问脱敏的Onboarding数据；VM2托管Trainer和Validator，保留所有ground truth和验证数据，通过token认证的本地API通信，防止数据泄露。评估任务为全外显子和全基因组测序事前授权表单提交，包含35个有效案例/141个非法案例，分布于33种错误类型（数据完整性、临床必要性、跨字段矛盾）。

Result: 在β=$0.04的每例成本目标下，三种杠杆配置（PMH、提示词+模型、仅提示词）的候选智能体均能匹配或超越Gemini 3.5 Flash基线（MFA从0.024提升至0.406–0.773），且成本仅为后者的极小一部分，最高达29倍成本降低。然而，Onboarding过程方差极大：同一Onboarding数据集的三次重复运行，得分S分别为0.323、0.501、0.199，范围达0.302；有效表单提交数为2、37、18（满分39）；MFA从0.041到0.917不等。Onboarding方差是评估噪声（约200倍）的近208倍。法官（gpt-oss-120B）与人工标注在184个样本上完全一致。便宜的基线模型（GPT-4.1 Nano、Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite）得分均为0.0，证明仅换模型不足以解决问题。在35种错误类别的泛化观察中，未见到清晰的迁移模式，因为各类别间存在固有的难度差异。

Conclusion: Onboarding展现出明显的潜力，但当前尚不成熟，无法用于临床部署。主要经验教训：(1) 模型杠杆需要精心策划的搜索空间，因为许多OpenRouter上的廉价模型存在输出schema违规、供应商功能限制等问题，6次运行中24次模型更换中有15次以崩溃或丢弃告终；(2) Onboarder需要一个结构化的思维接口，因为当前基于合同文本的自由形式接口导致Onboarder对指令的解读不稳定，常常按名称识别选模型、松散地达成成本目标、甚至放弃表单提交，harness杠杆在所有实验中至多被使用两次；(3) Onboarder需要受控的（非缺失的）互联网访问，因为缺少ICD-10等外部资源导致残缺的完美提交，可能是工具缺失问题而非模型/提示词问题，但需通过白名单、只读、审计代理的方式平衡安全与功能。未来工作将聚焦于更稳健的Onboarder接口，强制结构化思考，并平衡自由度与数据安全，以减少方差并提升性能。

Abstract: Agentic large language models have been documented to lose reasoning capability when placed inside a harness, the software that mediates their observations and actions. To reconcile these losses, we introduce AutoOnboarder, an autonomous system that adapts an agent to a task the way a trainer onboards a new employee. It places the agent under the supervision of an intelligent ``Onboarder'' coding agent, which iteratively tailors its foundation model, prompt, and harness source code to simultaneously improve performance and decrease cost. Like a real onboarding process, the Onboarder is only given tens of examples, and all evaluation data is isolated on a separate virtual machine to prevent leakage. We report the lessons learned from building and testing AutoOnboarder on genomic-sequencing prior authorization form submission. Autonomously onboarded agents are able to match or exceed the performance of a Gemini 3.5 Flash baseline at up to 29$\times$ lower costs. However, these agents remain imperfect, and the Onboarding process varies greatly in terms of final performance. We conclude that future Onboarding systems require a robust environment for the Onboarder, including a structured thought interface, (controlled) internet access, and a wide model search space.

</details>


### [351] [Auditing Escalation Reliability in Healthcare LLM Agents: A Perturbation-Controlled Benchmark of Workflow-State Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21270)
*Zihao Zheng,Junyi Yao,Baichuan Li,Jiayu Long*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对医疗LLM智能体在临床工作流中信息缺失、过时、冲突或延迟出现时的"升级决策可靠性"问题，构建了一个包含400个合成多轮医疗工作流场景的扰动受控基准（4个任务类×2种表层参数化×5种受控变体），评估5个开源权重模型（1.7B–9.7B）在四种动作（回答/请求澄清/弃答/转人工）下的成本敏感效用，揭示了清洁条件下高准确率（0.97）与工作流扰动下大量漏升级（32–97%）之间的"升级赤字"，并审计了一个轻量级工作流感知路由控制器的在分布内收益及其在词法未登录概念上的脆弱性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可信赖的医疗AI不仅需要在静态输入上准确，更需要在证据缺失、过时、冲突或延迟到达等真实工作流状态下做出可靠的"选择性决策"（何时回答、何时澄清、何时弃答、何时立即升级给人类）。现有医学LLM研究多聚焦静态问答或单轮拒答，缺少在多轮工作流状态受控变化下对升级行为的联合评估与成本敏感审计。

Method: （1）基准构建：40个手写语义种子×2种表层参数化×5种受控变体（清洁/缺失/过时/冲突/延迟风险）=400个多轮剧集，覆盖文档更新、证据检索、患者消息、护士分诊四类任务，动作空间为{Answer, Ask_Clarification, Abstain, Escalate}；（2）生成条件：vanilla 与显式不确定性提示（含遗漏/过时/冲突/延迟风险检查清单）；（3）工作流状态检测器：基于正则表达式的三个二元指标C（状态冲突）、M（信息缺失）、H（高风险线索）；（4）工作流感知选择控制器：风险分R = w_u(1-conf) + w_c C + w_m M + w_h H，结合双阈值策略（高阈值升级、中阈值且原动作=Answer则改为澄清）；（5）成本模型：预声明5:1（漏升级:不必要升级）与10:1稳健性检验，效用U=u_TP+u_TN−c_FN·FN−c_FP·FP；（6）评估指标：决策准确率、升级灵敏度/特异度、漏升级率、ECE、Brier、失败AUROC、风险-覆盖曲线，并以种子聚类自助法估计置信区间，以配对Wilcoxon检验做清洁-扰动差异；（7）词法OOV压力测试：30个概念的触发短语-未见释义配对，用于审计检测器泛化。

Result: 清洁条件下决策准确率高达0.97（如Qwen3.5-9B），但不确定性提示下漏升级率达32–97%；冲突是小型"回答偏向"模型的主导失败轴（Qwen3-1.7B冲突变体准确率0.00，Qwen3-4B为0.12），而Qwen3.5-9B将冲突准确率从0.97降至0.78；明示置信度校准差（ECE 0.10–0.54）、失败AUROC仅0.48–0.77，纯置信度策略无效用增益；工作流感知控制器将漏升级降至0.12–0.24（灵敏度0.76–0.88），5:1效用从最佳提示基线的−0.82…+0.38提升至+0.45…+0.54，10:1下仍为正；词法OOV压力测试中三个检测器在触发短语上召回率1.00，但在未见释义上全部降至0.00；不确定性提示对Qwen3-4B/9B有助，但对Gemma-3-4B反而将Escalate推向Ask_Clarification（清洁变体灵敏度0.33→0.00）。

Conclusion: 清洁条件下的高准确率不能保证工作流扰动下的可靠升级行为；明示置信度不足以作为智能体级控制信号，且提示级安全指令可能适得其反；显式工作流状态指标在分布内、按预声明成本条件下优于纯置信度路由，但其基于正则表达式的检测器在词法释义上完全失效，故路由控制自身仍需独立的泛化测试；该结论受限于单一作者标签（非临床裁定）、40个种子的合成模板池、以及不含专有或临床适配模型，仅支持策略相对分析而非临床主张。

Abstract: Trustworthy biomedical AI requires reliable action selection when evidence is missing, stale, conflicting, or late, not only accurate answers on static inputs. We instantiate an episode-level evaluation protocol as 400 synthetic healthcare workflow episodes: 40 hand-authored semantic seeds across four task classes, two surface parameterizations, and five controlled variants, scored on ANSWER/ASK CLARIFICATION/ABSTAIN/ESCALATE under a pre-declared 5:1 missed-versus-unnecessary escalation cost. Reference actions are single-author study-policy labels, not clinician-adjudicated ground truth. Across five open-weight configurations (1.7B--9.7B), clean decision accuracy reaches 0.97, yet uncertainty-prompted models miss 32--97% of required escalations. The stronger 9.7B configuration narrows but does not remove the gap, falling from 0.97 clean accuracy to 0.78 under conflict. Verbalized confidence is inconsistent (ECE 0.10--0.54; failure AUROC 0.48--0.77), and a development-tuned confidence-only policy yields no utility gain. A transparent workflow-aware controller improves 5:1 utility for every model and reduces missed escalations to 0.12--0.24, at specificity 0.83--0.93. However, a 30-concept lexical stress test reduces each rule detector's recall from 1.00 on trigger phrases to 0.00 on unseen paraphrases, limiting the controller claim to this benchmark. Seed-clustered statistics, ablations, cross-task transfer, raw outputs, and manifests are packaged for audit. The results motivate explicit workflow-state evaluation while showing that apparently effective routing controls need their own generalization tests.

</details>


### [352] [Diviner: Agentic RCA with Human-Governed Adaptation for Large-Scale Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21281)
*Pradipta Ghosh,Gaurav Mitra,Shripad Nadgowda,Akshil Shah,Junyu Liu,Canturk Isci,Syamla Bandla,Xinyao Hu,Onkar Deshpande,Anik Dasgupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Diviner是Meta开发的智能根因分析（RCA）系统，采用Encode-Execute-Evaluate-Adapt四阶段可靠性生命周期，通过治理化的运营知识、Lead-worker自适应编排和人类把关的更新机制，应对大规模分布式系统中的跨服务事故调查。在Meta推荐排序基础设施中，将检测到缓解的时间降低约52%，运营工作量降低约15%，45%的调查找到精确根因，60%提供有用的因果方向，平均Groundedness达80%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模分布式系统中的事故具有跨服务、数据、配置、计算和组织边界的特点，而通用LLM代理虽然具备工具访问能力，但仍存在使用陈旧或错时上下文、将失败查询误判为症状缺失、报告无支撑的系统状态等问题。事故调查需要治理化的知识、明确的证据语义、有界执行和基于已审查结果的更新机制，而非仅靠模型能力和工具访问。

Method: 系统采用四阶段生命周期：(1) Encode将审查过的事故语料库和服务所有者专业知识转化为作用域化、版本化的技能、工作流、类型化工具和事故知识图谱（IKG，DRAMA-1B编码+FAISS向量索引）；(2) Execute使用自适应Lead和上下文隔离的worker执行登记的工作流，每个worker接收问题、技能、相关上下文和工具视图，返回结构化观察，Lead根据证据修订计划并维护证据链接的假设（支持/反驳/未决）；(3) Evaluate通过DivinerEval将保存的轨迹与响应者审查结果对比，由Agent Judge对精确RCA、有用方向和Groundedness三维度独立评分；(4) Adapt是有人类把关的过程，识别反复出现的差距并通过重放、质量检查和所有者批准后才采纳知识更新。Runtime Review Agent在调查期间验证结论，证据层区分数据/有效空结果/无效/超时等不同语义。

Result: 在运营层面，Diviner支持数千起事故（含数百起高严重度事故），每月运行数千次告警触发的调查。TDM降低约52%（95% CI: 45.7-57.9%），运营工作量降低约15%（95% CI: 11.0-18.1%）。调查质量：45%精确根因、60%有用方向、80%平均Groundedness。延迟：首有用中等置信度假设p50为7.0分钟、p95为13.7分钟；最终结论p50约15分钟、p95约24分钟。控制研究中，对比Claude vanilla，Diviner+Claude将精确RCA提升11个百分点（95% CI: 3-20），将平均墙钟时间降低52%（95% CI: 44-58）。超过100次Adapt循环，约30个新技能提议，提交给所有者的提议90%被接受，已更新技能的质量提高20-40%。

Conclusion: 可靠的RCA代理不仅需要模型能力和工具访问，还需要治理化的运营知识、时间点证据、有界执行、对调查路径的评估以及对持久更改的人工控制。Diviner展示了这些元素如何协同提供有用的事故辅助并通过审查经验更新运营知识。关键洞察：事故报告不可直接用作就绪记忆，需转化为故障签名；正确答案可能因延迟而失效；重放必须保留事发时已知的信息；调查质量应包含调查路径而非仅最终答案。分类层面表现存在差异——基础设施/网络类最强，实验发布、内存泄漏和模型生命周期类仍需改进。

Abstract: Root-cause analysis (RCA) in large-scale distributed systems is challenging because a single symptom can cross service, data, configuration, compute, and organizational boundaries. Responders must assemble incomplete evidence and coordinate experts who hold different parts of the causal path. Generic language-model agents do not solve this problem through tool access alone: they can use stale or mistimed context, interpret failed queries as absent symptoms, report unsupported system state, and overload observability services designed for human-paced use. We present Diviner (Domain-Informed Verifiable Incident Navigation through Evidence and Review), an agentic RCA system operating at Meta and organized around a four-stage reliability lifecycle. Encode combines a large corpus of reviewed incidents with service-owner expertise to produce scoped, versioned skills, workflows, typed tools, and an incident knowledge graph. Execute uses an adaptive Lead and context-isolated workers to apply relevant knowledge to point-in-time evidence and maintain evidence-linked hypotheses. Evaluate compares saved investigation trajectories with responder-reviewed outcomes to measure exact cause, useful direction, and Groundedness. Adapt uses recurring gaps and on-call feedback to derive focused operational- knowledge updates, admitting them only after replay, quality checks, and owner approval.

</details>


### [353] [Mallea: Building, Steering, and Memorizing Worlds with Coding Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21283)
*Xuanyi Liu,Ruiqi Li,Siwei Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Mallea 是一个基于编码智能体（coding agent）的代码世界模型系统，通过共享的可执行对象定义，将物体表示构建、行为定义/编辑和外观纹理记忆三个环节统一起来，从文本提示生成可交互、可编辑、具备长时一致性记忆的可视化世界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型在长时序生成中难以维持物体一致性与物理合理性；现有代码世界模型虽然暴露了显式状态与可执行规则，但在物体表示选择、运行时行为扩展以及外观记忆管理方面缺乏统一协调机制，导致视觉质量指标与状态/事件一致性之间的不一致。Mallea 旨在以"编码智能体+共享对象身份"为核心，解决"如何表示物体、如何定义与修改其行为、如何随时间记忆其外观"这三个相互关联的问题。

Method: 系统由三部分协同组成——① 编码智能体（coding agent）：从文本提示推断物体及其交互需求，联合规划每个物体的几何表示、属性字段和规则，选择能支持所需交互的最简表示；② 可编程属性机制：每个对象具有稳定身份、几何表示与类型化属性字段，规则由"事件+条件+更新"组成，支持在运行时通过文本请求扩展新字段与规则（通过状态副本校验后提交），并维持未受影响状态；③ 物体纹理记忆（object texture memory）：仅对白盒（whitebox）定义的物体存储可复用外观、覆盖范围与标注时刻，纹理坐标绑定到所选表示（包围盒面/铰接部件/网格面），运行时依据可见性、姿态、材质与外观相关属性检查复用条件，并将生成结果通过物体 ID、深度与相机几何回写对至超世界表面；生成渲染器结合当前渲染提示、白盒几何条件和投影外观生成观测。

Result: 文章目前仅给出定性结果：12 个涵盖物理过程与角色动作的场景示例，展示自适应表示（如光学装置的机械几何 vs 战术场景的粗略代理）、可编程属性（如火灾控制链耦合物体响应、磁铁场景中材料相关行为）以及物体纹理记忆（如零重力场景下姿态变化时的外观保留）。作者明确表示定量 benchmark 结果（包括记忆消融与长时序重访基准）将"soon" 释出，结论部分也重申定量评估将"will be released soon"。

Conclusion: Mallea 提出了一种以共享可执行对象为枢纽的代码世界模型框架，将交互相关几何、可扩展行为与状态兼容的外观复用联系起来，修订可在保留未受影响状态的同时引导执行与渲染；定性示例展示了多样化的表示与交互，定量评估（交互保真度、运行时扩展、长时序一致性、计算成本）将在未来工作中报告。

Abstract: Code world models represent world dynamics through explicit state and executable rules. We investigate how to coordinate object representations, behavioral revisions, and visual memory within this formulation. We present Mallea, a system for building, steering, and memorizing worlds from text. A coding agent infers object interaction requirements from the prompt and jointly plans object structure, properties, and rules, favoring compact representations that support those requirements. The world evolves under the planned rules; optional user actions steer it, while text requests can edit properties or extend capabilities with unaffected state preserved. Object texture memory retains reusable appearance only for whitebox-defined objects and adapts it as those objects change. The program advances world state, while a generative renderer combines current structure with remembered appearance. By organizing construction, intervention, and memory around the same objects, Mallea conditions subsequent observations on the latest state and compatible appearance. Project page: this https URL .

</details>


### [354] [The Density of Thought: Predicting and Steering Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21286)
*Tanush Kalhan,Anupam Chattopadhyay,Sriram Ranga,Amritendu Mukherjee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了大型语言模型（LLM）思维链（CoT）推理中信息密度的双重角色——既是推理正确性的诊断信号，也是可控制的推理时干预目标。基于均匀信息密度（UID）假说，作者提出并验证了"密度即思维"的框架，在六个模型规模、两种训练范式（SFT与RL蒸馏）下通过60个GSM8K问题展开实验，得到四项核心发现：训练范式而非模型规模决定密度-正确性关系方向（SFT模型中低LP方差预测正确性，RL蒸馏模型中关系反转）；存在固有的复杂性偏好偏差（KL不对称比2.0–2.6×）；直接推理时密度引导会灾难性破坏准确率（-51.7pp），证明密度是功能承载性的；提出的EGDR（熵门控密度路由）方法作为自监督干预可提升准确率+10.0pp，结合hint injection与对比KV缓存引导的预生成微调可提升+13.3pp。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CoT提示虽能提升LLM多步推理能力，但人们对推理成功/失败的结构性原因理解不足：两条表面相似的推理链可能得出相反结论，提示正确性不仅取决于"写什么"，更取决于"如何组织跨步骤的信息流"。作者借鉴心理语言学的UID假说（有效沟通应均匀分配信息），将信息密度作为推理质量的候选信号，并探究其能否成为推理时的可控杠杆以提升可靠性。

Method: 方法包含四部分：(1) 密度测量框架——采用两种独立指标：LP方差（步骤级均token负对数似然方差，模型内部信号）与Caveman压缩比（基于SpaCy规则剥离可预测语法token，文本表面信号）。(2) 跨代际/合成实验——在10个预训练模型（GPT-2 Small至Mistral 7B）上测量复杂性偏好差距Δ，并按Ranga等人方法训练4个GPT-2类模型（2M–50M）在均匀/线性/逆分布语料上检验固有偏差。(3) 原理性微调——结合NuRL式抽象hint injection与基于CoT与直接回答prompt之间KV缓存差异向量的对比KV缓存引导。(4) EGDR——自监督方法，在每个token解码后基于Shannon熵H_t对最后一层KV位置施加分段修正（高熵>1.5H̄时+αd强化，低熵<0.6H̄时-0.3αd温和抑制），单次贪心生成中以≈0.3%的额外开销运行。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 跨代际复杂性偏好增长+21.3%，显著超过Pythia家族受控规模增长的+13.2%，表明训练方法而非规模是主要驱动因素；合成实验中KL(Inverse)/KL(Linear)比为2.0–2.6×，证明复杂性偏好是学习过程固有属性。(2) Qwen2.5 SFT模型上LP方差-正确性关系随规模增大而崩溃（1.5B时Δ_LP=+0.020，3B时-0.003，7B时-0.001），RL蒸馏模型（DeepSeek R1-Distill-Qwen）上关系反转并跨规模保持（1.5B +0.013，7B +0.014）。(3) 高密度提示将准确率从60.0%降至50.0%（-10pp），自适应中途注入降至8.3%（-51.7pp）。(4) Hint+Cache组合（条件D）取得+13.3pp（51.7%→65.0%）；EGDR（α=0.30）取得+10.0pp（61.7%），且是唯一在Δ_H（平均熵差）上达到p<0.05的条件（p=0.019）；Hint+EGDR取得+11.6pp（63.3%）。LP方差与Caveman比两个独立信号在所有条件下方向一致，确证密度效应非测量伪影。

Conclusion: 论文确立了CoT推理中的信息密度是模型学习表示的结构属性（而非表层风格），可追溯到由合成实验证实的固有复杂性偏差。该偏差表现为范式依赖的正确性信号——SFT下均匀密度预测正确性，RL蒸馏下结构化非均匀性预测正确性。密度是功能承载性的：粗暴干预会破坏准确率51.7pp。论文推导出"保留步骤级生成完整性"的设计原则，并证明EGDR等原理性干预可显著提升准确率。EGDR完全自监督且开销极低，为无需再训练、无需外部数据或验证器即可提升推理提供了实用路径，可与现有解码时方法自然组合。更广泛的意义在于：将信息密度从推理质量的被动描述符重构为推理时的主动控制面——朝向范式自适应推理系统（先诊断模型密度范式再应用对应有益干预）以及密度引导转向与加速的统一处理。该框架将密度提升为一阶可控制属性，为同时提升LLM准确性与可解释性开辟了方向。

Abstract: We investigate whether variation in information density across chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning steps predicts answer correctness and can serve as a controllable inference-time target. We prompt frozen pretrained models to solve problems via CoT and measure the density of each reasoning step with two independent metrics: LP variance (how unevenly information is distributed across steps, computed as the variance in mean per-token negative log-likelihood) and the Caveman compression ratio. We then test whether density correlates with, and can be steered to improve, answer correctness. Experiments across six model scales, two training paradigms, and 60 GSM8K problems yield four main findings. First, lower LP variance predicts correctness in supervised fine-tuned (SFT) models, but this relationship weakens with scale and reverses in reinforcement-learning (RL) distilled models. Training paradigm therefore appears more influential than model size in determining density behaviour. Second, synthetic experiments reveal an intrinsic complexity preference: models trained on uniformly distributed data learn complexity-favouring distributions 2.0 to 2.6 times more accurately than simplicity-favouring ones. Third, direct inference-time density steering reduces accuracy from 60.0% to 8.3%, indicating that natural density patterns are functionally important to reasoning. Fourth, pre-generation nudging combining hint injection with contrastive KV-cache steering improves accuracy by 13.3 percentage points, consistent across both metrics. Finally, we introduce Entropy-Gated Density Routing (EGDR), a self-supervised method using token-level Shannon entropy to gate proportional KVcache adjustments during generation, improving accuracy by 10.0 percentage points without any external guidance.

</details>


### [355] [Bias Control and Injection for Multi-Agent Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21290)
*Sungjae Lee,Soheil Abbasloo,Jabin Koo,Jungseul Ok*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对多智能体大语言模型推理中智能体决策冲突难以可靠聚合的问题，提出一种测试时聚合框架。该框架结合两种互补机制：偏差控制（对每个不同答案呈现一条风格归一化的推理轨迹以形成初始决策）和偏差注入（将聚合智能体初始选择的答案置于少数派以评估决策可靠性）。该方法无需验证数据也无需模型强度的先验知识，在三个数学推理基准和四个异构LLM组合上实现了更高的平均准确率与更好的token效率，并能直接应用于多智能体辩论和MoA框架以提升最终答案准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM推理在最终聚合阶段面临核心难题：当各智能体给出冲突的答案时，难以判断应信任谁。基于频率或一致性的聚合方法（如多数投票）虽然总体有效，但在存在相关性错误或正确答案以低频出现时会失效；而基于LLM推理的聚合虽能利用额外证据，却易受多数压力、风格偏好、位置等非语义偏差的干扰。多数已有研究聚焦于缓解偏差，本文则探索同时利用偏差的缓解与对抗施加，将其转化为可靠的决策信号。

Method: 方法包含两步核心机制：(1) 偏差控制：将推理轨迹按答案分组，每种不同答案仅保留一条轨迹并改写为统一的散文风格形式，由此消除频率与风格的呈现偏差并形成各智能体的初始决策；(2) 偏差注入：当各智能体初始决策不一致时，将每个智能体最初选择的答案在二次呈现中置于相对少数派（例如目标答案呈现一次，最强竞争答案呈现两次），观察其决策是否翻转。决策保持不变视为可靠性信号。最后，通过"保持计数H(a)（控制与探测均选某答案的智能体数）"与"探测支持数S(a)"进行聚合，选择满足H(a)>0且S(a)>J/2的答案。整个框架无需训练、验证数据或模型强度先验，可应用于独立采样、多智能体辩论及MoA的推理历史。

Result: 在三个数学推理基准（OlymMATH、AIME、HMMT的220题）与四种三模型组合（涉及Qwen3-8B、Phi-4-reasoning-plus、GLM-Z1-9B、Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2）上的实验表明：(1) 在所有四种模型组合中，所提方法的平均准确率均高于最强非预言基线3.2–6.2个百分点，并优于Single-Best-SC预言参考1.8–4.3个百分点，同时token使用更少；(2) 多数投票遗漏正确答案时，该方法可恢复53.6%，保留98.4%的MV正确答案；(3) 在多智能体辩论和MoA上应用同一聚合过程也能提升最终答案准确率，而不改变其上游交互或综合机制；(4) 消融实验验证了风格归一化与对抗频率注入各自对准确率的贡献。

Conclusion: 本文证明了多智能体聚合中偏差的双重作用：通过风格归一化与频率平衡缓解频率和风格偏差可改善初始决策，通过将初始选择置于少数派并观察决策翻转可获得问题特定的可靠性信号。所提出的训练和验证自由的测试时框架在异构LLM的数学推理任务上实现了更高的准确率和更好的token效率，并能即插即用地增强现有的多智能体辩论与MoA框架。局限在于评估集中在8B–14B参数的开源模型的数学推理任务，未来工作应将偏差控制与注入干预扩展至更多领域、模型规模以及上游交互综合阶段。

Abstract: Multi-agent reasoning with large language models (LLMs) raises a central question for collective decision-making: when agents disagree, whose decision should be trusted? Resolving such disagreements is difficult because agents' decisions are susceptible to non-semantic biases such as majority pressure and response-style preferences, which can obscure the quality of the underlying reasoning.
